articleTitle: Novel fabrication process of controlling aspect ratio of the hollow core in photonic bandgap fibers
abstract: We propose novel method of controlling the aspect ratio of the hollow core in the photonic bandgap fibers by inducing of asymmetric temperature characteristics at the hollow core region during the drawing process.

articleTitle: Synchronous parametric amplification for regeneration of 160Gbit/s OTDM signal
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a simple all-optical regeneration scheme for 160Gbit/s OTDM signal. Retiming and amplitude-limiting functions are simultaneously performed by parametric amplification of a signal with an optical clock synchronized by an OPLL technique.

articleTitle: On the packet optical networking platform (Packet-ONP) with a centralized universal switch for ethernet and TDM
abstract: The emergence of Packet-ONP with a centralized universal switch provides much improved efficiency, flexibility and scalability. The architectural and economic benefits of Packet-ONP are addressed to meet today's fast-growing bandwidth requirement for carriers' transport networks

articleTitle: Reducing burst loss probability in multi-class optical burst switching networks by successive minimal incremental routing
abstract: The successive minimal incremental routing (SMIR) algorithm is proposed to implement the class-aware routing scheme in multi-class optical burst switching (OBS) networks to further reduce the burst loss probability of multiple classes.

articleTitle: GENI: Overview & plans
abstract: We describe GENI, the global environment for network innovations, is a suite of experimental network research infrastructure being planned and prototyped in work sponsored by the National Science foundation.

articleTitle: Ultra high-speed, multi-wavelength polarization ompairment characterization technique for pol-muxed optical links
abstract: We introduce a technique to monitor the polarization dependent impairments in optical links at tens of MHz speeds. Experimentally, we capture up to 10 ps PMD values for 5.8-nm optical bandwidth at 36 MHz refresh rates.

articleTitle: Transmission with 1490 nm Photonic Integrated Circuits and all-SOA amplification for fiber bandwidth extension
abstract: A 100Gb/s Photonic Integrated Circuit at 1490 nm has been transmitted over 320 km using all-SOA amplification, demonstrating the applicability of PICs to address 55THz of fiber bandwidth.

articleTitle: Novel concepts for high speed VCSELs
abstract: The use of quantum dots allows the temperature insensitive operation of VCSELs at 20 Gb/s at temperatures up to 150degC. The electro-optic VCSEL modulation enables pulsed light emission with rise and fall times <15 ps.

articleTitle: Waveguide coupler formed by a graded photonic crystal
abstract: The coupling between a conventional dielectric waveguide and a photonic crystal waveguide is studied. The coupling methods studied in this work include graded photonic crystal coupler, photonic crystal taper, waveguide taper and parabolic mirror coupler. The measurement and simulation results show that the graded photonic crystal coupler has a higher coupling efficiency in a short coupling length.

articleTitle: An ultra-scalable broadband architecture for municipal hybrid wireless access using optical grid network
abstract: A novel broadband architecture suitable for municipal hybrid wireless access is proposed. This architecture, called GROW-Net, is ultra-scalable in bandwidth support and infrastructure extensibility. This paper presents GROW-Net transmission quality, resource efficiency, and QoS supports.

articleTitle: Compact silicon microring-assisted directional couplers for WDM and optical signal processing applications
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a compact SOI microring-assisted directional coupler. The device can be designed to have a wide range of spectral responses, including sharp asymmetric Fano line shapes, for WDM, switching and sensing applications.

articleTitle: Active multi-bound soliton lasers: Generation of dual to sextuple states
abstract: We present the generation of multi-bound solitons of 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> to 6<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> order states in a phase-modulation mode-locked fiber ring cavity. Temporal distribution and optical spectra confirm the differential phase states between adjacent solitons.

articleTitle: Broadband single-mode microfiber coupler for OCT
abstract: We present a broadband bi-conical microfiber coupler (MFC) with a specifically designed transition region that effectively suppresses any higher-order mode content present at the input fiber and provides efficient power splitting into the fundamental mode at the two output ports. As a practical example, single-mode 3-dB splitting operation over a very broad spectral window (400~1700 nm) was demonstrated with a 1.1 mum MFC made from conventional telecom optical fibers.

articleTitle: Multi-channel fiber-based source of polarization entangled photons with integrated alignment signal
abstract: We describe a fiber source of polarization entangled photons entirely constructed with fiber-coupled commercial components. A built-in alignment signal allows systematic setting of downstream measurement basis. Entanglement is measured at several signal-idler channels simultaneously.

articleTitle: Fiber-based entangled photon sources and their applications
abstract: We present an overview of how fiber-based sources of entangled photons have evolved to meet the requirements of quantum-information applications and we present one of those applications, one that addresses an ancient philosophical question.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon-based refractive index sensor using a tapered Bragg Fiber
abstract: A surface plasmon-based fiber sensor using a tapered Bragg fiber is proposed for high resolution refractive measurement. This structure allows precise measurement of low-index liquid or gel and the fabricated sensor showed a high sensitivity.

articleTitle: Investigation of 11.1Gbit/s direct-detection OFDM QAM-16 transmission over 1600km of uncompensated fiber
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated 11.1 Gb/s QAM-16 direct-detection OFDM transmission over 1600 km of uncompensated standard fiber using 0-5.55 GHz band. We also investigated the effect of self-phase modulation and observed penalties comparable to systems using QPSK-OFDM.

articleTitle: Polarization beat length distribution measurement in single-mode optical fibers with Brillouin optical correlation-domain reflectometry
abstract: The polarization beat length distribution along a single-mode optical fiber is measured with a Brillouin optical correlation-domain reflectometry (BOCDR) with such unique features as one-end access, random access to measuring positions, high spatial resolution, and high measurement speed.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of end-to-end PCI Express communication over a transparent all-optical photonic interconnection network interface
abstract: We successfully establish a PCI Express link, demonstrating device recognition between an endpoint device and host computer across an all-optical WDM network interface. Direct Memory Access transfers are demonstrated across the upstream and downstream paths.

articleTitle: Long period fiber gratings for high speed optical pulse shaping: Principles and applications
abstract: Recent work on long-period fiber grating-based picosecond and sub-picosecond optical pulse shaping/processing techniques and their applications in ultrafast optical telecommunication systems (up to 640 GHz) will be reviewed.

articleTitle: All-optical multicast based on cavity-enhanced four-wave-mixing in semiconductor ring laser
abstract: Reconfigurable all-optical multicast at multi-gigabit data rates has been realised using simultaneous multi-wavelength conversion based on cavity-enhanced four-wave-mixing in a monolithically integrated semiconductor ring laser. The scheme provides high efficiency, low power penalty, and cost-effectiveness.

articleTitle: Reduced complexity Rx concepts for optical multilevel transmission
abstract: Low complexity receiver concepts for multilevel transmission are reviewed. Systems with direct detection and coherent demodulation including digital electronic signal processing for equalization are compared in performance and on basis of their implementation complexity.

articleTitle: Temperature stabilized electrically tunable long period gratings coated with nanosized liquid crystal layer
abstract: Electrical spectral tuning of long-period gratings (LPGs) coated with high refractive index liquid crystal (LC) layer is presented. Temperature is stabilized at 60°C to obtain a high sensitivity operating point. The tuning range is ∼10nm.

articleTitle: Transmission from 0–360km (6120 ps/nm) at 10 Gb/s without optical or electrical dispersion compensation using digital pulse shaping of a chirp managed laser
abstract: For the first time, we demonstrate 0-360 km transmission in SMF fibre at 10.709 Gb/s without DCF or EDC using a DSP enabled driver and a CML TOSA fitting into pluggable XFP/SFP+ transceivers.

articleTitle: Development of a multiple-row MT connector for 80 µm diameter optical fibers
abstract: This paper presents the development of a multiple row MT connector for 80 mum diameter optical fibers. We conclude that the connector is effective for optical interconnections.

articleTitle: Highly sensitive temperature sensor using fiber Bragg grating on Pb/Ge-codoped fiber
abstract: A highly sensitive fiber Bragg grating temperature sensor using a temperature-sensitive Pb/Ge-codoped fiber was demonstrated experimentally with the average temperature sensitivity of the resonance wavelength shift about 0.0176 nm/degC.

articleTitle: Progress in metamaterials for optical devices (invited paper)
abstract: We review recent progress in optical metamaterials and demonstrate our sample with negative index behavior at the shortest wavelength so far (710 nm). We discuss the impact of fabrication limitations on the performance of metamaterials.

articleTitle: Generation of energetic wavelength tunable femtosecond pulses in higher-order-mode fiber
abstract: We discuss soliton-self frequency shift in higher-order-mode (HOM) fibers below 1300 nm. HOM fibers, with its higher tolerance to nonlinearities and engineerable dispersion characteristics, will enable tunable, energetic femtosecond sources at new wavelength regions.

articleTitle: Experimental characterization of elliptical hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber at wavelengths within the bandgap
abstract: We fabricate the hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber with elliptical core (EC-PBGF) and also show the possibility of strain and temperature sensing applications by composing a Sagnac loop interferometer with the fabricated EC-PBGF.

articleTitle: Continuously tunable multiwavelength fiber ring laser using nonlinear polarization rotation of SOA with external optical injection
abstract: We report a both channel-spacing- and wavelength-tunable multiwavelegnth fiber laser using nonlinear polarization rotation of SOA. Simultaneous oscillation of 20 wavelengths with 0.8nm spacing is continuously tuned by varying the power of externally injected laser.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of a novel filterless frequency quadrupling technique for colorless WDM millimeter-wave up-conversion systems
abstract: This study demonstrates a novel filterless frequency quadrupling technique for optical millimeter-wave generation and WDM up-conversion. After transmission of 50-km SMFF, the sensitivity penalty of each channel is less than 1.5 dB.

articleTitle: Demonstration of piezoelectric-polarization-controller-assisted P-OTDR
abstract: We propose a piezoelectric-polarization-controller-assisted polarization sensitive optical time domain reflectometry (P-OTDR), and have detected the birefringence distribution of single-mode fibers. An external pressure and its position is detected.

articleTitle: Parabolic pulse formation and applications
abstract: Parabolic pulses in optical fibers have stimulated an increasing number of applications. We review here the physics underlying the generation of such pulses as well as the results obtained in a wide-range of experimental configurations.

articleTitle: Bandwidth-reduced Brillouin optical time domain reflectometry using reference Brillouin scattering
abstract: We present a bandwidth reduced BOTDR realized by using reference Brillouin scattering as a local light. Temperature distribution sensing is successfully demonstrated by compensating for the temperature variation in the reference fiber.

articleTitle: Long spiral optical waveguides using ultra low loss perfluorinated polymer for optical interconnect
abstract: Multimode polymer optical waveguides with long spiral path using a perfluoropolymer are demonstrated. Spiral path length is 1.254 m and NA is 0.26. Propagation loss at 1310, 1550, and 1650 nm were 0.047 dB/cm, 0.049 dB/cm, 0.070 dB/cm , respectively.

articleTitle: The deployment and operation of fiber to the Cell Site
abstract: As wireless service providers begin to migrate from 2.5 and 3G wireless technologies to 4G systems, the bandwidth required at cell sites greatly increases. At the heart of this transition are initiatives coined Ethernet to the Cell Site. These initiatives are a means to provide increased bandwidth, improved reliability, and survivability to the 4G wireless networks.

articleTitle: Rep rate multiplication of pseudo-random bit sequences
abstract: We describe an all-optical method for rate multiplication of pseudo-random bit sequences. We quadruplicate, error-freely to 50 Gb/s, a 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup>-1, 12.5 Gb/s sequence. The scheme is a feedback loop and comprises of two nonlinear gates.

articleTitle: Novel optically generated Ultra Wideband (UWB) signals
abstract: We describe UWB wireless technology and the regulatory environment that imposes severe power constraints on these signals. We explain how optical pulse shaping can achieve impressive gains in power efficiency.

articleTitle: High-speed and high-responsivity back-illuminated photodiode with a high reflective reflector for 25-Gbps receiver of 100-Gbps ethernet
abstract: We developed a high-speed (over 30 GHz) and high-responsivity (nearly 0.8 A/W) back-illuminated PD with a newly developed high reflective reflector, and successfully demonstrated an error free 25-Gbps 10-km SMF transmission.

articleTitle: New optical fiber line testing system function for highly accurate facility location using Brillouin frequency shift assigned optical fiber
abstract: This paper describes a new optical fiber line testing system function for locating faulty facilities in optical fiber networks with a high accuracy by using 1 cm of Brillouin frequency shift assigned fiber.

articleTitle: Implementation of burst-mode optical amplification for WDM application; overpumping with GFF vs LOA hybrid
abstract: We demonstrated two types of implementation of burst-mode amplifier for WDM. Both amplifiers successfully maintained gain flatness in spite of dynamic change of input power according to traffic density. Noise figure and cost was trade-off.

articleTitle: Stimulated supercontinuum generation
abstract: We demonstrate active control over optical rogue waves with a weak optical seed. With this effect, we stimulate supercontinuum generation, resulting in greatly enhanced stability and coherence. The phenomenon also facilitates all-optical three-terminal devices.

articleTitle: Stable and ultra-wideband wavelength-tunable harmonically mode-locked short-cavity fiber ring laser using a bismuth-oxide-based highly nonlinear erbium-doped fiber
abstract: We demonstrate a harmonically mode-locked laser employing a 151cm-long bismuth-oxide-based highly nonlinear erbium-doped fiber. The cavity is as short as 8m. Stable 10GHz short pulses are obtained with an 87nm tuning range covering the CL-band.

articleTitle: Monolithic integration of diffractive optical element on silicon 45-degree micro-reflector
abstract: A monolithically integrating of a diffractive optical element onto a silicon-based 45deg micro-reflector for facilitating the optical alignment of non-coplanar fiber-to-fiber coupling with a working distance of 300 mum is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Cost-efficient non-blocking WDM network ppgrade
abstract: We investigate methods for periodic capacity upgrades (namely Network Engineering) to handle traffic growth in optical WDM mesh networks. Significant cost savings can be achieved by upgrading capacity of appropriate links at appropriate times.

articleTitle: Polarization dependent loss study on silicon-wire waveguide tap for optical performance monitoring
abstract: The complex refractive index of reflective metal layer was integrated onto the direction-changing region, made by 54.7-degree angles from anisotropic silicon wet-etching, to compensate polarization dependent loss of the tapping signal power on silicon-wire waveguides.

articleTitle: Tunable all-fiber short-wavelength-IR transmitter
abstract: Tunable SWIR operation in 2150nm band is reported for the first time. All-fiber transmitter construction used parametric conversion to convert 1.26µm seed to 2.155µm SWIR channel with record 35dB efficiency over 900nm spectral range.

articleTitle: Highly energetically efficient pulse compression for 640 Gbit/s OTDM using parabolic-like pulses synthesized with a long period fiber grating structure
abstract: Very low-pedestal, 310-fs FWHM pulses at 10-GHz repetition rate are obtained by nonlinear fiber propagation of parabolic-like pulses synthesized by linear re-shaping of 1.5-ps soliton-like pulses with an energetic efficiency reaching 70%.

articleTitle: A broadband ONU design using a Semiconductor Optical Amplifier-based Optical Loop Mirror
abstract: We demonstrate a novel approach in the implementation of a broadband optical network unit using a semiconductor optical amplifier-based optical loop mirror, both experimentally and via simulations for up to 50 km and 2.5 Gb/s.

articleTitle: TCP performance analysis of grid over OBS networks
abstract: TCP performance is analyzed in grid over OBS network with the high bandwidth-delay product scenario. The impacts of the influential factors of both the TCP layer and the OBS layer are analyzed all-roundly.

articleTitle: Automated fiber optical switching in FTTP PON access networks
abstract: Verizon has an aggressive plan to deploy fiber in its access network. Verizon is investigating the use of optical switches to reduce costs and improve service quality. Applications and architectures, using optical switches, are evaluated.

Author Keywords: (060.1810) Buffers, couplers, routers, switches, and multiplexers

articleTitle: Proposal of broadband optical delay with fine delay resolution utilizing high-confinement silicon waveguides
abstract: This proposal for an optical delay element, with a broad operation bandwidth and fine delay resolution, highlights the compact and nonresonant circuit design, as well as the size reduction of wavelength-insensitive couplers utilizing silicon waveguides.

articleTitle: 100Gb/s 10km link performance of 10×10Gb/s hybrid approach with integrated WDM array of DFB lasers
abstract: We demonstrate a 100 Gb/s 10 km link using hybrid packaging containing a monolithic WDM array of DFBs a PLC based optical MUX, an array of PDs and TIAs , and a PLC based optical DeMUX.

articleTitle: Defect-core PCF with metal coated central air-hole for THz propagation
abstract: A rigorous finite element analysis on a new Teflon PCF with metal coated central air-hole shows the formation a Surface Plasmon assisted fundamental mode with controllable modal properties for THz sensing application.

articleTitle: Optimized acoustic refractive index profiles for suppression of stimulated Brillouin scattering in large core fibers
abstract: We use an approximation for the Brillouin gain in optical fibers to find the antiguiding acoustic refractive index profile that minimizes the gain. We also calculate the Brillouin gain with BPM, with good agreement.

articleTitle: Gain enhancement in slow-light systems based on stimulated Brillouin-scattering with several short fibers
abstract: Presented is a novel system configuration of slow-light systems based on stimulated Brillouin-scattering consisting of several short fibers and a blocking of spurious backscattered spectral components for an enhancement of the gain and time delay.

articleTitle: 10-Gbit/s duobinary transmission controlled by a tunable coupled resonator optical delay line
abstract: We demonstrate that a coupled resonator optical waveguide can be used to control the delay of a 10 Gbit/s NRZ duobinary signal by 3 bit-lengths without significantly corrupting phase information.

articleTitle: Principles of digital coherent receivers for optical communications
abstract: ▪ Coherent detection enables the highest spectral efficiency by allowing information be encoded in amptitude and phase. ▪ Homodyne or heterodyne downcoverter recovers the field in each polarization, and sampling above Nyquist rate enables compensation in DSP with no loss of information. ▪ CD and PMD are linear distortions and can be compensated by a linear filter in both single-carrier and OFDM transmission. ▪ Single-carrier and QFDM have similar computational requirements. ▪ Phase-noise tolerance of feedforward carrier recovery is superior to PLL. ▪ In the presence of dispersion, phase noise tolerance scales inversely with impulse response duration. ▪ Digital BP is a universal method of compensating linear and nonlinear impairments for both single-carrier and OFDM. Enables greater transmission distance, at the expense of complexity.

articleTitle: History [& future?] of Photonic crystal fibres
Technical program and steering committees
abstract: Provides a listing of current committee members.

articleTitle: Key to authors and presiders
abstract: Presents an index of the authors whose papers are published in the conference.

articleTitle: Agenda of Sessions
abstract: Provides a schedule of conference events and a listing of which papers were presented in each session.

articleTitle: Table of contents
abstract: Presents the table of contents of the proceedings.

articleTitle: BERTScope [Advertisement]
abstract: Advertisement: SyntheSys Research, Inc., innovator of the award-winning BERTScope, develops and manufactures high-speed signal integrity test and measurement instrumentation for the computer, storage, and communications industries.

articleTitle: Reach-dependent capacity in optical networks enabled by OFDM
abstract: In today's optical networks, the channel capacity is designed for the system's maximum reach. By using OFDM, reach dependent capacity can be realized which improves the network performance substantially.

articleTitle: On the energy consumption of FTTH access networks
abstract: The energy consumption of FTTH network variants is compared with respect to the average access bit rate. The results show that passive optical networks are more energy efficient than point-to-point or active optical access networks.

articleTitle: Architectures for energy-efficient IPTV networks
abstract: A new energy consumption model of IPTV storage and distribution provides insights into the optimal design of a VoD network. Energy consumption is minimized by replicating popular program material on servers close to users.

articleTitle: A reconfigurable interconnect fabric with optical circuit switch and software optimizer for stream computing systems
abstract: An optical circuit switched network using a 3D-MEMS crossbar is demonstrated in a datacenter-scalable stream processing system. We developed a complete software control, routing and scheduling framework to interconnect clusters of blade servers.

articleTitle: Polarization QAM modulation (POL-QAM) for coherent detection schemes
abstract: A new polarization constellation diagram leads to polarization QAM modulation formats. At 28 Gband (112 Gb/s) POL-QAM 6-4 with six QPSK modulated states-of-polarization enables 1.7-dB higher sensitivity than PDM-QPSK by applying coded-modulation with an inner RS(511,455) FEC.

articleTitle: Adaptive chromatic dispersion equalization for non-dispersion managed coherent systems
abstract: Blind adaptive chromatic dispersion equalization for coherent polarization multiplexed (NRZ/RZ)-QPSK receivers is presented. A novel low complexity estimation algorithm precisely estimates arbitrarily large dispersion in a fixed adaptation length.

articleTitle: 112 Gb/s DP-QPSK transmission using a novel nonlinear compensator in digital coherent receiver
abstract: A novel nonlinear compensation scheme is proposed and demonstrated with 112 Gb/s DP-QPSK format using digital coherent receiver. The Q-improvement by the proposed scheme exceeded 2 dB after 20 span (1200 km) transmission.

articleTitle: Demonstration of RSOA-based WDM PON employing self-homodyne receiver with high reflection tolerance
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a 1.25-Gb/s RSOA-based WDM PON employing a novel self-homodyne receiver. The proposed receiver enables the excellent receiver sensitivity and reflection tolerance, and has potential applications in the long-reach WDM PON with high-split ratio.

articleTitle: Filtering characteristics of highly-spectrum efficient spectrum-sliced elastic optical path (SLICE) network
abstract: We investigate the performance of OFDM-modulated signals in spectrum-sliced elastic optical path network. We analyze the filtering characteristics and the guard band for multi-node transmission. The architecture increases spectral efficiency over the current WDM systems.

articleTitle: Demonstration of frequency-domain averaging based channel estimation for 40-Gb/s CO-OFDM with high PMD
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the intra-symbol frequency-domain averaging based channel estimation for a 40-Gb/s polarization-division-multiplexed coherent optical OFDM signal with 8-QAM modulation under large polarization-mode-dispersion, showing improved efficiency as compared to the time-domain averaging based scheme.

articleTitle: Low sample rate transmitter for direct-detection optical OFDM
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel colorless transmitter for direct-detection optical OFDM that requires lower sample-rate DACs than previous designs, without RF mixers. We transmit 24-Gbit/s over 800-km SSMF using two 10 GS/s DACs.

articleTitle: The OSMOSIS optical packet switch for supercomputers
abstract: We describe the OSMOSIS project from requirements through realization, in which IBM research and Corning Inc. completed the 64 port at 40 Gbps/port demonstrator hardware for what we believe is the world's first true optical packet switch.

articleTitle: Single cycle subcarrier modulation
abstract: We report experimental demonstration of a concept of subcarrier modulation with the symbol rate and carrier frequency being identical, and thereby synchronous. The concept is demonstrated with 2.5 Gsymbols/s signals generated with binary digital electronics.

articleTitle: 100 Gb/s operation of an AlGaInAs semi-insulating buried heterojunction EML
abstract: A large electro-optic bandwidth Electro-absorption Modulated laser, with a Semi-Insulating AlGaInAs/InP Buried Heterostructure, has been associated with a 100 Gb/s InP Heterojunction Bipolar Transistor Multiplexing circuit, exhibiting an open eye diagram.

articleTitle: High frequency sensing interrogation system using Fiber Bragg grating based microwave photonic filtering
abstract: A high frequency sensing interrogation system by using fiber Bragg grating based microwave photonic filtering is proposed, in which the wavelength measurement sensitivity is proportional to the RF modulation frequency applied to the optical signal.

articleTitle: Spectral Efficiency and Receiver Sensitivity in Direct Detection Optical-OFDM
abstract: We show by analysis and simulation that by proper biasing of the optical modulator, the intermodulation distortion is minimized. Thus the spectral efficiency can be improved and receiver sensitivity can be exchanged against spectral width.

articleTitle: High spectral efficiency coherent optical OFDM for 1 Tb/s Ethernet transport
abstract: Coherent optical OFDM (CO-OFDM) is considered as a pathway toward future 1-Tb/s Ethernet transport. CO-OFDM over the multimode-fiber is envisaged as a candidate to overcome the capacity barrier of 100-Tb/s per fiber for long-haul transmission.

articleTitle: Simple multi-Gbps 60 GHz radio-over-fiber links employing optical and electrical data up-conversion and feed-forward equalization
abstract: We show that optical up-conversion performs better than electrical up-conversion in simple IMDD-based 60 GHz radio-over-fiber links. Feed-forward equalization improved the performances of both systems, enabling error-free transmission of 4 Gbps over 500 m of single-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Discrete multitone modulation for high-speed data transmission over multimode fibers using 850-nm VCSEL
abstract: 30-Gb/s transmission over 500 m and 28-Gb/s over 1 km of multimode fiber (with 850-nm multimode VCSEL and large-area photodetector) is experimentally demonstrated by use of discrete multitone modulation (DMT) combined with bit-loading algorithm.

articleTitle: Investigation into optical technologies for access evolution
abstract: This paper considers the main technical challenges for optical access network deployment. Technological evolution of broadband optical networks is discussed with the need for adapting both metropolitan and access networks to the customer services demand evolution.

articleTitle: Extended-reach gigabit passive optical network for rural areas using distributed Raman amplifiers
abstract: A new extended-reach GPON for rural areas using distributed Raman amplifiers is proposed and demonstrated. Symmetric 2.5-Gb/s bidirectional transmission is achieved for 32 subscribers over 60-km reach, without using any active extender.

articleTitle: Dispersion tolerant UWB-IR-over-fiber transmission under FCC indoor spectrum mask
abstract: Thanks to excess pre-compensation of chromatic dispersion and a custom UWB antenna with a band-pass characteristic, fully FCC-compliant and dispersion tolerant UWB-IR-over-fiber transmission is experimentally demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Highly survivable restoration scheme employing optical bandwidth squeezing in spectrum-sliced elastic optical path (SLICE) network
abstract: This paper proposes a novel restoration scheme in the spectrum-sliced elastic optical network. The proposed scheme achieves a high level of survivability for the traffic that is subject to the committed service profile.This paper proposes a novel restoration scheme in the spectrum-sliced elastic optical network. The proposed scheme achieves a high level of survivability for the traffic that is subject to the committed service profile.

articleTitle: Virtualized optical network (VON) for agile cloud computing environment
abstract: A virtualized optical network is proposed as a key to implementing increased agility and flexibility into a cloud computing environment by providing any-to-any connectivity with the appropriate optical bandwidth at the appropriate time.

articleTitle: CMOS-integrated 40GHz germanium waveguide photodetector for on-chip optical interconnects
abstract: Compact (0.7 mum times 20mum) germanium waveguide photodetector operating at 40 Gbps is demonstrated. Monolithic integration of high-quality Ge-on-insulator single-crystalline layer into the CMOS stack was achieved by lateral seeded crystallization during CMOS wells activation anneal above germanium melting temperature.

articleTitle: Dynamically reconfigurable optical links for high-bandwidth data center networks
abstract: State-of-the-art data center networks cannot satisfy the bandwidth requirements of upcoming applications. We explore dynamic reconfiguration of low cost, high bandwidth optical networks that can adapt to application communication patterns.

articleTitle: Hybrid integrated 40 Gb/s DPSK receiver on SOI
abstract: A DPSK receiver using a flip-chip hybrid of InP photodetectors on SOI boards with waveguide delay line interferometer and SOA preamplifier on SOI boards are developed. The horizontal waveguide integration enables bandwidths exceeding 40 GHz.

articleTitle: Performance comparison of 40G and 100G coherent PDM-QPSK for upgrading dispersion managed legacy systems
abstract: We compare the performance of 40 G and 100 G coherent PDM-QPSK solutions for the upgrade of existing 10 G-based optical networks. This comparison is performed on the Alcatel-Lucent 1626LM commercial system.

articleTitle: Power saving architectures for unidirectional WDM rings
abstract: The paper compares the optimal power-saving designs of unidirectional WDM rings using three well-known architectures, i.e., first-generation, all-optical, and multi-hop (hybrid). Different scenarios of load and power consumption in electronic and optical components are considered.

articleTitle: An integrated inp coherent receiver for 40 and 100 Gb/Sec telecommunications systems
abstract: An InP based 4times4 multi-mode interferometer 90deg hybrid is described. The fabricated device showed a common mode rejection ratio in excess of 20 dB, and less than 1.5 dB variation in responsivity over the C-band.

articleTitle: Optical multiplexing of two 21.5 Gb/s DPSK signals into a single 43 Gb/s DQPSK channel with simultaneous 7-fold multicasting in a single PPLN waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate optical multiplexing of two 21.5 Gb/s DPSK signals into a single 43 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK channel with simultaneous 7-fold multicasting of the multiplexed 43 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK signal in a single periodically-poled lithium-niobate waveguide. We also demonstrate direct 7-fold multicasting of a single 43 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK signal and give a comparison of the two schemes. A bit error rate of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> with power penalties < 5 dB was obtained for all multicasted RZ-DQPSK signals with 100 GHz channel spacing.

Author Keywords: (230.1150) All-Optical Devices (060.4370) Nonlinear Optics (060.4080) Phase Modulation

articleTitle: Over 25-dB dynamic range 10-/1-Gbps optical burst-mode receiver using high-power-tolerant APD
abstract: A burst-mode receiver using high-power-tolerant APD for co-existence of 10-/1Gbps-PON systems was demonstrated. An inter-burst dynamic range as large as 25dB for both 10and 1Gbps at a fixed APD bias voltage was attained.

articleTitle: Chromatic dispersion compensation using full optical-field maximum likelihood sequence estimation
abstract: We propose a new metric to significantly simplify 4-state full-field maximum likelihood sequence estimation, demonstrate its use in a 372 km field-installed fiber transmission experiment without performance degradation, and investigate the influence of critical system parameters.

articleTitle: Generation and coherent time-division demultiplexing of up to 5.1 Tb/s single-channel 8-PSK and 16-QAM signals
abstract: We have generated single-wavelength channel 8-PSK and 16-QAM RZ-data signals up to 5.1 Tb/s and subsequently extracted the time-division base rate channel using an ultrafast coherent receiver with time-division demultiplexing function and digital BER post-processing.

articleTitle: Optical OFDM demultiplexer using silica PLC based optical FFT circuit
abstract: We propose an integrated-photonic device for demultiplexing optical OFDM signals that consists of an optical FFT circuit. An optical demultiplexer for four OFDM sub-carriers is realized, and used to demultiplex 4 × 10 Gbit/s signals.

articleTitle: PCE communication protocol for resource advertisement in multi-domain BGP-based networks
abstract: PCEP messages are proposed to announce inter-domain resource information typically not advertised by BGP because of scalability reasons. Proposed messages enable effective PCE-based path computations and preserve network stability, scalability, and intea-domain information confidentiality.

articleTitle: Signal-induced rayleigh noise reduction using gain saturation in an integrated R-EAM-SOA
abstract: We demonstrate mitigation of signal-induced Rayleigh beat noise by gain saturation of the SOA element in an integrated R-EAM-SOA operating at 10 Gb/s. The system tolerance to Rayleigh backscattering was increased by 8 dB at 1 dB penalty.

articleTitle: 30-Gbps (5-Gsymbol/s) 64-QAM self-homodyne transmission over 60-km SSMF using phase-noise cancelling technique and ISI-suppression based on electronic digital processing
abstract: Linewidth-tolerant 30-Gbit/s (5-Gsymbol/s) 64-QAM real-time transmission over 60-km SSMF without any dispersion compensation was experimentally demonstrated by ISI-suppression based on electronic digital processing and pilot-carrier aided optical phase-noise cancelling for the first time.

articleTitle: Optical quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) with coherent detection up to 128 states
abstract: Recent progress on single-channel and frequency-division-multiplexed (FDM) 128 QAM coherent optical transmission is presented. The spectral efficiency as high as 10 bit/s/Hz is successfully demonstrated by using polarization-multiplexing and Nyquist filter.

articleTitle: Bit-rate-flexible all-optical OFDM transceiver using variable multi-carrier source and DQPSK/DPSK mixed multiplexing
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a bit-rate-flexible all-optical OFDM transceiver. Signals were successfully generated at 107, 42.8, 32.1, and 10.7Gbit/s and received through the transceiver. The 107-Gbit/s signal was successfully transmitted over 40-km-SMF without dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: 112Gb/s PolMux RZ-DQPSK with fast polarization tracking based on interference control
abstract: We implement fast, precise and endless optical polarization tracking of high-speed polarization-multiplexed DQPSK signals. Stable polarization demultiplexing for polarization scrambling speeds up to 800 rad/s combined with 112 Gb/s direct detection PM-RZ-DQPSK transmission over 1035 km is demonstrated.

articleTitle: 40/100GbE technologies and related activities of IEEE standardization
abstract: • Background - Ethernet: Link for packet - Ethernet Std: IEEE802.3 - 40 & 100?: Host & Network - 40/100 Timeline: ′10/06 Std • Basics of Ethernet Technology - Arch.: MII and Sublayers - 10GbE: XAUI, 64/66, LFS - BpE: AN, Optional FEC ′ 40/100GbE Technologies - Types: {K,C,S,L,E} R {4,10} - PHY Arch.: Simpler Module - MLD: Multilane flexibility - PMDs: Reuse 10G specs • 40/100GbE Transport - OTN: for WDM and TDM - 10GbE Issue: G.sup43 - OTN evolution: transparent 100GbE, transcoded 40GbE

articleTitle: Transmission of 1.2 Tb/s continuous waveband PDM-OFDM-FDM signal with spectral efficiency of 3.3 bit/s/Hz over 400 km of SSMF
abstract: We demonstrate generation, transmission and reception of a 1.21 Tb/s continuous waveband PDM-OFDM-FDM signal with spectral efficiency of 3.33 bit/s/Hz. After DCF-free transmission over 400-km SSMF a considerable Q-factor margin of 2 dB vs. EFEC limit was achieved.

articleTitle: Uncooled 20 Gb/s direct modulation of high yield, highly reliable 1300 nm InGaAlAs ridge DFB lasers
abstract: Highly reliable, high yield uncooled ridge DFB laser is presented, directly modulated up to 20 Gb/s. Excellent performances are shown: 5dB extinction ratio and record high resonance frequency slope are demonstrated up to 70degC.

articleTitle: 100 Gbit/s transmission using single-band direct-detection Optical OFDM
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a single-band direct-detection polmux OFDM system using novel colorless transmitter and pol-mux receiver architectures. We transmit 100 Gbit/s over 500 km of standard SMF with a spectral efficiency of 3.57 bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: Performance monitoring using coherent receivers
abstract: We review performance monitoring using data of the digital equalizer of coherent receivers and show simulation and measurement results from 43 Gb/s transmission data.

articleTitle: Tapered dual-core fiber for efficient and robust coupling to InP photonic integrated circuits
abstract: We demonstrate a tapered dual-core fiber that splices to standard fiber at one end and butt couples to an uncoated InP ridge waveguide at the other, achieving a fiber-to-chip coupling loss of ~1.8 dB.

articleTitle: Reach optimized architecture for multi-rate transport system (ROAMTS): One size does not fit all
abstract: We propose a new system for high-speed optical communication in the metro area. The system is based on the concept one-size does not fit all philosophy for optical networks. Architecture and performance issues are discussed.

articleTitle: Availability-guaranteed connection provisioning with delay tolerance in optical WDM mesh networks
abstract: We propose a novel dynamic provisioning scheme exploiting a new user-centric SLA metric, called delay tolerance, in availability-guaranteed shared-path-protected optical WDM networks. Significant reduction in blocking probability is achieved without sacrificing additional resources.

articleTitle: All-solid G.652.D fiber with ultra low bend losses down to 5 mm bend radius
abstract: We demonstrate the feasibility of all-solid G.652.D fibers that exhibit bend losses 10 times lower than ITU-T recommendation G.657.B and 0.05 dB/turn at 5 mm bend radius at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Multi-wavelength message routing in a non-blocking four-port bidirectional switch fabric for silicon photonic networks-on-chip
abstract: A non-blocking four-port bidirectional multi-wavelength message router for use in 2D mesh or torus photonic networks-on-chip is fully characterized with bit-error-rate measurements and eye diagrams using three parallel 10-Gb/s wavelength channels.

articleTitle: Two-stage overlap frequency domain equalization for long-haul optical systems
abstract: We propose two-stage overlap frequency domain equalization (OFDE) to compensate chromatic dispersion and polarization mode dispersion in practical long-haul optical systems. This paper evaluates the performance of 25-Gb/s coherent optical single-carrier transmission using two-stage OFDE.

articleTitle: A 10 Gb/s burst-mode receiver with automatic reset generation and burst detection for extended reach PONs
abstract: We present a 10 Gb/s burst-mode receiver featuring automatic reset generation. The measured sensitivity is −12.5dBm at a loud/soft ratio of 11.5dB with a guard time of 25.6ns and a short preamble of 23.8ns.

articleTitle: Throughput-cost analysis of optical flow switching
abstract: In this paper, we employ a cost model embodying major sources of capital expenditure (CapEx) to compare the throughput-cost tradeoff offered by optical flow switching to that of more traditional optical network architectures.

articleTitle: Transparent vs. translucent optical network design with mixed line rates
abstract: We propose new design models for mixed-line-rate (MLR) optical networks with no regeneration (transparent) and selective regeneration (translucent). Our results show the interplay between transponder cost and regenerator card cost using mixed line rates.

articleTitle: Polarization insensitive all-optical wavelength conversion of 320 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK data signals
abstract: Polarization insensitive 320 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK single channel wavelength conversion was demonstrated using a Ti:PPLN-waveguide as all-optical wavelength converter in a bidirectional mode of operation. Error free performance of the converted signal was achieved.

articleTitle: No-guard-interval coherent optical OFDM for 100-Gb/s/ch long-haul transmission systems
abstract: We review the no-guard-interval coherent optical orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (CO-OFDM) scheme for 100-Gb/s/ch long-haul optical transmission focusing on system configuration and transmission performance.

articleTitle: Photonics for microwave generation, transmission, and processing
abstract: This paper provides an overview of state-of-art photonic technologies for microwave generation, transmission and processing. Technologies discussed include: low phase noise RF oscillators, high-fidelity fiber-optic links, and applications of photonics to RF filtering and processing.

articleTitle: 40-Gb/s MIMO-OFDM-PON using polarization multiplexing and direct-detection
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate the first 40-Gb/s MIMO-OFDM-PON. Superior performance over 20 km SSMF plus 15 dB attenuation is reported using polarization multiplexing and direct photo-detection, thereby significantly reducing implementation complexity and cost.

articleTitle: Proposal for frame structure of optical channel transport unit employing LDPC codes for 100 Gb/s FEC
abstract: We propose an OTU4V frame structure for 100 Gb/s transport networks using concatenated LDPC(9216,7936) + RS(992,956) codes with soft decision decoding. Example implementation for transponders and the expected performance is discussed.

articleTitle: Interest of an adaptive margin for the Quality of Transmission estimation for lightpath establishment
abstract: We justify a lightpath characteristic dependent margin when estimating the quality of transmission for the establishment of a connection by showing the resulting better prediction accuracy and eventually the reduction of the required transmission resources.

articleTitle: Optical performance monitoring by use of artificial neural networks trained with parameters derived from delay-tap asynchronous sampling
abstract: We demonstrate a technique for optical performance monitoring by simultaneously identifying optical signal-to-noise ratio (OSNR), chromatic dispersion (CD), and polarization mode dispersion (PMD) using artificial neural networks trained with parameters derived from delay-tap asynchronous sampling.

articleTitle: Filtering effects in a spectrum-sliced WDM-PON system using a gain-saturated reflected-SOA
abstract: We have investigated optical filtering-effects when a spectrally-sliced ASE light is injected to a gain-saturated R-SOA. The resulting distortion in the output optical spectrum from an optical pass-band shape of AWG could significantly affect the transmission quality of the WDM-PON.

articleTitle: A class of non-binary regular girth-8 LDPC codes for optical communication channels
abstract: We investigate the feasibility of non-binary, regular LDPC codes for optical transmission. Our results indicate that non-binary codes not only beat their bit-length-matched binary counterparts in performance but also admit 3.26 times less complex decoders.

articleTitle: Field trial investigation of 16-states MLSE equalizer for simultaneous compensation of CD, PMD and SPM
abstract: We investigate 16-states MLSE equalization over buried fibers having CD up to 4480 ps/nm, PMD up to 92 ps and launch powers up to 12 dBm. Results show a superior performance for joint compensation of all distortion effects.

articleTitle: Colorless photonic spectral processor using hybrid guided-wave/free-space optics arrangement and LCoS modulator
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a spectral phase and amplitude modulator with a 100-GHz free-spectral range capable of mitigating signal impairments. The processor achieves 1.8-GHz optical resolution over 80-GHz usable bandwidth, with 557-MHz addressable granularity.

articleTitle: Dual function sensing and multiservice communications radio over fiber network using second harmonic suppression
abstract: A wideband-multiservice RoF DAS with sensing and communications functionality is demonstrated, using an electronic feedforward second-harmonic cancellation scheme to reduce spurious emissions from high power RFID signals.

articleTitle: Linearized Gimbal-less Two-Axis MEMS Mirrors
abstract: Gimbal-less two-axis scanning MEMS mirrors provide ultra low-power and fast optical beam scanning at angles of up to 32deg in both axes, while dissipating less than 1 mW of power. Linearized driving scheme and 4-quadrant addressable electrostatic comb drive design gives nearly linear voltage-angle characteristics. Devices are made entirely of single-crystal silicon, resulting in excellent repeatability and reliability. Mirrors from 1 mm to 4 mm allow users to optimize in their application.

articleTitle: A fast, robust signaling protocol for enabling highly dynamic optical networks
abstract: We have developed a powerful new signaling protocol for highly dynamic optical networks that enables 100 ms setup time, efficient wavelength selection, and efficient wavelength converter usage on both working and shared restoration backup paths.

articleTitle: Cascaded two-modulus algorithm for blind polarization de-multiplexing of 114-Gb/s PDM-8-QAM optical signals
abstract: An 8-QAM optical signal is generated for the first time using a parallel I/Q modulator followed by a phase modulator with binary drive signals. Blind polarization de-multiplexing of 60 and 114-Gb/s PDM-8-QAM signals is demonstrated using a new cascaded two-modulus algorithm.

articleTitle: Testing MPI threshold in bend insensitive fiber using coherent peak-to-peak power method
abstract: We present a low frequency coherent peak-to-peak detection method to evaluate Draka's (BendBright-Elitetrade) new bend insensitive fiber MPI and show that a -30dB maximum threshold is satisfied in simulating all harsh field deployment scenarios.

articleTitle: First demonstration of on-chip wavelength multicasting
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time wavelength multicasting performed in a silicon photonic chip. We investigate multicast number selectivity at 40-Gb/s data rates and evaluate each configuration using BER measurements, establishing immense prospect for scalability.

articleTitle: Multi-gigabit real-time coherent optical OFDM receiver
abstract: We report the first FPGA-based real-time implementation of a multi-gigabit receiver for coherent optical OFDM (CO-OFDM) signal. The basic CO-OFDM signal processing and BER sensitivity performance are evaluated in real-time.

articleTitle: 40-Wavelength channelized tunable optical dispersion compensator with increased bandwidth consisting of arrayed waveguide gratings and liquid crystal on silicon
abstract: We propose a novel configuration for a tunable optical dispersion compensator (TODC) with increased bandwidth. We demonstrate 40-wavelength channelized compensation for 400-ps/nm chromatic dispersion with a 40-GHz bandwidth using the proposed TODC.

articleTitle: Wavelet transform based optical OFDM
abstract: Wavelet transform based OFDM is proposed to increase the dispersion tolerance of optical OFDM. For moderate accumulated dispersion the performance is shown to be comparable with Fourier transform based optical OFDM with 10% cyclic prefix.

articleTitle: Routing and horizon scheduling for time-shift advance reservation
abstract: We introduce an optimal routing and horizon scheduling algorithm for time-shift advance reservation. The proposed algorithm minimizes latency for each request, reduces request blocking, and increases link utilization compared to standard advance reservation approaches.

articleTitle: 10G EPON: Next generation ethernet passive optical networks
abstract: This paper describes and discusses critical technical issues related to the design and implementation of the emerging 10G EPON technology, particularly from system-on-chip perspectives. It also provides guidelines to effectively design the new devices.

articleTitle: Toward tera-sample/s 5-bit all-optical analog-to-digital conversion
abstract: We demonstrate 4-bit analog-to-digital conversion at a sampling rate of 160 GSamples/s using 16-fold optical time-interleaving, and discuss how it is capable of Tera-Sample/s, 5-bit operations.

articleTitle: Bend insensitive fiber for FTTX applications
abstract: FTTH applications require advanced fibers insensitive to stapling and tight bends. We demonstrate resonance-assisted fibers made with standard solid-fiber fabrication, achieving <0.1dB/turn loss down to 3mm fiber bend radius and compatibility with standard SMF.

articleTitle: Novel ultra-wideband photonic signal generation and transmission featuring digital signal processing bit error rate measurements
abstract: We propose the novel generation of photonic ultra-wideband signals using an uncooled DFB laser. For the first time we experimentally demonstrate bit-for-bit DSP BER measurements for transmission of a 781.25Mbit/s photonic UWB signal.

articleTitle: Full-duplex bidirectional transmission at 10 Gbps in WDM PONs with RSOA-based ONU using offset optical filtering and electronic equalization
abstract: Bidirectional full-duplex transmission at 10 Gbps over extended SSMF is demonstrated using a low-bandwidth RSOA (1.5 GHz) in the ONU, assisted by electronic equalization (DFE) and optimum offset filtering at the receiver (OLT) end.

articleTitle: Single-channel 1-Tb/s transmission over 480 km DMF for future terabit ethernet systems
abstract: We present a single-channel 1-Tb/s transmission system based exclusively on semiconductor pulse sources. By using alternating polarization RZ-DQPSK modulation a record transmission length of 480-km dispersion managed fiber is achieved.

articleTitle: Soft decision LSI operating at 32 Gsample/s for LDPC FEC-based optical transmission systems
abstract: We have developed a 2-bit 32 Gsample/s soft decision LSI for low-density parity-check code FEC at 100 Gb/s in 0.13 mum SiGe-BiCMOS which generates confidence bit with 25 mV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</sub> sensitivity.

articleTitle: Low noise InAs/InP quantum dot C-band monolithic multiwavelength lasers for WDM-PONs
abstract: A 50-GHz-spacing C-band multiwavelength laser (MWL) module based on an InAs/InP quantum-dot (QD) Fabry-Perot cavity has been developed for the first time. We have evaluated its system performance to show our QD-MWL potentials for WDM-PONs.

articleTitle: Initial tap setup of constant modulus algorithm for polarization de-multiplexing in optical coherent receivers
abstract: We demonstrate a modified constant modulus algorithm (CMA) for polarization de-multiplexing and equalization. By designing the initial tap values for CMA, degeneration of the two polarization tributaries can be avoided.

articleTitle: Limiting the propagation of intra-channel crosstalk attacks in optical networks through wavelength assignment
abstract: Physical layer attacks in transparent optical networks are a serious security threat to network operation. We propose a novel protection approach based on wavelength assignment which limits the maximal propagation of intra-channel crosstalk attacks.

articleTitle: ROADM network design issues
abstract: ‣ ROADMs have seen widespread deployments in long-haul and metro DWDM networks ‣ Multiple technology options and node configurations lower network cost and increase flexibility ‣ DWDM network design must account for transmission impairments introduced by each ROADM type ‣ 40G transmission through large number of network nodes ‣ Significant improvements in optical specifications of Nx1 WSS ‣ Improved understanding of system performance ‣ ROADM technologies offer new features which benefit 40G/100G with full flexibility in wavelength routing ‣ Control Plane technologies have adapted to incorporate capabilities of and constraints imposed by ROADM elements

articleTitle: Remote detection of fiber fuse propagating in optical fibers
abstract: A novel technique of remotely detecting fiber fuse from the electrical spectrum of backreflected light is proposed and demonstrated. When fuse occurred, a rise in signal level over 50dB was observed for frequencies ranging ~20-500 KHz.

articleTitle: CAPEX and OPEX in Aggregation and Core Networks
abstract: New end-to-end architectures and sophisticated technology combinations are required to provide future cost-efficient networks. This necessitates new modeling approaches of CAPEX and OPEX to jointly optimize the total cost of ownership (TCO), which are introduced.

articleTitle: 400Gb/s hybrid optical switching demonstration combining multi-wavelength OPS and OCS with dynamic resource allocation
abstract: In this paper, we design and implement a hybrid optical switching node combining both multi-wavelength packet and circuit switching, and experimentally demonstrate its feasibility in a 400 Gb/s network testbed.

articleTitle: The demonstration of symmetric 10G-EPON system for coexistence with 1G-EPON
abstract: The 10Gbps-PON system with 10G/1G coexistence capability is one of the most promised systems for next generation optical access networks. We successfully developed 10G-EPON system for coexistence with existing 1G-EPON ONU with 8.46Gbps upstream throughput.

articleTitle: Relation between fiber parameters and polarization changes due to mechanical vibrations
abstract: Relation between fiber parameters and polarization changes due to mechanical vibration was investigated experimentally. We first revealed that smaller MFD non-circularity and fiber spin reduce polarization change and that low PMD fiber is desirable.

articleTitle: Impairment-aware WDM network dimensioning with optimized regenerator placement
abstract: This paper focuses on WDM networks employing selective regeneration and studies jointly the network design and regeneration placement considering the physical network performance. Simulation results show substantial savings in regenerator requirements compared to existing approaches.

articleTitle: Frequency noise characterization of a widely tunable narrow-linewidth DFB laser array source
abstract: Frequency noise measurements have been made on a widely tunable DFB laser array source designed for narrow-linewidth operation. Results show instantaneous linewidths of 90-200 kHz at 30-mW output power over the C-band.

articleTitle: Statistical characterization of bit patterning in SOAs: BER prediction and experimental validation
abstract: We present a novel simulation tool for optical systems employing in-line nonlinear SOAs, able to correctly estimate the bit error rate even in the presence of significant SOA-induced intersymbol interference.

articleTitle: FEC optimization for 10-Gb/s WDM PON implemented by using bandwidth-limited RSOA
abstract: We optimize the FEC code for the 10-Gb/s operation of the bandwidth-limited RSOA. The results show that it is possible to transmit 10-Gb/s signal over 20 km with the optimized FEC code in addition to the electronic equalization and dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Towards real-time implementation of coherent optical communication
abstract: We outline the hardware architecture of coherent optical receivers supporting Gt40 Gb/s data rates and extract constraints for compatible signal processing algorithms. Additionally a chipset layout for a 40 Gb/s digital coherent polarization-multiplexed QPSK receiver is presented.

articleTitle: Demonstration of colorless and directed/directionless ROADMs in router network
abstract: We demonstrate dynamic optical path operation of colorless ROADM and connection switching between routers in a router network. We also evaluate and demonstrate both colorless-directed ROADM and colorless-directionless ROADM in a router network.

Author Keywords: (060.4250) Fiber optics and optical communications. Network

articleTitle: Advanced vapor-phase doping method using chelate precursor for fabrication of rare earth - doped fibers
abstract: Chelate evaporation method for rare earth and aluminum precursor delivery was used for “insitu” MCVD fabrication of large core rare earth-doped optical fiber preforms. Vaporization conditions and device design are discussed. Preform results are analyzed.

articleTitle: 92-Gb/s field trial with ultra-high PMD tolerance of 107-ps DGD
abstract: A field trial shows a 92-Gb/s DS-DP-QPSK channel has much higher PMD tolerance than an ordinary 10.7-Gb/s OOK channel, allowing 100G transport over fiber that could not be used even for 10G.

articleTitle: Fabrication of bismuth-based photonic crystal fiber by stack and draw method
abstract: We have successfully fabricated bismuth-based photonic crystal fiber by a stack and draw method. A redraw process was newly developed to make fine glass capillaries with high accuracy of diameter.

articleTitle: Femtosecond pulses with tunable, high repetition rate generated from a CW laser without mode-locking
abstract: 436-fs Pulses are generated by injecting a 33-ps pulse train, obtained from pulse carving a 1.55-mum CW DFB laser, into a time-lens loop. Largely-tunable repetition rate from 23 MHz to 400 MHz is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Photonic band gap materials
21 Port self wavelength switching of 40 Gb/s spectral-amplitude-encoded DPSK signals
abstract: Ultrafast self-switching of spectral-amplitude-encoded 40 Gb/s DPSK signals is demonstrated for the first time. Switching between 21 ports with 15nm maximum bin separation is achieved using a single correlator based on HNLF and an AWG.

articleTitle: Rayleigh backscattering performance of carrier distributed passive optical networks using of OFDM-QAM signal
abstract: We quantify the performance of OFDM-QAM signal when subjected to the noise produced by the carrier-generated and signal-generated Rayleigh backscattering that are present in the carrier-distributed WDM-PONs.

articleTitle: Optical link performance monitoring using extended link management protocol for transparent optical networks
abstract: We successfully demonstrated intelligent link performance monitoring using extended link management protocol (LMP) in the all-optical network testbed. Multiple link parameters could be dynamically monitored via the GMPLS control plane.

articleTitle: Polarization-mode-dispersion compensator feedback signal for alternate-polarization return-to-zero differential-phase-shift-keying signals
abstract: A novel optical polarization-mode-dispersion compensator (PMDC) feedback signal is proposed for alternate-polarization return-to-zero differential-phase-shift-keying (APol-RZ-DPSK) signals. The effectiveness of the feedback signal is demonstrated with numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Remotely switched OTDR conformance testing at the fiber distribution hub
abstract: Conformance testing is a critical step in ensuring the future quality of a passive optical network. A new automated test procedure couples an optical switch and a hand-held test set to enable significant labor savings.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s uplink traffic transmitter using external optical injection for TDM passive optical networks
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an upgrade solution for 10-Gb/s TDM-PON using four directly-modulated 2.5-Gb/s FP-LDs in each ONU. The performance of the proposed scheme is analyzed, showing its feasibility for the next-generation 10-Gb/s networks.

articleTitle: Genetic-algorithm assisted design of C-band photonic-crystal waveguide interleavers using ring resonators
abstract: We investigate the optimization of C-band photonic-crystal waveguide (PCW) interleavers in different implementations using coupled-resonator optical waveguide (CROW) ring resonators. Genetic algorithms (GAs) are employed to optimize the filters for high transmittivity and flatness.

articleTitle: Performance of a polarization-insensitive all-optical 3R regenerator using cross- and self-phase modulation and offset filtering in a recirculating loop
abstract: Using a recirculating loop, the performance of a polarization-insensitive, wavelength-preserving all-optical 3R regenerator for 10 Gb/s RZ-OOK signals is investigated for regenerator spacings of 80, 160 and 240 km.

articleTitle: Photonic compensation of antenna dispersion and matched filtering of ultrawideband RF waveforms
abstract: We demonstrate broadband antenna dispersion compensation and matched-filtering using microwave photonic filters implemented by optical pulse shaping. We compensate undesirable dispersion to overcome distortion introduced by nonlinear spectral phase and perform matched-filtering for waveform identification.

articleTitle: Proposed model for the effect of Ge-doping on the acoustic properties of silica fibers
abstract: We propose an analytical model for the effects of Ge doping on the longitudinal acoustic modulus and acoustic damping coefficient in silica optical fibers. The model is found to fit extremely well to experimental data.

articleTitle: High-speed photodiode and optical receiver technologies
abstract: Optimization of the material layer design for the modified uni-traveling-carrier photodiode maximizes both bandwidth and efficiency, allowing its application to a wide range of optical receivers. A 350-GHz photomixer and 43-Gbit/s DQPSK receiver are presented.

articleTitle: Omnipresent Ethernet: A novel metro communication system using binary+source routing and Carrier Ethernet
abstract: We present Omnipresent Ethernet - by using binary and source routing embedded in Carrier Ethernet advances as a method for providing end-to-end communication in metro networks. A test-bed is built to showcase triple play applications.

articleTitle: The SECOQC Quantum-Key-Distribution network in Vienna
abstract: We present a prototypic Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) back-bone network, formed by seven QKD-Link devices that connect five subsidiaries of SIEMENS Austria. This highly integrated trusted-repeater type QKD network allows integration of heterogeneous QKD technologies.

articleTitle: A tunable 3D hollow waveguide bragg reflector with giant birefringence and tunable differential group delay
abstract: A tapered-3D-hollow-waveguide Bragg-reflector has been proposed exhibiting a giant-birefringence of 0.01 and an 8.5-psec tuning in differential-group-delay for 3-mm-long compact devices, which can be used for adjustable compensation of polarization-mode-dispersion in optical-fiber-links.

articleTitle: Resource allocation for minimizing response time in grid over optical burst switched networks
abstract: We propose routing and resource allocation algorithms for grid over OBS networks with burst retransmission with the objective of minimizing the response time and maximizing the throughput of grid services.

articleTitle: Multiple channel scheduling algorithms for WDM PONs and OFDMA PONs
abstract: This paper designs multiple channel scheduling algorithms for WDM PONs and OFDMA PONs to allocate upstream bandwidth resource to competing users. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithms obtain higher channel utilization.

articleTitle: Light-mesh: An evolutionary approach to optical packet transport in access networks
abstract: We report achieving optical packet transport using mature off-the-shelf components as an alternative technology to PON called light-mesh. Novel service provisioning algorithm and implementation details are discussed with delay/utilization profiles presented.

articleTitle: 5 GHz 200 Mbit/s radio over polymer fiber link with envelope detection at 650 nm wavelength
abstract: All-optical envelope detection of a 5 GHz 200 Mbit/s modulated RF signal and error free transmission over 50 m POF link is achieved by using a 650 nm RCLED.

articleTitle: Dual-polarization 2×2 IFFT/FFT optical signal processing for 100-Gb/s QPSK-PDM all-optical OFDM
abstract: Dual-polarization operation of all-optical IFFT/FFT elements is demonstrated for the first time employing coupler interferometry. All-optical OFDM transmission at 100-Gb/s for two QPSK-PDM sub-carriers was experimentally performed using two matched 25 G DMZIs and coherent detection.

articleTitle: Optical isolator with SOI waveguide
abstract: An SOI waveguide isolator is fabricated by directly bonding a magneto-optic garnet onto a silicon guiding layer. The isolator works for TM mode based on nonreciprocal phase shift with an isolation ratio of 21 dB.

articleTitle: Optical network design with mixed line rates and multiple modulation formats
abstract: We propose a design method for mixed-line-rate (MLR) optical networks with transceivers employing different modulation formats. Our results demonstrate the tradeoff between a transceiver's cost and its optical reach in overall network design.

articleTitle: Reflectometric measurement of the complete spin profile in randomly birefringent spun fibers
abstract: We report non-invasive OFDR based reflectometric measurements of the complete spin profile in short spun fiber samples. In addition, the spin homogeneity is also verified on longer distance by means of P-OTDR measurements.

articleTitle: All-optical modulation format conversion from NRZ-OOK to RZ-QPSK using integrated SOA Three-Arm-MZI wavelength converter
abstract: We demonstrate an error-free all-optical 2times10.7 Gb/s NRZ-OOK to 10.7 Gsymbol/s RZ-QPSK modulation format conversion using a newly developed integrated SOA three-arm-MZI wavelength converter module.

articleTitle: Nonlinear polarization rotation in a carbon nanotubes deposited D-shaped fiber for widely tunable wavelength conversion
abstract: We demonstrate cross-phase modulation induced nonlinear polarization rotation based wavelength conversion using a carbon nanotubes deposited D-shaped fiber. Wavelength tunable converted signal over C-band is obtained with 2.5-dB power penalty for 10 Gb/s NRZ signal.

articleTitle: Establishment of VLAN tag swapped path on GMPLS controlling wide area layer-2 network
abstract: GMPLS controlled multi-domain end-to-end layer-2 path establishment with VLAN tag swapping is demonstrated. Two kinds of signaling mechanisms to realize tag swapping are implemented on prototype layer-2 switch systems and both mechanisms are evaluated.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of light-forests to serve groupcast sessions in WDM mesh networks
abstract: As WDM technology grows, optical groupcast applications will become widely popular. In this paper we introduce the concept of groupcast routing and wavelength assignment (GC-RWA) and evaluate the performance of light-forests using lightpaths and light-trees.

articleTitle: All-optical up-conversion for 30×7.5Gb/s WDM signals in a 60GHz ROF System
abstract: Polarization-insensitive all-optical up-conversion based on co-polarized pump fourwave mixing (FWM) in highly nonlinear fiber (HNLF) for 30 times 7.5 Gb/s WDM channels in 60 GHz ROF systems has been demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Bandwidth enhancement of semiconductor laser optical phase-lock loops by sideband locking
abstract: We demonstrate the sideband locking of single section DFB semiconductor lasers in heterodyne optical phase-lock loops, eliminating the loop bandwidth limitation imposed by the phase reversal of the frequency modulation response of the lasers.

articleTitle: Feasibility study of adaptive ONU for gigabit optical access networks
abstract: This paper studies the feasibility of the adaptive ONU that can be connected to either Gigabit-Ethernet-based point-to-point or passive-optical-network systems. It clarifies its logical design and its performance as a function of the transmission loss.

articleTitle: Pump to signal RIN transfer in silicon Raman amplifiers
abstract: The pump to signal RIN transfer in chip-scale silicon Raman amplifiers is investigated in the presence of nonlinear losses. Pump RIN frequency components as high as 1.5 GHz will be transferred to the signal.

articleTitle: A 2×2 optical cross-connect switch based on dual-drive silicon microring-resonators with reduced timing jitter and driving voltage
abstract: As a single-ring resonator is used for an optical cross-connect (OXC) switch, a large jitter of 30 ps and a low extinction ratio may occur due to delay and crosstalk. We propose a dual-drive, three-ring OXC, which exhibits a jitter of 8 ps and an extinction ratio of 20 dB.

articleTitle: Crystal-based DPSK and DQPSK demodulators using PBI
abstract: Crystal-based DPSK and DQPSK demodulators using the principle of polarization beam interference(PBI) is theoretically introduced in this paper, the performance of the DPSK demodulator is also measured. What's more, they are both polarization-independent.

articleTitle: Implications of tight optical filtering and the phase ripple of a dispersion compensating fiber Bragg grating on 40-Gb/s DPSK transmission
abstract: For 40-Gb/s NRZ-DPSK and RZ-DPSK transmission, we demonstrate experimentally that tight optical filtering enhances the system degradation caused by the imperfect frequency response of a dispersion compensating fiber Bragg grating.

articleTitle: Demonstration of burst transmission of multiple capacity 10G-PON over OCDMA uplink using hybrid SSFBG encoder / multi-port decoder and 10 Gbps burst-mode receiver
abstract: In a novel 10 G-PON over OCDMA system, 16-ONU (4-OCDMA times 4-packet) uplink burst transmission having four times larger capacity than 10 G-PON is demonstrated by using hybrid SSFBG encoder/multi-port decoder and 10 Gbps burst-mode receiver.

articleTitle: Field-deployed scalable ROADM - Cost reduction through wavelength overprovision
abstract: We describe a field-deployed metro-WDM architecture with any-to-any wavelength connectivity. Through wavelength overprovision, it achieves low initial costs and complete flexibility without employing full ROADMs at every network node, and can be gracefully upgraded to full capacity.

articleTitle: Cost-efficient dragonfly topology for large-scale systems
abstract: Evolving technology and increasing pin-bandwidth motivate the use of high-radix routers to reduce the diameter, latency, and cost of interconnection networks. This migration from low-radix to high-radix routers is demonstrated with the recent introduction of high-radix routers and they are expected to impact networks used in large-scale systems such as multicomputers and data centers. As a result, a scalable and a cost-efficient topology is needed to properly exploit high-radix routers.High-radix networks require longer cables than their low-radix counterparts. Because cables dominate network cost, the number of cables, and particularly the number of long, global cables should be minimized to realize an efficient network. In this paper, we introduce the dragonfly topology which uses a group of high-radix routers as a virtual router to increase the effective radix of the network. With this organization, each minimally routed packet traverses at most one global channel. By reducing global channels, a dragonfly reduces cost by 20% compared to a flattened butterfly and by 52% compared to a folded Clos network in configurations with > 16K nodes. The paper also introduces two new variants of global adaptive routing that enable load-balanced routing in the dragonfly. Each router in a dragonfly must make an adaptive routing decision based on the state of a global channel connected to a different router. Because of the indirect nature of this routing decision, conventional adaptive routing algorithms give degraded performance. We introduce the use of selective virtual-channel discrimination and the use of credit round-trip latency to both sense and signal channel congestion. The combination of these two methods gives throughput and latency that approaches that of an ideal adaptive routing algorithm.

articleTitle: Fiber-wireless networks and microwave photonics subsystem technologies
abstract: •Merging of photonic and radio technologies - Fiber-radio as a last mile solution - Optical networking enables it to be linked to broadband backbone network • Technologies - Overcome impairments in analog photonic links - MUX/DEMUX, OADM for WDM fiber-wireless networks - Cost-effective uplink transport - Opto-electronic interfaces - Integration of baseband wired line transport with radio transport on same platform

articleTitle: 42.8-Gb/s chirp-managed signal transmission over 640-km SSMF with large dispersion tolerance
abstract: High-speed transmission at 42.8 Gb/s over 640-km SMF-28 with dispersion compensation at 1550 nm using a directly modulated chirp-managed laser (CML) has been demonstrated. The large dispersion tolerance has also been probed in this paper.

articleTitle: Electronically tunable microwave frequency generation based on dual-polarization fiber grating laser
abstract: A simple and compact approach for tunable microwave frequency generation based on dual-polarization distributed Bragg reflector fiber laser is demonstrated. The beat tone frequency changes linearly with the voltage applied to piezoelectric transducer.

articleTitle: Sun's project blackbox: A modular approach to high density datacenters
abstract: This article consists of a collection of slides from the author's conference presentation. The complete oral presentation in text form was not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings. Some of the specific areas/topics discussed include: A few Data Center trends; Sun's Project Blackbox; Applications and Challenges; Industry Acceptance; Implications; and the Future.

articleTitle: First demonstration of an As2S3-on-LiNbO3 ring resonator
abstract: A race-track ring resonator with a 600 mum diameter and 25 GHz free spectral range is demonstrated by vertically integrating arsenic-trisulfide (As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) waveguides with Ti-diffused LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> waveguides. Measurements of the TM ring resonator response are presented.

articleTitle: Photolithography of thick photoresist coating in anisotropically etched v-grooves for electrically controlled liquid crystal photonic bandgap fiber devices
abstract: Thick photoresist coating for electrode patterning in anisotropically etched v-grooves is investigated. The photoresist coverage is compared with and without soft baking. Two-step exposure is applied for a complete exposure and minimizing the resolution loss.

articleTitle: A high-speed silicon modulator based on an embedded-ring-resonator structure
abstract: An embedded-ring-based modulator is proposed for 40-Gb/s signal generation, with compact chip-size and enhanced tolerance to cavity loss and fabrication-induced coupling variation. The modulated signal with negative chirp exhibits penalty-free transmission of 6.5 km, with a drive voltage lower by 40%.

articleTitle: High bit rate polymer optical fiber links: Design and demonstration
abstract: For Perfluorinated Polymer Optical Fiber we show that optical coupling, fiber core size selection and receiver design all can be optimized to realize low-cost, high-speed data links. An example 10 Gbps 200 m link is demonstrated.

articleTitle: SerDes chips for 100Gbps dual-polarization DQPSK
abstract: The required features of SerDes chips for 100Gbps Ethernet and OTN optical data transmission are discussed. As a baseline technology for 100Gbps SerDes, 40Gbps DPQSK serializer chip performance is presented.

articleTitle: Ultra-low latency reconfigurable Photonic Network on Chip architecture based on application pattern
