abstract: This paper presents a reconfigurable Photonic Network on Chip architecture and evaluates its ultra-low latency potential. The latency performance simulation shows a 50% decrease compared to static photonic network on chip.

articleTitle: Modal and chromatic dispersions interference in VCSEL and MMF based gigabit ethernet link
abstract: VCSEL spectral width is wide enough to yield significant chromatic dispersion impairments in 10 GbE link longer than 300 m. We demonstrate that chromatic dispersion can be compensated for by the multimodal nature of the VCSEL.

articleTitle: Investigation of nonlinear DPSK fading due to cross-polarization modulation
abstract: We examine nonlinear fading in differential PSK receivers due to cross-phase modulation and determine its relevance in the presence of cross-phase modulation. We find that XPolM does not contribute to the nonlinear penalty.

articleTitle: Behavior-aware user-assignment in hybrid PON planning
abstract: We investigate an efficient user-assignment scheme for planning a hybrid WDM/TDM-PON by exploiting users' behavior, namely the complementary daily traffic profiles of business and residential customers. Our algorithm significantly reduces the number of wavelengths needed.

articleTitle: Optical performance monitoring via slow light enhanced third harmonic generation in silicon photonic crystal waveguides
abstract: We report optical performance monitoring via slow-light enhanced third harmonic generation in a 2D silicon photonic crystal waveguide. We achieve all-optical in-band OSNR monitoring of a 40Gb/s Return-to-Zero signal with significantly better performance than methods based on quadratic response functions.

articleTitle: Service oriented optical network architecture
abstract: A service oriented optical network (SOON) architecture for control plane enabled transport network is described and assessed. The relevant service plane is also described in terms of functional blocks and interfaces.

articleTitle: Brillouin-based random fiber optic delay line
abstract: A continuous-wave light as Brillouin probe is linearly frequency-modulated to determine the location of the delayed pulse signal via stimulated Brillouin scattering. The random ~4-mus continuous tunability is experimentally demonstrated. The pulse distortion is also studied.

articleTitle: Enhanced deep space data return by integrated RF Optical TT&C
abstract: A hybrid RF-Optical TT&C system is described that provides standard operability and deep space mission coverage via slightly downscaled RF means and that replaces mainly the High Gain Antenna and its gimbal by an optical deep space link to transmit science data to Earth.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 8 error-free cascades of 2R NRZ SOAMZI wavelength converter
abstract: We show 8 error-free cascades of a 2R SOA-MZI, 10 Gb/s NRZ wavelength converter. It uses a novel push-pull arrangement with an additional CW signal to differentially bias the MZI SOAs and reduce jitter accumulation.

articleTitle: 1-µm waveband, 10Gbps transmission with a wavelength tunable single-mode selected quantum-dot optical frequency comb laser
abstract: 1-mum waveband, 10 Gbps transmission over 1.5-km single-mode holey fiber is demonstrated with clear eye-openings. A wavelength tunable single-mode selected quantum-dot optical frequency comb laser is utilized as the optical source potentially capable of WDM source.

articleTitle: 60-GHz photonic vector signal generation employing frequency quadrupling scheme for radio-over-fiber link
abstract: A novel 60-GHz photonic millimeter-wave signal generation using a frequency quadrupling technique is proposed for the first time. A 312.5-MSym/s 8-QAM millimeter-wave signal at 60 GHz is demonstrated with negligible penalty following 25-km SMF transmission.

articleTitle: Unrepeatered transmission of 21.4-Gb/s (2×10.7-Gbaud) RZ-DQPSK over 220km of SSMF using heterodyne detection and electrical dispersion compensation
abstract: Unrepeatered transmission of 21.4-Gb/s RZ-DQPSK over 220 km of SSMF using heterodyne detection and electrical dispersion compensation achieving FEC-limit performance in a single-span is reported. The 2-dB CD and DGD tolerance is 577 ps/nm and 29 ps, respectively.

articleTitle: AT&T Optical Transport Services
abstract: AT&T's Optical Transport Services are evolving to OTN-based architectures driven by demand for IP and high capacity Ethernet services, bandwidth on demand, mesh restoration, flexibility and cost reduction.

articleTitle: Dynamic distortion characteristics of silicon evanescent detectors and phase modulators
abstract: The linearity of silicon evanescent modulators and quantum well detectors was measured for the first time. An output IP3 of 21 dBm for detectors and a peak phase input IP3 of 2.6pi for reverse biased phase modulators was achieved at 500 MHz.

articleTitle: Multi-channel polymer optical waveguides with graded-index and W-shaped index profiles
abstract: We demonstrate the advantages of parabolic and W-shaped refractive index profiles formed in the cores of multi-channel polymer optical waveguides: Sufficiently low inter-channel crosstalk (> -30 dB) is achieved in these waveguides with small inter-channel pitch (<80 mum).

articleTitle: Maximizing the revenues for distributed computing applications over WDM networks
abstract: A novel optimization problem of jointly provisioning both network resources and computing resources for distributed computing applications over WDM networks is studied, with the objective being the revenue maximization.

articleTitle: Multi-class flow aggregation for iptv program delivery in multicast optical backbone networks
abstract: Considering security or subscription issues for IPTV program delivery in optical backbone networks, we propose multi-class IP flow aggregation to guarantee that the secured programs are only received by edge nodes which subscribe to them.

articleTitle: A novel LightLabel orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (LL-OFDM) system for cross-layer lightpath monitoring and setup
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate, for the first time, a novel LightLabel OFDM (LL-OFDM) system supporting real-time lightpath tracing and cross-layer lightpath configuration. Simulations show its benefits, including reduced setup latency and lower blocking probability.

articleTitle: Elimination of DWDM transponders over a deployed IP over DWDM network using novel DWDM XFP transceivers with integrated G.709 and Forward Error Correction
abstract: Elimination of DWDM transponders in an IP over DWDM network is demonstrated, for the first time, using DWDM XFP MSA transceivers with integrated G.709 framing for OAM management and Forward Error Correction for performance capabilities.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband (THz) RF spectrum monitoring of high-speed optical signals using a chalcogenide waveguide chip
abstract: An all-optical photonic chip RF spectrum monitor with measurement bandwidth ≫2.5 THz is reported. Using a 16 cm length, highly nonlinear and broadband low dispersive As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> planar rib waveguide, 320 Gb/s optical signals are characterized.

articleTitle: Tunable photonic microwave filter using slow light in vertical cavity surface emitting laser
abstract: A tunable photonic microwave filter using slow light in a VCSEL is proposed and experimentally demonstrated for the first time. Tunable microwave notch filter at 20 GHz can be achieved by adjusting the bias current of VCSEL.

articleTitle: Robust Application Specific and Agile Private (ASAP) networks withstanding multi-layer failures
abstract: A novel robust network design framework supporting critical distributed computing applications over WDM networks is studied, taking into consideration concurrent and multi-layer failures and their impact on a large number of distributed computing applications.

articleTitle: Low power penalty monolithically-cascaded 1550nm-wavelength quantum-dot crossbar switches
abstract: A compact cascaded crossbar element with low power penalty, high distortion threshold and low crosstalk penalty is presented. Dual-stage monolithic switch integration is facilitated using a quantum dot epitaxy at 1550nm wavelength.

articleTitle: 4K uncompressed streaming over multicast-capable 80 (8λ × 10) Gbps colored optical packet switching network using SOA switch and stacked OC-label processing
abstract: We demonstrate a field trial of 4K uncompressed streaming over multicast-capable 80 (8lambda times 10) Gbps colored optical packet switching network using SOA based broadcast-and-select switch and stacked optical-code label processing.

articleTitle: Reversed dispersion slope photonic bandgap fibers and femtosecond pulse propagation
abstract: Reversed dispersion slope PBG fibers are presented around one micron by the introduction of partial reflector layer around the core resulting in a strongly wavelength dependent nonlinear phase shift on the propagating fundamental mode.

articleTitle: Multi-wavelength, 4.32 Gbps UWB radio-over-fiber demonstration featuring a reflective electro-absorption transceiver and low-Cost DWDM grid VCSELs
abstract: We demonstrate multi-wavelength UWB radio-over-fiber transmission with 4.32 Gbps throughput over 26.2 km of fiber using a reflective electro-absorption transceiver. Overall EVMs better than −16.8 dB were measured for three VCSEL wavelengths from 1536.3 nm to 1537.8 nm.

articleTitle: Field trial demonstrating improvement of backbone fiber infrastructure PMD using a random-scrambling POTDR
abstract: The accumulated PMD along several fibers in an optical network were measured in order to identify those short fiber portions exhibiting high PMD. By replacing high-PMD-portion(s) in each fiber, the overall-PMD could be reduced significantly.

articleTitle: Quaternary sequences comparison for the modeling of optical DQPSK dispersion managed transmission systems
abstract: By means of numerical simulations, we test quaternary sequences, pre-coded for a differential logic at the receiver, with respect to their efficiency of properly modeling the performance of DQPSK dispersion-managed transmission systems.

articleTitle: Wavelength path reconfigurable AWG-STAR employing coprime-channel-cycle arrayed-waveguide gratings
abstract: We propose a novel flexible AWG-STAR system that employs two kinds of cyclic-frequency AWGs whose repetition channel numbers are coprime. We demonstrate that we can reconfigure all the wavelength paths in a network independently.

articleTitle: Wideband and reproducible operations of parametric delay-dispersion tuner
abstract: We demonstrate wideband and reproducible operations of the dasiaparametric delay-dispersion tunerpsila. The delay was continuously tunable over 17.3 ns and uniform over 0.9 THz within a precision of 0.8 ps.

articleTitle: Phase preserving wavelength conversion over 6 THz in a silicon coupled resonator optical waveguide
abstract: We demonstrated 6-THz wavelength conversion of a 10 Gbit/s DPSK signal via four-wave-mixing in a silicon coupled resonator optical waveguide. The device provides 16 dB enhancement of the conversion efficiency with negligible phase information distortion.

articleTitle: Multi ASON and GMPLS domains interworking trials for automatically switched Ethernet VLAN path provisioning
abstract: Seamless end-to-end Ethernet VLAN path provisioning over multi ASON and GMPLS network domains is successfully achieved. Two interworking scenarios 1) ASON and GMPLS, 2) GMPLS and GMPLS are confirmed in both control and data planes.

articleTitle: Gain and high speed transmission characteristics of InAs/InP quantum dot Semiconductor Optical Amplifiers
abstract: High performance quantum dot semiconductor optical amplifiers with penalty free transmission of 10 Gb/s signal with gain of -8.2 dB and 40 Gb/s transmission with pattern-effect-free, wide open eye have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Operation of a 25-Gbps direct modulation ridge waveguide MQW-DFB Laser up to 85 °C
abstract: We demonstrated 25-Gbps direct modulation up to 85 degC with a 1.3-mum InGaAlAs RWG-MQW-DFB laser. The dependence of the relaxation oscillation frequency on current was 3.3 GHz/mA<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">frac12</sup> and this is the highest value ever reported.

articleTitle: Optical multi-domain routing
abstract: Optical networks provide a clear opportunity to redesign the multi-domain routing paradigm. This paper reviews the current limitations in multi-domain routing as well as some of the research lines in the optical area.

articleTitle: Optical phase add/drop for format conversion between DQPSK and DPSK
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate an optical phase ldquoadd/droprdquo scheme to enable the format conversion between a 20-Gb/s DQPSK and a 10-Gb/s DPSK. Meanwhile, the incoming DQPSK could be directly forwarded to another wavelength.

articleTitle: Avoiding path-vectors in multi-domain optical networks
abstract: We show that a modified version of a path-vector protocol can drastically reduce the blocking and converge significantly faster, while exchanging less number of routing messages both during failure-free conditions and during a convergence.

articleTitle: Game-theoretic evaluation of a municipality FTTH rollout
abstract: Municipalities are often the driver for an FTTH rollout in Europe, where many traditional operators hesitate. In this paper we look into the economics of such municipality rollout making use of game theory.

articleTitle: A remotely reconfigurable PON architecture for efficient maintenance and protection
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a PON architecture that can be remotely reconfigurable for monitoring and protection from fiber failure/degradation. Protection for fiber failures and OTDR test for preventive maintenance can be done without service disruptions.

articleTitle: Monolithic silicon coherent receiver
abstract: We realized a monolithic polarization-diversity dual-quadrature coherent receiver with on-chip balanced detection in a silicon photonic integrated circuit with integrated germanium detectors. We tested it using a polarization-division multiplexed quadrature phase-shift keyed signal at 112-Gb/s.

articleTitle: Achievement of linearly polarized single-transverse-mode emission from active multimode fiber via multimode interference
abstract: Self-imaging and spectral filtering due to multimode interference are utilized to demonstrate an all-fiber laser with active multimode fiber that generates linearly polarized diffraction limited light.

articleTitle: A new large variable delay optical buffer based on cascaded double loop optical buffers (DLOBs)
abstract: A novel optical buffer bases on cascaded DLOBs is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. This buffer can provide large variable delay range of 1-999 times of the basic delay unit and be dynamically reconfigurable within nanoseconds.

Author Keywords: (060.1810) Buffers, couplers, routers, switches, and multiplexers

articleTitle: Dispersion compensation by SBS based slow-light in an optical fiber
abstract: We present a new scheme to simultaneously delay pulses without broadening and compensate the optical fiber dispersion. Our technique is based on a negative group velocity dispersion achieved by a stimulated Brillouin scattering spectrum control.

articleTitle: Multilayer network resilience
abstract: ▪ We have to deal with multiple layers ▪ Integration of IP and optical networks controlled by a common control plane offers new opportunities and challenges related to survivability ▪ Simple escalation strategies are available ▪ Integrated multilayer recovery seems to be impractical ▪ Dynamic multilayer recovery is very promising

articleTitle: A simple, robust, and wide-range chromatic dispersion monitor in coherent receivers
abstract: We demonstrate a simple, robust and wide-range chromatic dispersion monitor that can be used for 2-stage chromatic dispersion compensation. The performance is validated by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Survivable logical topology design for distributed computing in WDM networks
abstract: We present a MIP formulation and an efficient heuristic for the problem of logical topology design for a distributed computing application to survive one computing cluster failure and one fiber link failure in WDM networks.

articleTitle: Fiber optics, from sensing to non invasive high resolution medical imaging
abstract: Many concepts in optical imaging have initially been developed for Fiber Optic Sensing, Optics Communications or in Laser Physics

articleTitle: Wavelet split-step backward-propagation for efficient post-compensation of WDM transmission impairments
abstract: Wavelet-based filtering in digital backward-propagation is presented for linear and nonlinear impairment compensation. This approach significantly reduces the computational load compared to inverse Fourier-transform filter design due to the finite support of wavelets.

articleTitle: Demonstration of multivendor E-NNI interoperability across a 1000 km production network
abstract: E-NNI allows network to network interconnection between multiple vendors and I-NNI domains in an ASON/GMPLS network. Verizon and participating vendors have demonstrated end-to-end STS-n circuit provisioning across 1000 km in a production network.

articleTitle: Fast amplitude and phase characterization of optical frequency combs propagating over 50 km of optical fiber using dual quadrature spectral interferometry
abstract: We demonstrate fast retrieval(<1.5 mus) of amplitude and phase of optical frequency combs propagating over long lengths of optical fiber(> 50 km) and of user defined pulse shapes representing higher order propagation effects using dual quadrature spectral Interferometry.

articleTitle: Polarisation-independent sub-picosecond flat-top pulse generation for ultra-fast 640 Gbit/s gating
abstract: An 840 fs wide flat-top pulse is generated in a polarisation-independent optical differentiation scheme and used for 640 Gbit/s demultiplexing. The timing jitter tolerance is improved by a factor of three to 310 fs.

articleTitle: Luminescence and laser generation in Bi-doped fibers in a spectral region of 1300–1520 nm
abstract: Optical properties of Bi-doped phosphogermanosilicate fibers were investigated. It was demonstrated that fiber lasers based on fibers of this type can generate radiation in a broad-band range of 1300-1520 nm.

articleTitle: A simple group velocity dispersion measurement method by RF spectral periodic pulse timing variation characterization
abstract: By measuring the dispersion-induced periodic pulse timing variation with a wavelength-swept pulse light source and a RF spectrum analyzer, the fiber group velocity dispersion can be determined with excellent accuracy.

articleTitle: Unidirectionally spun fibers for efficient narrow-band parametric amplification
abstract: Narrow-band optical fiber parametric amplifiers realized by randomly birefringent and unidirectionally spun fibers are numerically studied. Fast spinning reduces random birefringence effects, enhances the gain and reduces gain fluctuations.

articleTitle: Impact of topology and traffic on physical layer monitoring in transparent networks
abstract: The benefit of optical performance monitoring, in terms of addressing the extent of optical transparency, is analyzed with respect to network topology and traffic patterns.

articleTitle: Polarization beamforming MIMO-based PON: 20 Gb/s transmission over a 10 Gb/s system with dynamic power allocation and ∼1.8 dB improved reach
abstract: We report the first experimental demonstration of a low-complexity polarization multiplexing PON architecture, achieving twice the downstream throughput, dynamic power allocation, and improving loss budget up to ~1.8 dB based on MIMO polarization beamforming.

articleTitle: Design of broadband dispersion compensating photonic crystal fibers for high speed transmission systems
abstract: This article presents larger negative dispersion coefficient, better dispersion slope compensation, and low confinement losses in the entire S+C+L telecommunication band based on the finite difference method and applicable for 40 Gb/s transmission systems.

articleTitle: Monitoring of drop optical fibers in 32-branched PON using 1.65 µm pulse-OCDR
abstract: We newly propose 1.65 mum pulse-OCDR with 2.6 cm high spatial resolution, which can monitor reflections from FBGs in drop section of 15 km-feeder 32-branch PON without overlaps of peaks.

articleTitle: Demonstration for delivering of optical DPSK signal in a radio-over-fiber platform based on heterodyne detection
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the wireless transmission of optically generated DPSK signals based on heterodyne detection with high receiver sensitivity. Using this scheme, an approach to deliver two DPSK channels is proposed for FDM application.

articleTitle: Transient performance of ultra-fast AGC-EDFA in 40-channel add/drop operation
abstract: We have achieved a good gain transient performance of an ultra-fast AGC-EDFA in 40-channel add/drop operation owing to the combination of an electrically controlled pump LD and a high-speed VOA.

articleTitle: Effective all-optical RZ-to-NRZ conversion for transparent network gateways
abstract: Cross Gain Compression in Semiconductor Optical Amplifier provides effective RZ-to-NRZ conversion, with the highest obtained pulsewidth increase, from 10 to 100 ps. It allows transmission of the output 10 Gb/s NRZ signal on metro-like links with limited power penalty.

articleTitle: Plug-and-play WDM-PON technologies for future flexible optical access networks
abstract: We present WDM-PON technologies that enable us to achieve the plug-and-play function, which remotely and automatically controls all wavelengths over an optical distribution network. Key technologies are reviewed for constructing future flexible optical access networks.

articleTitle: A Si/SiGe based Impact Ionization Avalanche Transit Time Photodiode with ultra-high gain-bandwidth product (690GHz) for 10-Gb/s fiber communication
abstract: We demonstrate Si/SiGe impact-ionization-avalanche-transit-time photodiodes at 830 nm wavelength. It achieves an ultra-high gain-bandwidth product (690 GHz, 30 GHz bandwidth) with high external efficiency (53.2%) and 10 Gbit/sec eye-opening neither using costly silicon-on-insulator substrate nor integrating with active ICs.

articleTitle: SRLG-aware partitioning for scalability and survivability
abstract: This paper addresses both scalability and survivability issues for large optical networks by suggesting a dynamic and distributed logical partitioning technique based on shared risk groups. Simulation results verify the viability of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Tolerance of 46-Gb/s dual-polarization quadrature-phase shift keyed signals to multiple-path interference
abstract: We measured the tolerance to multiple-path interference (MPI) of a dual-polarization QPSK transceiver with coherent detection and real-time digital signal processing. The MPI-induced Q-penalties with coherent detection were compared to those with direct detection.

articleTitle: Heterodyne Radio over Fiber system with 10 Gbps data rates
abstract: A coherent radio over fiber (RoF) system using unlocked laser sources for frequency translation is investigated. Transmission experiments prove this simple scheme to provide broadband multimedia services with decent bit error rates.

articleTitle: 503 ns, tunable optical delay of 40 Gb/s RZ-OOK and RZ-DPSK using additional λ-conversion for increased delay and reduced residual dispersion
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable optical delay element using wavelength conversion in a highly nonlinear fiber, dispersion compensating fiber, and optical phase conjugation. A continuous delay of up to 503-ns, for RZ-OOK and RZ-DPSK at 40-Gb/s, is demonstrated utilizing an improved method for doubling the relative delay and minimal residual dispersion.

Author Keywords: (230.1150) All-Optical Devices (060.4370) Nonlinear Optics (060.4080) Phase Modulation

articleTitle: 16x2.5 Gbit/s downstream transmission in colorless WDM-PON based on injection-locked fabry-perot laser diode using a single quantum dash mode-locked fabry-perot laser as multi-wavelength seeding source
abstract: Error-free colorless WDM-PON downstream over 25 km for 16 channels with 85 GHz channel spacing is experimentally demonstrated at 2.5 Gbit/s, using an injection-locked Fabry-Perot laser and a quantum dash mode-locked laser as a coherent seeding source.

articleTitle: Compact wireless access nodes for WDM bidirectional radio-over-fiber system based on RSOA
abstract: We demonstrate a RSOA based WDM radio-over-fiber, bidirectional system for wireless access networks. The multi-functionalities of a RSOA, such as colorless operation, re-modulation and envelope detection, make wireless access nodes more compact.

articleTitle: Development of low friction indoor cable
abstract: A low friction indoor cable has been newly developed. As a result of optimizing the designs of outer dimension, sheath material and stiffness, the remarkable improvement of cable installation through a conduit line is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Adjustment-free DxPSK receiver based on single delay interferometer using 120-degree optical hybrid
abstract: We report an adjustment-free DxPSK receiver based on a single delay-interferometer using a 3times3 optical coupler. We experimentally demonstrate wavelength- and polarization-independent detection of DQPSK and D8PSK signals with near quantum-limited sensitivities.

articleTitle: All-optical regeneration for ultra-long fiber links and its prospects for future applications with new modulation formats
abstract: We will discuss all-optical regeneration technologies in ultra-long fiber communication links and investigate prospects for spectrally efficient modulation formats. Future modulation schemes with novel regeneration techniques will also be discussed.

articleTitle: Frame-loss-free line switching method for in-service optical access network using interferometry line length measurement
abstract: This paper proposes a method for the interferometry path length measurement of dualized optical transmission lines with a precision of 1 mm. The frame-loss-free line switching of in-service GE-PON is realized by continuously transferring signals.

articleTitle: On-chip, high-dispersion-value and coupled strip/slotted waveguide structure for efficient dispersion compensation
abstract: We propose a slot-waveguide-based dispersion compensator with a negative dispersion of -181520 ps/nm/km. Dispersion compensation for a 320 Gb/s NRZ signal at 11-km fiber transmission has an eye-opening penalty of 4 dB.

articleTitle: Lossless multistage SOA switch fabric using high capacity monolithic 4×4 SOA circuits
abstract: The first high data-capacity routing in a 3-stage switch using integrated 4times4 QW-SOA circuits is reported. The feasibility of a proof-of-principle 16times16 routing switch is demonstrated for 8lambdatimes10Gb/s operation, with an IPDR of 6dB.

articleTitle: TE-enhanced path selection for QoS provisioning in multi-domain GMPLS networks
abstract: We present a GMPLS-compliant path selection algorithm that supports QoS in multi-domain optical networks. Simulation results show that using TE metrics as the primary path selection criterion is beneficial for networks with long connection durations.

articleTitle: An optical frequency comb generator as a broadband pulse source
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of wavelength tunable, 0.62 ps, near transform-limited pulses at a repetition rate of 20 GHz by combining an ultra-stable optical frequency comb generator with a delay line interferometer.

articleTitle: Fiber nonlinearity compensation for CO-OFDM systems with periodic dispersion maps
abstract: We show that the nonlinear limit of CO-OFDM systems at 100+ Gbps in periodic dispersion maps can be increased by 4 dB using nonlinear precompensation. We also show compensation is beneficial in WDM systems.

articleTitle: High-speed optical signal sampling via temporal magnification
abstract: We demonstrate a novel technique for high-speed characterization of optical signals based on temporal magnification using four-wave mixing in a silicon nanowaveguide. Sampling at 1.3 TS/s is demonstrated with a 5-GHz oscilloscope.

articleTitle: Generation of 40Gbps duobinary signals using an integrated laser Mach-Zehnder modulator
abstract: Generation of 40 Gbps duobinary signals is demonstrated over a wavelength range of 1537 nm - 1569 nm, using the intrinsic EO response of a Mach-Zehnder modulator integrated with a widely tunable laser.

articleTitle: A linear model for nonlinear phase noise induced by cross-phase modulation
abstract: A simplified linear model is developed to predict nonlinear phase noise induced by cross-phase modulation (XPM). The simplified model shows good agreement with experiment and provides various insights on XPM phenomena.

articleTitle: Compensation of the power fluctuations in intensity-based plastic optical fiber sensors
abstract: A new technique to compensate power fluctuations occurring in intensity-based plastic optical fiber sensors is presented. The technique relies on the use of a dual-wavelength transmission over the fiber: two signals at two different wavelengths experience the same environmental perturbations, apart from the sensing region where only one signal is attenuated according to the sensing quantity. Therefore it is possible to use the other as a reference to correct the raw measure. Experimental tests show a nearly perfect compensation of both mechanical and thermal stress over the fiber. This solution is expected to ease the widespread of low-cost plastic optical fiber sensors since it enables to overcome the sensitivity to environmental perturbations while keeping the advantages of intensity-based sensors.

articleTitle: 22.4-Gb/s OFDM transmission over 1000 km SSMF using polarization multiplexing with direct detection
abstract: In this paper, we experimentally demonstrate 22.4-Gb/s optical OFDM transmission over 1000 km SSMF with polarization multiplexing (POLMUX) and direct detection. To the best of our knowledge, this is the longest reach directly-detected POLMUX-OFDM experiment reported.

articleTitle: 10-Gbit/s next-generation coherent QPSK-PON with reduced bandwidth requirements employing linear digital equalization with adaptive algorithm
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 10-Gbit/s coherent QPSK-PON with a reduced bandwidth. Using a linear feed-forward equalizer with an adaptive algorithm, the bandwidth requirement is reduced down to 2.5 GHz with an approximate 0.5-dB power penalty.

articleTitle: Integration and packaging of devices for 100-Gb/s transmission
abstract: Designing high-speed opto-electronic components necessary for 100-Gb/s transmission systems is a challenging undertaking. Methodologies and techniques for designing such components will be discussed, and the advantages of hybrid opto-electronic integration will be explained and demonstrated.

articleTitle: Record-Length 10.7 Gb/s uncompensated transmission experiment over installed fiber using narrow-filtered duobinary and a correlation-sensitive MLSE-Rx
abstract: We carried out an off-line 10.7 Gb/s transmission experiment over installed fiber, using narrow-filtered duobinary and a noise-correlation-sensitive MLSE receiver. We achieved MLSE-systems record distance (1300 km, 2048 states) and record efficiency (800 km, 64 states).

articleTitle: In-situ monitoring of PMD and PDL in a traffic-carrying transatlantic fiber-optic system
abstract: We report the direct monitoring of PMD and PDL in a traffic-carrying transatlantic fibre-optic system (TAT-14). The impact of transmitter polarization scrambling in the measured results is analyzed and verified by the measured results.

articleTitle: Cost-effective radio-over-fiber systems employing phase-modulated downlink and intensity-modulated uplink
abstract: We present a cost-effective radio-over-fiber system employing a phase-modulated downlink and an intensity-modulated uplink over a single optical carrier. We demonstrate a good error vector magnitude performance in both downlink and uplink signal after transmission over a 25-km fiber link.

articleTitle: Experimental analyses of hybrid gigabit TDM-PON and code division multiplexed PON architecture toward next generation access network
abstract: Coexistence trial of TDM and CDM giga-bit passive optical networks (PONs) was successfully completed. A very shallow minimum isolation of 7 dB between G- and CDM-PON at OLT and ONU in the ITU-T G.984.5 enhancement band was demonstrated. The backscattering optical noise does not seriously affect the maximum reach of CDM-PON. Adding the CDM-PON onto GPON can provide following technical and economical impacts: low-cost coexistence, minimum service outage, and combination of best-effort and guaranteed-bandwidth for efficient and high-quality network services due to CDM feature.

articleTitle: Network coding and its implications on optical networking
abstract: Network coding allows for minimum-cost multicast that is fault-tolerant against a link failure. However, it is often possible to achieve the calculated minimum cost without actually performing coding operations at interior nodes.

articleTitle: Ultrabroadband FBG filters using femtosecond pulses
abstract: We report on the writing of ultrabroadband Fiber Bragg Gratings in standard telecom fibers by the use of a highly chirped first-order phase-mask in conjunction with infrared femtosecond pulses. A high reflectivity (99%) and high chirp rate (95 nm/cm) filter providing a wavelength coverage of five telecom bands (E+S+C+L+U) is demonstrated over a single 35 mm long grating obtained following an exposure time of only 30 s in a H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-loaded SMF-28 fiber segment. This report paves the way to the development of new broadband fiber-based optical components with unique features able to provide large bandwidths and low-losses.

articleTitle: Towards a transponder for serial 100 gigabit ethernet using a novel optical SERDES
abstract: A 100 Gbps serial transponder is proposed using off-the-shelf 10 Gbps optics, a novel combining optical SERDES and mature optical logic. Data-center and metro connectivity is simulated validating the preliminary design.

articleTitle: Analysis of fiber dispersion effects on phase modulated signals using constellation diagram
abstract: Effects of CD and first order PMD on the shape of the constellation diagrams of DQPSK systems are presented, and by quantifying variations in the constellation diagrams, a figure of merit is obtained which can be used for computing the amount of dispersion.

articleTitle: Effect of neighboring channels in OSNR monitoring with fractional-bit-delay interferometers
abstract: We characterize the effects of neighboring channels on the accuracy of OSNR monitoring with a fractional-bit-delay Michelson interferometer. We find errors Gt 10 dB when the center channel is flanked by higher-power constant-wave neighbors.

articleTitle: Extremely wide and uniform hysteresis windows (32mA) for integrated optical RAM using novel active MMI-BLD
abstract: Integrated optical RAM showed extremely wide and uniform hysteresis windows of 32 mA plusmn 2 mA (with operation current around 70 mA) using novel active MMI-BLD, with relatively high ON/OFF ratio of 18 dB in 315 times 600 mum<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> total device size.

articleTitle: Flexible and reconfigurable time-domain de-multiplexing of optical signals at 160 Gbit/s
abstract: We present experimental results showing reconfigurable switching of four 40 Gbit/s tributary channels in a 160 Gbit/s data signal using Fourier-domain temporal pulse shaping and a nonlinear optical loop mirror.

Author Keywords: (060.1810) Buffers, couplers, routers, switches, and multiplexers

articleTitle: Synthesis of equalized broadband gain in one-pump fiber-optic parametric amplifiers
abstract: A record continuous-wave one-pump fiber-optic parametric amplifier with a 4-dB equalized gain bandwidth over 140nm was constructed. The importance of employing an accurate dispersion fluctuation map in the synthesis of wideband equalized parametric response was experimentally verified.

articleTitle: Agile photonics architectures enabled by new modulation formats and DSP
abstract: Recent advances in microelectronics have made possible advanced modulation formats, electronic compensation and high-gain FEC. These advances have allowed the commercial introduction of higher bit rate transponders and have also increased the tolerance to channel effects such as filtering and noise. As a result, the requirements on photonic elements and the possible architectures have evolved dramatically.

articleTitle: Comparison of 30 Gbit/s coherent 8PSK single carrier and OFDM multi carrier systems with respect to transmission reach
abstract: We investigated the achievable transmission distance for various OFDM setups in comparison to an 8PSK single carrier system in a single channel scenario. The single carrier system turns out to achieve a longer transmission distance.

articleTitle: Surviving channel power transients in TDM-pumped lumped Raman fiber amplifier
abstract: Experimental and theoretical results of all-optical gain-clamping of wide-band TDM-pumped Raman fiber amplifier consisting of 13 km of DCF counter-directionally pumped by 4 wavelengths optical unit are presented.

articleTitle: Novel 1550 nm vertical external cavity surface-emitting lasers with 2.28 W RT CW output
abstract: A novel 1550 nm optically pumped VECSEL based on wafer fused InAlGaAs/InPAlGaAs/GaAs half cavity shows a high CW output of 2.28 W at room temperature and 250 mW at 75degC.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a novel PON system with distributed real-time bandwidth allocation
abstract: This paper demonstrates a novel distributed control PON system (DCPON). Equipped with a distributed adaptable DBA algorithm that enables real-time precise bandwidth allocation, DCPON achieves high utilization, fairness, low request/response time, and superior service differentiation.

articleTitle: Modulation format transparent subcarrier reuse by feed forward current injection in a reflective SOA
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate remodulation of a 2.4GHz microwave channel by using feed-forward current injection in a reflective-SOA. We tested the scheme with different modulation formats (BPSK, 16-QAM, 64-QAM) at 155Mbaud.

articleTitle: 1.83-µs wavelength-transparent all-optical delay
abstract: We demonstrate a record wavelength-transparent, all-optical delay of 1.83 mus using precise dispersion engineering and triple wavelength conversion. The maximal 3-dB penalty achieved over the entire delay tuning range is the lowest reported impairment to date.

articleTitle: CdSe quantum dots doped optical fiber as a remote current sensor
abstract: A new optical fiber current sensor using a CdSe quantum dots doped optical fiber was demonstrated with large Verdet constant of about 3.86 rad T-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>m-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> at 633 nm for remote sensing upto 40 Amperes.

articleTitle: Stereo multiplexing for direct detected optical communication systems
abstract: We propose a novel technique that allows simultaneous detection of two modulated optical sub-carriers. A proof-of-principle experiment is described and subsequently the performance at high data rates (111Gb/s) is assessed by simulations.

articleTitle: Novel fiber sensor system for dynamic displacement measurement using RF-modulated RSOA
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a dynamic displacement sensor system based on intensity-modulated RSOA and radio-frequency signal measurement. Compared with previous methods, it has important advantages such as low cost, high-speed measurement, and adjustable sensitivity.

articleTitle: Photonic analog-to-digital converters A tutorial
abstract: Each new bit of ADC resolution requires an increase in signal-to-noise-and-distortion ratio (SNDR) of 6 dB • ENOB without noise bandwidth is meaningless • Decreasing the noise bandwidth by a factor of 4 increases ADC resolution by 1 ENOB - e.g. the Tektronix 50 GS/s digital oscilloscope has • 5 ENOB over 16 GHz • 7 ENOB over 1 GHz • Every time you sneeze, you lose a few 1/10's of an ENOB • Optical photons are very energetic compared to RF photons - Shot noise is irrelevant for electronic ADCs - Shot noise is a fundamental limit in photonic ADCs • Photonic ADCs usually contain a microwave photonic link - Standard analysis gives the SNR/CNR - Max ENOB over a given noise bandwidth readily estimated • If commercialized, photonic ADCs will resemble data conversion modules and digital oscilloscopes rather than single chip ADCs

articleTitle: Differentiated quality of protection (QoP) and cross-layer protection for survivable hybrid packet/WDM networks
abstract: We experimentally study how to provide differentiated QoP for hybrid packet/WDM networks by intelligently using survivability from packet layer rerouting, WDM layer protection, or cross-layer protection according to different traffic types and survivability requirements.

articleTitle: Multiple-impairment monitoring technique using optical field detection and asynchronous delay-tap sampling method
abstract: We demonstrate a new monitoring technique based on the homodyne detection and the asynchronous delay-tap sampling method. In principle, the proposed technique can monitor the multiple impairments of the optical signal, regardless of its modulation format, by evaluating both the amplitude and phase distributions.

articleTitle: Analysis on performance deterioration of optical fiber joints with mixture of refractive index matching material and air-filled gaps
abstract: We experimentally investigated the performance of optical fiber joints with a mixture of refractive index matching material and air-filled gaps. We revealed that the insertion loss might deteriorate more than 30 dB at most.

articleTitle: A WDM-PON with 10-Gb/s symmetric bit-rates and multicast overlay with delay-based multicast control
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a WDM-PON with 10-Gb/s IRZ downstream point-to-point signals, 10-Gb/s DPSK downstream multicast signals, and 10-Gb/s NRZ upstream signals. The multicast control is achieved by simple electronic synchronization adjustment.

articleTitle: FWM wavelength conversion with over 60nm of 0dB conversion bandwidth by SBS-suppressed HNLF
abstract: We demonstrated FWM wavelength conversion with maximum conversion efficiency of 1.5 dB using a single CW pump with no phase modulation by SBS-suppressed HNLF. Over 60 nm of conversion bandwidth with over-0 dB conversion efficiency was obtained.

articleTitle: 10-packet-depth, 40 Gb/s optical buffer with a ≪0.5 ns reconfiguration time using 116 ns, Continuously tunable conversion/dispersion delays
abstract: We demonstrate a 40 Gb/s optical buffer utilizing a 116 ns continuously tunable optical delay. 53 byte ATM packets are buffered up to a 10-packet-depth with a reconfiguration time of 25 ps (1 bit-slot). The buffer is capable of adjusting to varying packet sizes, data-rates, and modulation formats.

Author Keywords: (060.1810) Buffers, Couplers, Routers, Switches, and Multiplexers

articleTitle: Demonstration of a novel method for real-time network latency measurements in the optical transport network using G.709 overhead
abstract: Accurate round-trip latency measurements of G.709 encapsulated signals are possible with use of a pattern in the G.709 reserved overhead. The measurements results match well to those obtained with an external test set.

articleTitle: Subcarrier modulation boosts chaotic optical communication systems to error-free performance
abstract: The subcarrier modulation technique is applied in an optical communication system based on chaos data encryption in order to exploit the spectral distribution of the chaotic carrier and provide error-free performance for Gb/s data.

articleTitle: DCF module with low insertion loss, small residual dispersion, and low PMD
abstract: DCF for SSMF with record high figure-of-merit of 450ps/nm/dB and low residual dispersion within ±0.08ps/nm/km in C-band is fabricated after appropriately designed profile. Its DCF module for 80km-long SSMF realizes low insertion loss of 3.6dB.

articleTitle: Optically concatenated 4-fold 40-Gbit/s multicasting, 4-Fold 40-to-160-Gbit/s multiplexing, and 160-to-40-Gbit/s demultiplexing using highly nonlinear fibers
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate concatenated 4-fold 40-Gbit/s signal multicasting, 4-fold 40-to-160-Gbit/s multiplexing and subsequent 160-to-40-Gbit/s demultiplexing based on supercontinuum generation and cross-phase modulation in highly nonlinear fibers. 5–9 dB penalty at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup> BER was observed after the nonlinear processes.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact optical switch based on photonic crystal waveguides
abstract: We outline the prospects for ultrafast modulators based on dispersion-engineered photonic crystal waveguides. Due to the slow light enhancement, devices of 100-200 micrometers length can be realised that operate over a >10 nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous 1.25-Gb/s simultaneous wired and wireless optical transmission using an injection-locking FP-LD
abstract: The radio over fiber system that transmits different data simultaneously for wireless and wired network is proposed. One sideband carrier of a wireless double sideband signal is re-modulated by injection-locking at a Fabry Perot laser diode to generate a wired signal. Because the condition of the injection-locking varies with changes of the input optical power and the injected current of the fabry perot laser diode, the BER performance of the wired signal is measured according to the modulation depth of both the wireless and wired signals. The error free transmission of both the wired signal and the wireless one are achieved after 23-km SSMF.

articleTitle: Tunable high order dispersion compensator for optimized 40Gb/s performance in 50GHz channel spacing
abstract: We analyse the penalty associated with high-order dispersion in concatenated optical filters for 40 Gb/s channels in 50 GHz spacing, and demonstrate a tunable high-order dispersion-compensator to mitigate this penalty. Less than 0.1 dB/ROADM of penalty is demonstrated.

articleTitle: All-optical time domain 160 Gb/s ADD/DROP based on pump depletion and nonlinearities in a single PPLN waveguide
abstract: All-optical time-domain 160Gb/s add/drop scheme based on PPLN waveguide is demonstrated which exploits pump depletion in addition to sum and difference frequency generation. Less than 3.5dB penalty on dropped, survived and added channels is obtained.

articleTitle: Digital coherent detection of subcarrier multiplexed phase modulated radio-over-fibre signals
abstract: Digital coherent detection of multi-channel subcarrier multiplexed optically phase modulated radio-over-fibre signals is experimentally demonstrated. Successful detection after transmission over 40 km long fiber link of five 25 Mbaud BPSK/QPSK subcarrier channels in 5 GHz bandwidth is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Potential for 1550-nm broadband amplification by using different Er3+- doped tellurite fiber structures
abstract: A spectral analysis of two Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>- doped tellurite fiber structures pumped at 980-nm is presented. The samples produced bandwidths in the order of 95 nm around 1550 nm and potential amplification up to 15 dB.

articleTitle: Power Excursion Aware Routing in GMPLS-based WSONs
abstract: A routing scheme is proposed for GMPLS-based WSONs to mitigate the effects of power transients due to WDM link failures. Simulations show that power transients are considerably reduced with negligible degradation of network resource utilization.

articleTitle: Bandwidth reduction via localized peer-to-peer (P2P) video on NG-PON
abstract: Video distribution using P2P that can be localized to within the same access network is examined. With NG-PON, nearly all unicast video could be delivered via localized P2P; lowering core Internet bandwidth by 43%.

articleTitle: Gigahertz quantum key distribution with 1 Mbit/s secure key rate using decoy pulses
abstract: We report the first gigahertz clocked decoy-protocol quantum key distribution (QKD) system, with a record secure key rate of 1.02 Mbit/s over a fibre distance of 20 km and 10.1 kbit/s over 100 km.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of QoS-aware lightpath provisioning mechanism in lambda grid networks
abstract: A QoS-aware lightpath provisioning mechanism is experimentally demonstrated on GMPLS-enabled lambda grid testbed. Experimental results show end-to-end lightpath could be either exclusively occupied by one job or shared among multi-jobs according to user's dynamic requests.

articleTitle: Photonic generation of UWB monocycle pulses using a cascaded semiconductor optical amplifier and electroabsorption modulator
abstract: Photonic generation of ultrawideband monocycle pulses is experimentally demonstrated by using a cascaded semiconductor optical amplifier and electroabsorption modulator. The polarity and the shape of the ultrawideband monocycle pulses can be electrically controlled and optimized.

articleTitle: A novel 60-GHz millimeter-wave over fiber with independent 10-Gbps wired and wireless services on a single wavelength using PolMUX and wavelength-reuse techniques
abstract: A PolMUX 60-GHz MMoF system that simultaneously provides 10-Gbps symmetric independent wired and wireless downstream and wavelength-reuse upstream on same wavelength with high nonlinear tolerance and only 0.2-dB interference penalty is first proposed and demonstrated.

articleTitle: Mixed-polarization to improve dynamic range of optical single sideband in a Mach-Zehnder modulator
abstract: We investigate spur-free dynamic range improvement of linearized optical single sideband Mach-Zehnder modulator using mixed-polarization. The experimental results agree with the theoretical analysis showing an improvement of more than 7 dB.

articleTitle: Operating contours and loss-budget partitioning of SOA-based GPON reach extension
abstract: Operating contours and loss budget partitioning are investigated for semiconductor optical amplifier based GPON reach extension. A link model is constructed to assess means of improving loss budget for enabling flexible network deployment.

articleTitle: All-optical correlation-based bit-pattern recognition with reduced wavelength sensitivity using wavelength conversion
abstract: We demonstrate a method of minimizing the wavelength sensitivity of the all-optical bit-pattern recognition relying on a passive optical correlator. We accomplish all-optical 40-Gb/s, 8-bit pattern recognition with much reduced wavelength sensitivity by combining a wavelength converter front-end and a passive optical correlator.

articleTitle: Effects of multi-path interference (MPI) on the performance of transmission systems using Fabry-Perot lasers and short bend insensitive jumper fibers
abstract: We measured the effects of MPI for systems that include Fabry-Perot lasers and short bend insensitive fibers and analyzed contributions from different factors including both laser and fiber characteristics.

articleTitle: Comparisons on PMD-compensation feedback signals for bit-to-bit alternate-polarization RZ-DPSK
abstract: PMD compensation for 40 Gb/s Apol RZ-DPSK is successfully demonstrated using different feedback methods. Eye-opening feedback exhibits the lowest penalty. Experiments indicate a mean PMD tolerance of 5.3 ps for an outage probability of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>.

articleTitle: Generation of 10 GHz optical pulses with very low timing jitter using one section passively mode locked quantum dash based lasers operating at 1.55 µm
abstract: Using either single-side-band phase noise spectrum or optical cross-correlation, timing jitter of 500 fs integrated from 150 kHz to 320 MHz has been measured from quantum-dash Fabry-Perot mode-locked lasers exhibiting a record low radiofrequency linewidth of ~850 Hz.

articleTitle: Modal gain measurements in a fiber Bragg grating stabilized laser module for erbium-doped fiber amplifiers
abstract: Novel modal gain spectral measurements are presented in an EDFA 980 nm diode laser pump module with a fiber Bragg grating (FBG) that provides wavelength-selective optical feedback. Measurements are shown at several device temperatures and injection currents. Gain clamping is observed at the wavelength of the FBG and the wavelength of the free-running laser, depending on the device current and the spectral detuning between the laser and the FBG. The paper provides key experimental evidence for the basic theory of the locking range.

articleTitle: Global load balancing of Zero-bandwidth TE LSPs in MPLS networks
abstract: An iterative algorithm is proposed to achieve global load balancing of zero-bandwidth TE LSPs. Results show that the proposed algorithm closely approximates the ideal global load balancing result, without resorting to additional routing protocol extensions.

articleTitle: Third order characterization of dispersion compensating gratings for 40Gbps DQPSK transmission systems
abstract: We present a third (and higher) order local dispersion characterization method for quality control of dispersion compensating gratings in 40 Gbps RZ-DQPSK systems with small (< 0.5dB) system penalty margin. Simulation results show that this approach is a simpler and more accurate indicator of system penalty due to group delay ripple, when compared to conventional methods based on phase ripple.

articleTitle: 640-Gbit/s (64-wavelength × 10-Gbit/s) wide-colored and phase-modulated optical packet switching and buffering without packet power compensation
abstract: We demonstrate first 640-Gbit/s (64-wavelength times 10-Gbit/s) DWDM/NRZ-DPSK optical packet switching and buffering with 200-Gchip/s PSK optical label processing for transparent optical packet switch system. Error-free (bit-error-rate<10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>) operation for all 64 DPSK payload-channels is achieved.

articleTitle: 1.5µm polarization entangled photon pair generation based on birefringence in microstructure fibers
abstract: Birefringence in microstructure fiber leads to polarization dependent parametric florescence, which provides a novel scheme for polarization entangled photon pair generation. Its feasibility is demonstrated by two-photon interference measurement with fringes visibilities of >93%.

articleTitle: Bidirectional 1.25-Gbps WDM-PON with broadcasting function based on fabry-perot light source and RSOA
abstract: A novel WDM-PON system delivering bidirectional 1.25-Gbps data and broadcast data is proposed. A subcarrier signal modulates optical carriers of a FP-LD based broadband light source to broadcast to all users. RSOAs are used as modulators for the baseband data in both the OLT and the ONU for a channel. BER and EVM were measured to demonstrate the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A low cost solution for sources and receivers in WDM-PON
abstract: A new architecture for low-cost WDM-PON is proposed, which combines a multi-wavelength CW source with a reflective SOA at 2.5 Gbps, with an optical budget up to 20 dB.

articleTitle: Hybrid access network integrated with multi-level RF vector signal and baseband signal without optical filtering
abstract: Hybrid access network integrated with multi-level wireless vector signal and wireline OOK signal without optical filter is proposed for the first time. 312.5-MSymbol/sec RF 8-PSK signal and 1.25-Gb/sec BB signal are experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Simultaneous PMD mitigation by optically clocked reshaper for two-channel 80-Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK signals
abstract: Simultaneous PMD mitigation by optically clocked reshaper for two-channel 80-Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK signals has been demonstrated using gain saturation effects of optical parametric amplification. The reshaper was applied to mitigate DGD as high as 100 ps.

articleTitle: Integer programming assisted optimization of optical design for transparent WDM networks
abstract: We propose a novel optical design method assisted by integer programming and column generation technologies considering optical characteristics and optical paths distribution in mesh WDM networks. Trial designs showed 14 % cost reduction.

articleTitle: Photonic microwave filter with negative coefficients using fiber optical parametric amplifier
abstract: We proposed and demonstrated a novel approach to implement a photonic microwave filter by using cross-gain modulation in fiber optical parametric amplifier (OPA). Two-tap notch filter and four-tap bandpass filter were successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Phosphorus and aluminum co-doped EDF insensitive to hydrogen exposure for extended L-band amplification
abstract: P/Al co-doped EDF without Ge is fabricated, which exhibits broad gain bandwidth from 1560 to 1620nm. Its loss stability against hydrogen exposure is more than one order of magnitude superior to that of Al/Ge-doped EDF.

articleTitle: Analysis of crosstalk impact on optical packet signals in an optical cross-bar switch by intensity-trimming method
abstract: We investigated optical packet signal distortion due to crosstalk of an optical switch by adopting an intensity trimming technique. Less than -17 dB is required for error-free operation.

Author Keywords: (060.1810) Buffers, couplers, routers, switches, and multiplexers

articleTitle: Transmitter for calibrating extinction ratio measurements of optical receivers
abstract: We describe a transmitter being developed at the National Institute of Standards and Technology for calibrating extinction ratio measurements of optical receivers. Preliminary measurement results are presented, and major uncertainty components are discussed.

articleTitle: Guard-time-free port selection by a LiNbO3 optical switch embedded intensity trimmers for optical packet switching
abstract: Guard-time-free output port switching is demonstrated by using a LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> optical switch possessing rapid response and high extinction ratio. Evaluated maximum power penalty was 1.2 dB for error-free operation of the switch.

Author Keywords: (060.1810) Buffers, couplers, routers, switches, and multiplexers

articleTitle: Hybrid electrically pumped evanescent Si/InGaAsP lasers
abstract: Hybrid Si/InGaAsP Fabry-Perot evanescent lasers are fabricated via wafer bonding. Compared with previous similar devices, the current threshold density, turn-on voltage, output power and slope efficiency are all improved. Images show modal confinement to Silicon.

articleTitle: 107 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK signal transmission over 108 km SMF using optical phase conjugation in an SOA
abstract: We demonstrate 107 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK transmission with dispersion compensation by mid-span spectral inversion. Error free transmission over 108 km SMF was achieved with a sufficient margin to the FEC limit.

articleTitle: System technologies for 100G transport networks
abstract: Networks for 100 Gb/s transport are described including both short-reach and long-haul technologies. Some of the many technology trade-offs are discussed as they pertain to the primary driver: economics.

articleTitle: Multi-card wavelength scheduling in modular optical packet switches
abstract: A two-step scheduler is proposed for input-queued multi-card optical packet switches. First, transmitters on each card are assigned a different wavelength, then for every wavelength a maximal matching is found among all cards.

articleTitle: Bidirectional ROF transmission and signal remodulation using separate optical clock distribution to mitigate signal distortions
abstract: We demonstrate a bidirectional ROF system using a separate optical-clock distribution to mitigate signal-fading and code time-shifting. Error-free signal remodulation using downlink DPSK and uplink OOK was achieved in a 20-km reach ROF system.

articleTitle: All-optical multi-wavelength extinction ratio enhancement via pump-modulated four-wave mixing
abstract: We demonstrate extinction ratio enhancement of 10-Gb/s signals at two different wavelengths using pump-modulated four-wave mixing in a 64-m highly nonlinear, dispersion-flattened photonic crystal fiber. The receiver sensitivities have been improved by over 2.5 dB.

articleTitle: A 1.3-µm lens-integrated horizontal-cavity surface-emitting laser with direct and highly efficient coupling to optical fibers
abstract: A novel 1.3-µm surface-emitting laser integrated with a monolithic InP bulk lens was demonstrated. The laser achieved very narrow far-field angles of around 2° leading to a −2.7 dB direct coupling to a single-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of non-linear threshold of 113Gb/s O-OFDM signals on DCF free transmission links
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally that DCF free transmission increases the non-linear threshold of OFDM signals with high bit rates. Peak power values are flattened due to dispersion. An integrated power value up to 9.5 dBm was observed.

articleTitle: Improvement of PMD tolerance for 110Gb/s pol-mux RZ-DQPSK signal with optical pol-dmux using optical PMD compensation and asymmetric symbol-synchronous chirp
abstract: PMD tolerance of 110Gb/s pol-mux RZ-DQPSK signal with receiver using optical pol-dmux is increased from 7ps to 15ps by adoption of asymmetric symbol-synchronous chirp on the signal and optical PMD compensation.

articleTitle: Highly integrated DQPSK modules for 40 Gb/s transmission
abstract: We demonstrate that increased integration in InP photonic devices can be utilized to support high performance 43 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK transmission and provide additional benefits which include smaller footprint and reduced system-level complexity.

articleTitle: 20 GHz picosecond pulse generation by a 1300nm mode-locked quantum dot master oscillator power amplifier
abstract: An integrated 1300 nm QD mode-locked narrow stripe MOPA is shown to generate 10.5 ps Fourier transform limited pulses at 20 GHz. The pulse train has an average power of 46.4 mW and peak powers exceeding 0.31 W.

articleTitle: Alien wavelength transport: An operational and economic analysis
abstract: A new alien wavelength architecture used in long-haul IP over WDM networks is compared against traditional transponder-based WDM. Operational impact and network economics are provided, showing minimal network benefit.

articleTitle: Joint SPM compensation for inline-dispersion-compensated 112-Gb/s PDM-OFDM transmission
abstract: We show numerically that the nonlinear tolerance of a 112-Gb/s polarization-division-multiplexed coherent optical OFDM signal in inline-dispersion-compensated transmission can be substantially improved by a joint self-phase-modulation compensation scheme, particularly when optimized dispersion maps are used.

articleTitle: Channel allocation to improve bandwidth utilization performance for CDMA-PONs
abstract: This paper describes a novel DBA (Dynamic Bandwidth Allocation) mechanism and evaluation results obtained by simulations and FPGA implementation experiments for CDMA-PONs. It improves non-blocking probability about 10% to 50% compared with a conventional method.

articleTitle: Investigating the forward and backward injections of injection-locked dual optoelectronic oscillators
abstract: An injection-locked optoelectronic oscillator (OEO) is investigated for the effects of simultaneous forward and reverse injections between the master and slave OEOs to find the optimized condition for low phase noise and spurious levels.

articleTitle: High phase linearity, high power handling, InGaAs photodiodes for precise timing applications
abstract: We report an InGaAs p-i-n photodiode with a power-to-phase conversion factor of 5.6 rad/W at 2 V peak RF amplitude at 1 GHz frequency. In comparison, a PIN-TIA photoreceiver demonstrates 44 rad/W phase linearity at 0.44 V peak RF amplitude.

articleTitle: 43-Gb/s NRZ-PDPSK WDM transmission with 50-GHz channel spacing in systems with cascaded wavelength-selective switches
abstract: We investigate the nonlinear robustness of 43-Gb/s NRZ-PDPSK WDM transmission in SMF and NZDSF links with narrow optical filtering introduced by cascaded 50-GHz wavelength-selective switches.

articleTitle: Optical generation, fiber distribution and air transmission for Ultra Wide Band over fiber system
abstract: A system for all-optical generation and distribution of impulse radio UWB signals has been implemented and demonstrated experimentally. Bit error rate measurements at 1.625 Gbps and ldquoover the airrdquo performance is presented.

articleTitle: Managing the convergence of Carrier Ethernet with optical transport
abstract: Carrier Ethernet and Connection-Oriented Packet Switching are being merged with optical technology to form a converged solution involving Packet Optical Transport Platforms. We describe this convergence and the management challenges it introduces.

articleTitle: CDM-technologies for next generation optical access networks
abstract: Code-division-multiplexing (CDM) -technologies for next-generation passive optical networks (PON) is discussed. The PON using CDM are reviewed in the view point of alternative for next generation PON. Architecture of electrical CDM-PON is discussed, and its attractive feature is introduced. Co-existing electrical CDM-PON and G-PON as a potential candidate of next generation optical access network was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Reflection tolerance enhancement of RSOA-based WDM PON by using optical frequency dithering
abstract: We investigate the effectiveness of optical frequency dithering to enhance the reflection tolerance of RSOA-based WDM PONs. We show that the reflection-induced penalty can be substantially reduced in both directions by the same dithering frequency.

articleTitle: 53.5 Gbit/s NRZ-VSB modulation applying a single Mach-Zehnder modulator and transmission over 21 km SSMF with electronic dispersion compensation
abstract: We demonstrate NRZ-VSB modulation at 53.5 Gbit/s applying a dual-drive Mach-Zehnder modulator and compare transmission performance of our VSB-modulated signal with VSB-filtered signals applying electronic dispersion compensation at the receiver.

articleTitle: RF instantaneous frequency measurement system using a polarization-based interferometer
abstract: A simple and cost-effective RF instantaneous frequency measurement system is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. Measurements yield a peak-to-peak frequency error down to 50 MHz for an RF frequency range of 1 to 18 GHz.

articleTitle: All-optical wavelength conversion at 42.7 Gbit/s in a 4 mm long silicon-organic hybrid waveguide
abstract: All-optical wavelength conversion at 42.7 Gbit/s over 18 nm in a passive 4 mm long silicon-organic hybrid waveguide is demonstrated based on four-wave mixing. No patterning effects are observed.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an optical OFDMA metro ring network with dynamic sub-carrier allocation
abstract: We demonstrate a novel optical OFDMA ring network with an adaptive sub-carrier allocation algorithm, which utilizes queuing length and traffic characteristics to effectively support multicasting and real-time traffic flows.

articleTitle: Secure 2.5Gbit/s, 16-ary OCDM block-ciphering with XOR using a single multi-port en/decoder and its transmission experiment with true clock recovery
abstract: Secure 2.5 Gbit/s, 16-ary optical code division multiplexing (OCDM)-based block-ciphering with on-line XOR using a single multi-port optical en/decoder and its 50 km-long fiber transmission with true clock recovery is experimentally demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Routing and scheduling for variable bandwidth advance reservation in elastic applications
abstract: We introduce a heuristic for the routing and scheduling problem in variable bandwidth advance reservation. The proposed heuristic minimizes latency for each request and reduces request blocking significantly compared to traditional circuit switching approaches.

articleTitle: Multiscale sampling for wide dynamic range electro-optic receivers
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel multiscale sampling technique for extending the dynamic range of a phase-modulated analog optical system employing passband signals by 20 dB. Envelope distortion is compensated using digital post-processing.

articleTitle: System degradation by the SPM-induced mean nonlinear phase shift in optical QAM transmission
abstract: Optical QAM transmission inherently suffers from performance degradation caused by different mean nonlinear phase shifts experienced by symbols with different power levels. This paper illustrates this effect and shows possible compensation schemes and their efficiency.

articleTitle: Restoration signaling protocol design for next-generation optical network
abstract: The DARPA CORONET project envisions a next-generation dynamic IP/optical network. We present an optical-layer restoration methodology for CORONET based on an extension of AT&T's ROLEX method.

articleTitle: Using downstream DPSK signal for upstream OOK signal remodulation with RSOA in hybrid WDM-TDM passive optical networks
abstract: We propose a signal remodulation of DPSK downstream and OOK upstream signals using RSOA at the customer side for the hybrid WDM-TDM PONs. Error-free operation was achieved in a 20-km-reach WDM-TDM PONs without dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Fast 40 Gb/s optical packet switching using an all-optical flip-flop based on a single distributed feedback laser
abstract: Fast all-optical switching of 40 Gb/s packets is demonstrated using a single off-the shelf DFB laser as all-optical flip-flop, thus offering a fast (150 ps) and economically viable method to implement a transparent network node.

articleTitle: Homodyne coherent receiver with phase locking to orthogonal-polarisation pilot carrier by optical injection phase lock loop
abstract: Phase locking to an orthogonal-polarisation pilot by an optical injection phase lock loop is demonstrated for the first time, enabling homodyne demodulation of 10 Gb/s BPSK with performance close to the LO-ASE limit (OSNR=6 dB/0.1 nm; BER=10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>).

articleTitle: A novel 50-GHz spaced DWDM 60-GHz millimeter-wave Radio-over-Fiber systems using optical interleaver
abstract: A novel simple technique to realize spectral efficient multi-channel 60-GHz mm-wave radio-over-fiber in a 50-GHz DWDM system using optical interleaver is proposed and experimentally demonstrated with less than 1.8-dB power penalty after 25-km SMF-28.

articleTitle: 5 GHz channel spacing InP-based 32-channel Arrayed-Waveguide Grating
abstract: We realize a 32-channel InP-based Arrayed-Waveguide Grating (AWG) with a 5-GHz channel spacing. The AWG shows approximately 14 dB excess-loss, 9 dB crosstalk, and 21 × 22 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> dimensions.

articleTitle: 640 Gbit/s optical signal processing
abstract: Techniques for 640 Gbit/s generation, demultiplexing, clock recovery, add/drop multiplexing, wavelength conversion, transmission, channel identification and timing jitter tolerant switching is described. Various switching materials are explored, such as HNLF, SOA, chalcogenide, and PPLN.

articleTitle: Programmable UWB waveform generation using FBGs with temperature-controlled apodization
abstract: A state-of-the-art programmable technique for generation of various UWB waveforms based on optical pulse shaping is proposed. By changing the temperature of a FBG in some positions, various pulse shapes are generated.

articleTitle: Novel and flexible WDM NRZ-DPSK system with demultiplexing and demodulation using a single standard AWG
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel NRZ-DPSK-WDM system which can simultaneously demultiplex and demodulate multiple-wavelengths using single commercial AWG for rates between 10 and 40Gb/s. BER results after transmission show the practicality of the system.

articleTitle: Ultra high-speed automatic level controlled optical amplifier with wide dynamic range
abstract: We proposed an ultra high-speed automatic level controlled optical amplifier with wide dynamic range and 110-ns guard time and 20-dB dynamic range for input power is achieved for the first time.

articleTitle: Offset PDM RZ-DPSK for 40 Gb/s long-haul transmission
abstract: We demonstrate a new direct-detection polarization-division-multiplexing modulation scheme without polarization tracking. This scheme reduces sensitivity to depolarization and exhibits less Q-factor fluctuations compared to conventional polarization-division-multiplexing.

articleTitle: Microwave nonlinearities in Ge/Si avalanche photodiodes having a gain-bandwidth product of 300 GHz
abstract: The nonlinearity of a 300 GHz gain bandwidth Separate Absorption Charge Multiplication (SACM) Ge/Si avalanche photodiode was examined experimentally for varying multiplication factors. The maximum second order dynamic range was 84.8 dB⋅Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">½</sup>. The largest third order dynamic range was 101.5 dB⋅Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">⅔</sup>.

articleTitle: Extended reach access network based on aggregation of the G-PON traffic
abstract: We propose to increase the reach and reduce the number of central offices by traffic aggregation of four G-PONs, achieving 10 Gbit/s downstream traffic. Upstream burst mode traffic at 1.25 Gbit/s is converted into continuous mode.

articleTitle: Simultaneous conversion of 40 Gb/s OTDM to 4 × 10 Gb/s WDM signals using a time- and wavelength-interleaved pulsed source
abstract: We demonstrate 40 Gb/s OTDM to 4 times 10 Gb/s WDM conversion by cross-absorption modulation of time- and wavelength-interleaved laser pulses in an electro-absorption modulator. Error-free operation is obtained in all the converted outputs.

articleTitle: Transparency of FWM in SOAs to phase/amplitude and polarization
abstract: We study the real transparency of FWM in SOAs to modulation formats involving phase/amplitude and polarization. 40 Gb/s (NRZ-OOK and NRZ-DPSK) and 80 Gb/s polarization-multiplexed signals are wavelength-converted employing two different polarization-independent schemes. Critical issues are found.

articleTitle: Tunable 6-stage lattice-form Mach-Zehnder interferometer for arbitrary binary code generation at 40 GHz
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable planar lightwave circuit for arbitrary 4-bit binary code generation at 40 GHz. The device is a 6-stage lattice-form Mach-Zehnder interferometer fabricated in silica-on-silicon technology.

articleTitle: 20-km transmission of 40-Gb/s signal using frequency modulated DBR laser
abstract: Using a frequency modulated DBR-LD and an optical filter, error-free transmission of a 40-Gb/s signal over a 0- to 20-km span (non-dispersion-shifted fiber) has been demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Compact ring resonators using conventional waveguides, etched beam splitters and total internal reflection mirrors
abstract: Compact single ring resonator bandstop filters with 11.5 nm free spectral range and 12 dB extinction ratio are demonstrated in GaAs/AlGaAs using weakly guided waveguides, etched beam splitters and total internal reflection mirrors.

articleTitle: High-speed and temperature-insensitive operation in 1.3-µm InAs/GaAs high-density quantum dot lasers
abstract: Temperature-insensitive 10.3-Gb/s operation under fixed driving condition was demonstrated using directly-modulated InAs/GaAs high-density quantum dot lasers, maintaining an Ethernet mask margin of 48 % up to 100degC. 20-Gb/s direct modulation has also been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Improving the filtering tolerance of 42.7-Gb/s partial-DPSK by optimized power imbalance
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel method to further improve the tolerance of 42.7-Gb/s partial-DPSK to tight optical filtering by applying an optimized power imbalance, allowing the signal to pass 20 times 50-GHz filters with < 1 dB penalty.

articleTitle: State of the art Si-based receiver solutions for short reach applications
abstract: We report on the recent progress in Ge/Si receivers which are becoming competitive in performance with their III-V counterparts. In particular, we will focus on pin and avalanche photodetector-based receiver results at 1310 nm.

articleTitle: Word-synchronous linear optical sampling of 40 Gb/s QPSK signals
abstract: We demonstrate word-synchronous measurements of QPSK format 40 Gb/s PRBS signals using linear optical sampling with a precision time-base, which allows us to average waveforms and distinguish between signal distortion and noise in eye diagrams.

Author Keywords: (320:7100) Ultrafast measurements Work of an agency of the US government not subject to copyright

articleTitle: A novel channel estimation method for PDM-OFDM enabling improved tolerance to WDM nonlinearity
abstract: We propose a novel channel estimation method for polarization-division-multiplexed (PDM) OFDM that improves the signal tolerance to nonlinear cross-phase modulation in WDM transmission. The improvement is quantified numerically in a 112-Gb/s PDM-OFDM based WDM system.

articleTitle: RZ to CSRZ format and wavelength conversion with regenerative properties
abstract: A 40 Gb/s all-optical modulation format conversion from return-to-zero (RZ) to carrier suppressed return-to-zero (CSRZ) with simultaneous regenerative wavelength conversion is introduced relaying on a versatile scheme of a single SOA followed by a filter.

articleTitle: 320 Gb/s nonlinear operations based on a PPLN waveguide for optical multiplexing and wavelength conversion
abstract: Limitations and potentials of nonlinearities in PPLN waveguides for ultra-fast all-optical processing have been experimentally investigated. A combination of pump depletion effect and SFG+DFG have been exploited to realize 320Gb/s optical demultiplexing and wavelength conversion.

articleTitle: Electronic mitigation of the filter concatenation effect of low-cost 2.5 Gb/s rated DMLs sources operated at 10 Gb/s
