abstract: We experimentally investigate (using a re-circulating loop) the benefit of electronic equalization in the mitigation of filter concatenation effects for low-cost DML transmitters rated for 2.5 Gb/s but operated at 10 Gb/s, applicable in transparent metro networks.

articleTitle: Generation and transport of independent 2.4 GHz (Wi-Fi), 5.8 GHz (WiMAX), and 60-GHz optical millimeter-wave signals on a single wavelength for converged wireless over fiber access networks
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel optical-wireless system to flexibly offer multiple wireless services on a single wavelength. Independent ultra-high speed data on 2.4-GHz/5.8-GHz/60-GHz bands are successfully transmitted over both fiber and air links.

articleTitle: Full C-band 40-Gbit/s DPSK modulation using lossless InP n-p-i-n Mach-Zehnder modulator monolithically integrated with SOA
abstract: A traveling-wave-electrode InP n-p-i-n Mach-Zehnder modulator monolithically integrated with a semiconductor optical amplifier was developed. Loss-less operation and full C-band 40-Gbit/s DPSK modulation with a low driving voltage of 3 Vpp was successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: On the XPM-induced distortion in DQPSK-OOK and coherent QPSK-OOK hybrid systems
abstract: We prove that the phase estimation process makes coherent QPSK more vulnerable than DQPSK to the XPM induced by 10 G-OOK channels. A novel sensitivity penalty formula is presented and verified against simulations.

articleTitle: High performance PONs based on I-Q modulation of electronic CDMA channels
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time I-Q modulation of two electronic CDMA channels using electronic transversal filters. Two in-quadrature channels with chip rates of 18 Gchip/s show the potential for 40 Gb/s throughput ECDMA PONs.

articleTitle: First demonstration of WDM-enabled all-optical wavelength conversion with a SOA and a 2nd order micro-ring resonator ROADM
abstract: We present the RAWC, the first Ring Resonator Assisted Wavelength Converter employing a SOA and a tunable, Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>-SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> micro-ring resonator ROADM. We demonstrate inverted, non-inverted and WDM-enabled wavelength conversion with low power penalties.

articleTitle: Rerouting of 1+1 optical channels: Cost benefits for incrementally planned networks
abstract: Re-optimizing 1+1 protected networks for multiple time periods can lead to cost benefits. We show these cost reductions for a topology and a demand scenario applying traffic affecting and unaffecting rerouting of optical channels.

articleTitle: 1.28 Terabit/s (32×40 Gbit/s) WDM transmission over a double-pass free space optical link
abstract: 1.28 Terabit/s (32×40 Gbit/s) is transmitted over a double pass free space optical link between two buildings (2×210m), transparently connected to optical fibers. Limited penalty on all 40 Gbit/s channels and high stability is obtained.

articleTitle: Low-driving-current high-speed direct modulation up to 40 Gb/s using 1.3-μm semi-insulating buried-heterostructure AlGaInAs-MQW distributed reflector (DR) lasers
abstract: 1.3-mum semi-insulating buried-heterostructure AlGaInAs-MQW distributed reflector lasers have shown very high slope value of relaxation oscillation frequency of 4.0 GHz/mA<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">frac12</sup>. 25- and 40-Gb/s direct modulation has been achieved with low driving current.

articleTitle: Equalization of FBG-induced group-delay ripples penalties using a coherent receiver and digital signal processing
abstract: We show the mitigation of fiber Bragg gratings induced group delay ripple penalties through the use of coherent detection and electronic equalizer. For 111-Gb/s POLMUX-RZ-DQPSK only a negligible penalty is observed after 10 cascaded FBGs.

articleTitle: 160-Gb/s OTDM de-multiplexing based on a pulsed pump optical parametric amplifier
abstract: We report the experimental demonstration of pulsed pump optical parametric amplifier for all-optical time de-multiplexing of 160-Gb/s signals. 14.5-dB of conversion gain with less than 2-dB power penalty were achieved for de-multiplexed sixteen 10-Gb/s tributaries.

articleTitle: The world's first InP 8×8 monolithic tunable optical router (MOTOR) operating at 40 Gbps line rate per port
abstract: We demonstrate the first InP monolithic tunable optical router with error-free 40 Gbps operation per port. The device has eight wavelength converters and an 8 times 8 arrayed-waveguide grating router, yielding more than 200 on-chip functional elements.

articleTitle: Secure OCDM-based PON
abstract: Different optical encryption schemes for secure PON and VPN systems are discussed and their confidentiality evaluated, within an accurate cryptanalysis framework. We consider both optical bit- and block-ciphering, and quantum-noise data protection.

articleTitle: Impact of OBS and TCP parameters on instantaneous behavior of TCP congestion window on LOBS network testbed
abstract: Impact of OBS and TCP parameters on instantaneous behavior (fluctuations) of TCP cwnd is evaluated on LOBS Testbed. Experimental and simulation results show that cwnd fluctuations can be reduced by tuning OBS and TCP parameters.

articleTitle: Fiber optic synchronisation architecture for high precision GPS applications
abstract: We propose a GPS-over-fiber solution that allows relative delay monitoring with millimetric precision and uplink transmission of down-converted GPS signal. Experimentations with directly modulated semiconductor devices show that it is suitable for high precision measurements.

articleTitle: Simple and precise chromatic dispersion measurement using sinusoidally phase-modulated CW light
abstract: A novel chromatic dispersion measurement technique using a sinusoidally phase-modulated CW light is described. We utilize the fact that the phase to intensity modulation conversion induced by the dispersion disappears at specific phase modulation frequencies.

articleTitle: Efficient multicast bandwidth allocation in TDM-WDM PONs
abstract: We consider multicast video distribution in TDM-WDM PONs assuming that ONUs can tune to at most one wavelength and request multiple video streams. We study the receivers' allocation to WDM channels minimizing video streams duplications.

articleTitle: Design and development of optical grid over wavelength switched optical network
abstract: We design and develop optical grid over wavelength switched optical network, both of which are controlled in a distributed fashion. We address the overview and show experiment of optical grid via JGN2plus' optical fiber testbed.

articleTitle: Performance comparison of DPSK, P-DPSK, RZ-DQPSK and coherent PDM-QPSK at 40Gb/s over a terrestrial link
abstract: DPSK, P-DPSK, RZ-DQPSK and coherent PDM-QPSK are compared over the same testbed by sending a 40Gb/s channel, either surrounded by 10Gb/s legacy or 40Gb/s channels. DPSK and P-DPSK are most the robust to nonlinear effects.

articleTitle: Photonic-enabled microwave and terahertz communication systems
abstract: An optical heterodyne technique for generating millimetre-wave and THz carriers with high spectral purity and low phase noise is described, for application to Gb/s wireless communications systems. Progress on key integrated optical components is reported.

articleTitle: Slice provisioning in a virtualized optical substrate network with programmable routers and ROADMs
abstract: A specific problem of creating virtual networks on demand in an optical substrate network with programmable routers and ROADMs is investigated. The formulation of the problem together with a heuristic algorithm as a solution is presented.

articleTitle: Fiber beat length estimates via polarization measurements of stimulated Brillouin scattering amplified signals
abstract: Simple, continuous wave based beat length measurement technique is proposed, using statistics of the states of polarization of stimulated Brillouin scattering amplified signals. Polarization statistics are studied analytically, numerically and experimentally.

articleTitle: 90-km single-mode fiber transmission of 10-Gb/s multimode VCSELs under optical injection locking
abstract: Adjustable chirp is achieved in injection-locked, 10-Gb/s directly modulated, multimode 1.55-mum VCSELs for the first time, leading to 90times increase in standard single-mode fiber transmission distance to 90 km.

articleTitle: Tunable GPON receivers enable phased migration to 1Gb/s per subscriber
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable receiver with -30 dBm sensitivity at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> BER on any of seven 100 GHz spaced channels, and propose deployment strategies for low-cost migration to up to 1 Gb/s per subscriber downstream wavelength-agile PON.

articleTitle: Amorphous waveguides for high index photonic circuitry
abstract: Photonic wires, channel and rib waveguides as well as tapers were fabricated with amorphous silicon showing low propagation loss. Material analysis and RTA was carried out in order to tune the refractive index post deposition.

articleTitle: The impact of LED transfer function nonlinearity on high-speed optical wireless communications based on discrete-multitone modulation
abstract: The nonlinear dependence of the optical power from white LEDs on the applied driving current and its impact on discrete-multitone modulation was investigated by use of numerical simulations for the case of optical wireless communications.

articleTitle: Synchronous homodyne detection of 42.8Gb/s NRZ-ASK using standard DFB lasers
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate synchronous demodulation of 42.8 Gbaud using an analog optical phase-locked loop and COTS DFB lasers having an aggregate linewidth of 2 MHz. OSNR and CD tolerance are measured.

articleTitle: Demonstration of lightpath labeling technique for multi-channel DPSK signals
abstract: We successfully demonstrate a digital lightpath labeling technique, LightLabel, for multi-channel DPSK signals. Labels encoded into 10Gb/s streams were received by a single delay interferometer and a single low-speed photo-detector shared among all 32 wavelengths.

articleTitle: Optical communication challenges for a future internet design
abstract: This talk challenges the optical research community to explore more secure, robust, and flexible future networks and consider how advances in technology and systems could impact future Internet designs, unconstrained by the current Internet.

articleTitle: Design, performance evaluation and energy efficiency of optical core networks based on the CANON architecture
abstract: We demonstrate a way to apply dynamic networking based on node clustering in real-life core networks and achieve superior performance compared to conventional burst switching techniques in terms of blocking, resource utilization and power consumption.

articleTitle: Monolithic 90° ehybrid -with balanced PIN photodiodes for 100 Gbit/s PM-QPSK receiver applications
abstract: A monolithically integrated InP 90deg hybrid with waveguide PIN-photodiodes is presented. Stable performance was achieved over a wavelength range from 1520 nm to 1570 nm and a temperature range from 0degC to 75degC.

articleTitle: Micrometer-scale optical up-converter using a resonance-split silicon microring resonator in radio over fiber systems
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel micrometer-scale optical up-converter for converting 1-Gb/s data to 40-GHz milimeter-wave. This scheme utilizes the free-carrier dispersion effect in a resonance-split silicon microring resonator.

articleTitle: All-optical balanced detection system with sub-ps resolution
abstract: We demonstrate a dual-channel all-optical sampling system that simultaneously samples the two output ports from a DPSK demodulator. The two channels are combined to perform balanced detection with sub-ps resolution.

articleTitle: Risk assessment in SLA-based WDM backbone networks
abstract: We propose a novel method to assess SLA violation risk for service provisioning in a WDM backbone network. Our study reveals the important parameters and advocates comprehensive evaluation (beyond path availability) for service provisioning.

articleTitle: Ultimate-low-power-consumption, polarization-independent, and high-speed polymer Mach-Zehnder thermo-optic switch
abstract: We demonstrate a compact, ultimate-low-power-consumption, polarization-independent, and high-speed polymer Mach-Zehnder 2times2 photonic switch. Our thermo-optic switch operates with less than 4mW of power consumption via a small-area heater, which is, to our best knowledge, the lowest value of its switch type reported to date. The polarization independent switching crosstalk is less than -25dB while the switching rise and fall times obtained are 90mus and 160mus, respectively.

articleTitle: Field trial of 43-Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK transmission in aerial fiber with rapidly changing SOP
abstract: We use long-term SOP measurements to assess the characteristic of SOP change in aerial fiber. We demonstrate field transmission of 43-Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK signals in aerial fiber with rapidly changing SOP; the results confirm stable transmission.

articleTitle: Field-modulated packet forwarding chips for label-switched optical routing
abstract: We demonstrate a single-chip 40 Gb/s wavelength converter based on an SG-DBR laser and field-modulated optical gate. This device also performs 10 Gb/s label encoding for all-optical packet forwarding.

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive delay-asymmetric nonlinear loop mirror for variable bit-rate DPSK demodulation
abstract: We demonstrate a polarization-insensitive delay-asymmetric nonlinear loop mirror for DPSK demodulation at variable bit-rates. The output power variation has been suppressed to below 0.35 dB for arbitrary input signal polarization states.

articleTitle: Optical WDM regeneration: Status and future prospects
abstract: Principles of 2R all-optical regeneration in the context of multi-channel operation are presented. Existing fiber-based solutions are reviewed both in terms of implementation issues and performance.

articleTitle: Gain enhancement by ASE suppression in Er-doped all-solid microstructured fiber
abstract: An Er-doped all-solid microstructured fiber with an enhanced gain of 1.8 dB at 1.60 mum is successfully demonstrated by introducing the high-index periodic structure to filter out the ASE shorter than 1.56 mum.

articleTitle: 4-bit all-optical buffer memory with shift register function using polarization bistable VCSELs
abstract: We have demonstrated a 4-bit all-optical buffer memory with shift register function using four 1.55-mum polarization bistable VCSELs for the first time. This buffer memory is constructed by parallel connected two sets of shift-register memory.

Author Keywords: (060.1810) Buffers, couplers, routers, switches, and multiplexers

articleTitle: Cross-layer reconfiguration for surviving multiple-link failures in backbone networks
abstract: Fast-reroute adequately addresses single-link failures, but is less effective for multiple failures frequently occurring in backbone networks. We study a protocol to reconfigure impacted backup paths after a link failure, improving survivability from a subsequent failure.

Author Keywords: (060.4250) Fiber optics and optical communications, Networks

articleTitle: Polarization-sensitive linear optical sampling for characterization of NRZ polarization-multiplexed QPSK
abstract: We describe polarization-sensitive phase-referenced linear optical sampling for measuring polarization, amplitude, and phase of a high speed optical waveform. With a single measurement, we simultaneously measure both orthogonal polarization channels of 2 times 10 GB/s polarization-multiplexed QPSK.

articleTitle: Transmitter PIC for 10-channel × 40Gb/s per channel polarization-multiplexed RZ-DQPSK modulation
abstract: We report the first demonstration of a large-scale InP-based transmitter photonic integrated circuit (PIC) capable of 10-channel times 40 Gb/s per wavelength polarization-multiplexed RZ-DQPSK modulation.

articleTitle: Origin of the gain-bandwidth-product enhancement in separate-absorption-charge-multiplication Ge/Si avalanche photodiodes
abstract: A separate-absorption-charge-multiplication Ge/Si avalanche photodiode with very high gain-bandwidth-product over 800GHz is reported. The origin of this dramatically high value is explained using well consentient measurement and simulation results.

articleTitle: All-optical WDM subcarrier modulator for binary phase shift keying (BPSK) with optical SSB format using a phase modulator loop mirror filter
abstract: A photonic subcarrier BPSK modulator with optical SSB format is proposed based on a frequency discriminator using a phase modulator loop mirror filter. The generation of 18-GHz WDM subcarrier conveying BPSK signal is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Ultra high definition media over optical networks (CineGrid)
abstract: This article consists of a collection of slides from the author's conference presentation. The complete oral presentation in text form was not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings. Some of the specific areas/topics discussed include: 1. Use cases CineGrid & Networks. 2. Formats - Numbers - Bits. 3. Global Lambda Integrated Facility. 4. A LightPath. 5. Transport Protocol issues. 6. End System Issues. 7. Network Storage.

articleTitle: Operating points for low-density parity-check codes in on-off keyed fiber-optic transmission systems
abstract: We consider the rate/distance tradeoff for LDPC-coded OOK systems under soft-decision iterative decoding. Below 6000 km, EXIT-chart optimized irregular LDPC codes outperform systems that use a nonlinearity-reducing constrained inner code.

articleTitle: Multi-point-to-multi-point Ethernet over SONET/SDH
abstract: This article looks at extended multipoint-to-multipoint Ethernet over SONET/SDH (EoS) service offerings. A novel scheme is presented based upon a tiered protection approach and results from a sample performance evaluation study are also presented.

articleTitle: Isolator-less optically injection-locked 1.55-µm vcsels for upstream transmitters in WDM-PONs
abstract: An optically injection-locked 1.55 mum VCSEL is demonstrated for use as an isolator-free, low-cost, directly modulated upstream transmitter in a WDM-PON where the injection-locking light is supplied by a modulated downstream signal.

articleTitle: A 9b10b line code for 2.5Gb/s upstream PONs
abstract: We propose a novel 9b10b line code suitable for the XG-PON1 2.5Gb/s upstream. It provides a good balance of line conditioning and efficiency. We show that this line code outperforms the scrambled NRZ code.

articleTitle: Tunable dispersion slope compensator using two chirped FBGs mounted linearly and quadratically, respectively on S-shape plate
abstract: We propose a novel method for tunable dispersion slope compensation using two chirped fiber Bragg gratings (CFBGs) mounted linearly and quadratically, respectively on each surface of a metal plate.

articleTitle: Multi-core holey fibers for the long-distance (≫100 km) ultra large capacity transmission
abstract: Novel holey fibers with 7 cores and ultra wide transmission bandwidth over 500-1700 nm have been developed. By optimizing the core intervals, the transmission capability more than 100 km can be realized.

articleTitle: 1.3 / 1.5 µm QD-SOAs for WDM/TDM GPON with extended reach and large upstream / downstream dynamic range
abstract: GPONs with extended reach require 1.3 mum and 1.5 mum amplifiers for up and downstream, respectively. Burst-mode compatibility and largest possible input power dynamics are necessary. We show that latest-generation QD-SOAs fulfill these demanding specifications.

articleTitle: Using holistic methodology to build scalable networks
abstract: The scalability of routers is an issue when the traffic increases exponentially. We use holistic methodology to integrate the optical and packet layer capabilities. Analysis shows it is a scalable, power-efficient and cost-effective solution.

articleTitle: Dispersion-tolerant 40Gb/s field trial over an installed 10 Gb/s WDM 752 km link using multi-carrier technique
abstract: A 40Gb/s field trial using 12.5GHz-spaced multi-carrier 10Gb/s signals over an installed 752km WDM-link was successfully completed. Results show that the system has a superior CD and similar PMD tolerance compared to typical 10Gb/s systems.

articleTitle: Multicasting at 10 Gb/s and 40 GHz using a hybrid integrated SOA Mach-Zehnder interferometer
abstract: We present experimental results on multicasting of one-to-six 10 Gb/s NRZ signals and one-to two 40 Gb/s RZ signals using a hybrid integrated SOA-MZI.

articleTitle: Fundamental limits of signal processing in optical communications
abstract: We discuss the use and the interpretation of the information rate as a performance evaluation tool for optical communication systems. In particular, we obtain insights on the impact of the receiver structure on the ultimate achievable performance limits.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s uncooled dilute-nitride optical transmitters operating at 1.3 µm
abstract: Dilute-nitride lasers with record performances have been used to build uncooled transceivers and failure free 10 Gb/s optical transmission was achieved over 815 m of multimode Corning InfiniCor fiber under the LRM standard.

articleTitle: Compact integrated 100 Gb/s optical modulators using hybrid assembly technique with silica-based PLCs and LiNbO3 devices
abstract: We have developed compact integrated 100 Gb/s optical modulators by using arrayed optical phase modulators with an LN waveguide and two PLCs with various passive waveguides. These modulators exhibited excellent performance.

articleTitle: Optofluidic assembly of InGaAsP microdisk lasers on Si photonic circuits with submicron alignment accuracy
abstract: We demonstrate optofluidic assembly of pre-fabricated InGaAsP microdisk lasers (6 mum diameter, 200 nm thickness) on silicon photonic circuits with sub-micron alignment accuracy. The laser output is successfully coupled to the integrated silicon waveguide.

articleTitle: Dual-concentric-core photonic crystal fiber with −5400ps/nm/km Dispersion Coefficient
abstract: We present the design and measured results of the highest dispersion value from photonic crystal fibers reported so far. The dual core photonic crystal fiber exhibits chromatic dispersion value of about -5400 ps/nm/km around 1.56 mum.

articleTitle: Guided mode gain competition in Yb-doped rod-type photonic crystal fibers
abstract: The gain competition among the guided modes in Yb-doped rod-type photonic crystal fibers with a low refractive index core is investigated with a spatial model to demonstrate the fiber effective single-mode behaviour.

articleTitle: Improvement of multiplicity in flexible signal bit rate OCDM system using noise reduction circuits
abstract: The noises in the flexible OCDM system were reduced using the electric noise reduction circuits and the EAM optical gate by operating with the short pulse generating circuit. The BERs are improved by approximately 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>.

articleTitle: Remote measurements of lengths by excess-fraction method using optical fiber networks and tandem interferometer
abstract: Practical lengths are remotely measured by excess fraction method using a tandem low-coherence interferometer through optical fiber networks. Interference fringes of high S/N are generated when the path difference between two interferometers is equal.

articleTitle: Multi-period PM-NOLM with dynamic counter-propagating effects compensation for 5-bit all-optical analog-to-digital conversion
abstract: We propose a dynamic compensation scheme of counter-propagating effect using PM-NOLM, and demonstrate a truly dynamic 8-period input/output optical transfer function, usable for 5-bit quantizing and encoding, a crucial number for the front-end of DSP.

articleTitle: Network design and architectures for highly dynamic next-generation IP-over-optical long distance networks
abstract: We present initial network architectures and capacity-efficient design for an IP/Optical network with highly dynamic IP and wavelength services, restoration against up to 3 failures, and aggregate traffic levels that represent a 10-fold increase over today's network traffic.

articleTitle: Single phase-shifted fiber Bragg grating as an all-optical Hilbert transformer
abstract: We propose and numerically demonstrate a simple all-optical Hilbert transformer design based on a specially-apodized fiber Bragg grating (FBG) with a single pi phase shift, providing operation bandwidths up to a few hundreds of GHz.

articleTitle: Recent advances in long wavelength quantum dot lasers and amplifiers
abstract: We demonstrate 1.55-mum InAs/InGaAsP/InP (100) quantum dot (QD) shallow and deep etched Fabry-Perot and ring lasers, micro-ring lasers, mode-locked lasers, Butt-joint integrated lasers, polarization control of gain, and wavelength conversion in QD amplifiers.

articleTitle: Temperature-stable 10.3-Gb/s operation of 1.3-µm quantum-dot DFB lasers with GaInP/GaAs gratings
abstract: Temperature-stable operation of 1.3-mum quantum-dot DFB lasers with anti-reflection coated facets was realized by utilizing GaInP/GaAs gratings. A 10.3-Gb/s modulation under fixed driving conditions was achieved between 15degC and 70degC.

articleTitle: New passive optical technologies enabling faster, lower cost MDU installations
abstract: New optical fiber, cable, and connecting technologies can significantly reduce MDU optical cabling system installation labor and materials. Recent innovations can help reduce installed costs up to 65% and speed deployment up to 500%.

articleTitle: In-band wavelength conversion of 16×114-Gbps polarization multiplexed RZ-8PSK signals with digital coherent detection
abstract: By employing a co-polarized pump scheme, we achieve polarization-insensitive inband wavelength conversion in high-speed 16times114-Gbps polarization-multiplexed return-to-zero octaphase-shift keying (PolMux-RZ-8PSK).

articleTitle: Service-oriented multi-granular optical network testbed
abstract: This paper presents a service-oriented multi-granular multi-format network demonstrator. Service-oriented wavelength and sub-wavelengthnetwork connection establishment is being demonstrated by utilising SOON-JIT protocols to support VoD HD and Quad-HD multi-media applications.

articleTitle: Hi-Fi All-optical continuously tunable delay with a high linear-chirp-rate fiber Bragg grating based on four-wave mixing in a highly-nonlinear photonic crystal fiber
abstract: A configuration for hi-fi all-optical tunable delay based on high chirp-rate grating and four-wave mixing in a highly-nonlinear photonic crystal fiber is proposed. 8 times pulse width with broaden ratio of 2.08% are achieved.

articleTitle: A simple and accurate approach for estimating the transmission performance of adaptively modulated optical OFDM signals over IMDD MMF links
abstract: Statistical investigations show that 3-dB optical bandwidths of multimode fibres are sufficiently accurate for estimating the transmission performance of IMDD adaptively modulated optical OFDM signals, with <6% (<17%) relative standard deviations in loss- (modal-dispersion)- dominant regions.

articleTitle: Bandwidth-variable bandpass filter based on dispersion engineered tapered fiber with external polymer cladding
abstract: A simple thermo-optic bandwidth-variable fiber-based bandpass filter is demonstrated by using a tapered standard single mode fiber covered with a dispersive polymer layer. The 3 dB spectral bandwidth can be tuned from 250 nm with a Gaussian shape to 500 nm with a flat-top shape.

articleTitle: The influence of continuous-wave and modulated interference on incoherent spectral codes
abstract: We show, for the first time, simulation and experimental results on the resilience of incoherent spectral codes to continuous-wave and amplitude-modulated interference which may be applied to optical-wireless communication and optical packet switching.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Polarization Scattering Impairments and Mitigation in 10-Gbaud Polarization-Division-Multiplexed WDM Systems
abstract: Experiments on 10-Gbaud polarization-division-multiplexed DQPSK, DBPSK and OOK show that time interleaving return-to-zero signals in two polarizations can significantly reduce nonlinear polarization scattering in polarization-division-multiplexed WDM systems and increase the system tolerance to inter-channel nonlinearities.

articleTitle: Improved reflection tolerance by near-threshold operation of DFB seed light for a 80km reach loop-back WDM-PON
abstract: Reflection tolerance was improved for long-reach WDM-PON by operating DFB seed-light near its threshold region. With such a spectrally broadened seed light, error-free transmission over 80 km fiber reach was demonstrated under -32dB reflection.

articleTitle: Differentiated scheduling for delay-sensitive and delay-tolerant jobs in optical grids
abstract: A differentiated scheduling algorithm is designed to selectively schedule delay-sensitive jobs and delay-tolerant jobs in Optical Grids. It achieves lower overall blocking probability compared to conventional scheduling algorithms without job differentiation.

articleTitle: Optical Code Division Multiplexing technique for ultra high speed NGA asymmetric PON system
abstract: First time hybrid OTDM and OCDM technology is presented here to realize asymmetric 160Gbps PON System. To validate the basic principle, we experimentally demonstrated 2 channels OCDM signals with 15chip (~1.6ps/chip) pseudo random type optical encoder by allocating encoded chip pulses of different channels with 0.1ps accuracy.

articleTitle: Recent advances in real time processing based on parametric processes
abstract: Multicast parametric synchronous sampling (MPASS) architecture for real-time processing of optical signals based on parametric processes is reviewed. The processor uses parametric gates to obtain multiple sub-rate outputs. Operating principle and first demonstrations are described.

articleTitle: Interworking of IP and OTN networks - making IP over OTN a reality
abstract: The transition to IP dominated traffic coinciding with the explosion of traffic is putting bring the interworking of the IP networks and the OTN networks into sharp focus. This paper explores those issues.

articleTitle: Holographic Bragg Reflectors: Designs and applications
abstract: • Fabrication advances open the door to planar volume holographics devices - Functional equivalent of integrated thin film filters - Multiplexers (small with flexible passband) - Integrated reflective resonators (high finesse, high Q) - Truly photonic integrated circuits • Overlapping, delocalized signal paths • Signal selection via mode-specific holographic structures • Consistent with low cost volume manufacture - DUV photolithography - Nanoimprinting • Many basic questions remaining to possible function, loss management, mode selectivity, non-linear effects, etc., remain.

articleTitle: The continuing evolution of ethernet
abstract: Ethernet has continuously evolved to meet the needs of the application spaces which it services. This session will provide an overview and review the progress of the IEEE P802.3ba 40Gb/s and 100Gb/s Ethernet project.

articleTitle: Employing embedded waveform viewing technology with EDC in 10Gb/s optical links
abstract: Advances in embedded waveform monitoring technology are enabling system designers to perform signal integrity analysis and remote monitoring. Combining monitoring capability with EDC promises to reduce the cost and time-to-market in 10 G optical systems.

articleTitle: Fiber laser wavelength tuning on a silicon chip
abstract: Tunable silicon microring filters are used to implement CMOS compatible tuning of fiber-lasers. A micro-heater is used to tune the Si microring filter, demonstrating tuning of 1.5 nm with linewidths narrower than 0.02 nm.

articleTitle: Demonstration of tunable microwave photonic notch filters using slow and fast light effects in semiconductor optical amplifiers
abstract: We introduce a novel scheme based on slow and fast light effects in semiconductor optical amplifiers, to implement a microwave photonic notch filter with ~100% fractional tuning range at a microwave frequency of 30 GHz.

articleTitle: Radio-frequency arbitrary waveform generation on a silicon chip
abstract: We demonstrate ultra-compact spectral shaping via thermo-optically tunable multiple-channel microring resonators on a silicon chip, and combine it with frequency-time mapping to achieve photonic radio-frequency arbitrary waveform generation (RFAWG).

articleTitle: All-optical encryption for optical network with interleaved waveband switching modulation
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical encryption scheme with interleaved waveband-switching modulation using a 35-cm bismuth-oxide nonlinear fiber. The encrypted data adopt a constant intensity for both bit0 and bit1 such that no data signature is observed.

articleTitle: GMPLS Ethernet and PBB-TE (A carrier's view)
abstract: Applicability of GMPLS architecture to Ethernet transport networks is discussed regarding carrier requirements and standardization status. Demonstration results of preliminary implementations of GMPLS controlled Ethernet and PBB-TE are presented.

articleTitle: Impact of 2xOOK-to-QPSK format conversion on dynamic RWA with FWM-induced crosstalk-aware wavelength-path networks
abstract: Envisaged transparent modulation format conversion from 2-channels OOK to QPSK in future wavelength-path networks, a novel FWM-induced crosstalk-aware dynamic RWA algorithm is demonstrated to minimize the blocking probability.

articleTitle: Reliable multi-bit-rate VPN design for Ethernet over WDM carrier services
abstract: We study cost-efficient and reliable design of multi-bit-rate virtual private network (VPN) in a mixed-line-rate (MLR) WDM optical network for multipoint-to-multipoint carrier Ethernet services.

articleTitle: PCE-based network design for multi-domain layer 1 Virtual Private Networks
abstract: We propose a novel resource demand model and a BFS-based algorithm for multi-domain L1VPN. The proposed model and algorithm are implemented on AMSON testbed by combining PCE and service plane, and verified by experiment results.

articleTitle: Bandwidth efficient precompensation using a single digital-to-analog converter
abstract: We introduce a new electronic precompensation scheme based on the use of a single digital-to-analog converter. The proposed method allows for arbitrary amount of chromatic dispersion compensation while minimizing the occupied bandwidth of the transmitted signal.

articleTitle: Multi-layer network architectures
abstract: Multi-layer networks are a hot topic with many investigations and approaches reported in literature. This contribution reflects on basic issues, key questions, and important challenges in planning, building, and operating multi-layer networks.

articleTitle: PMDC for polarization multiplexed RZ-DQPSK systems
abstract: A PMDC working in the cancellation mode is proposed for Pol-Mux RZ-DPSK/ DQPSK systems. It has separate control loops for PMDC and Pol-Demux. It showed 18 ps of DGD tolerance in a 112 Gb/s bit-aligned Pol-Mux RZ-DQPSK system.

articleTitle: Transmission of optically generated 1.25 Gb/s QAM wireless signals in a dynamically reconfigurable optical WDM network
abstract: WDM Transmission of 1.25 Gb/s 4-QAM photonic vector modulated signals together with 155 Mb/s baseband and a UMTS signal in a dynamically reconfigurable network is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Impact of FBGs reflectivity shape on spectra of radiation in 10 km Raman fibre laser
abstract: We study the impact of the shape of fibre Bragg gratings spectral reflectivity on spectral broadening in a 10 km Raman fibre laser. We show that, at high powers, spectral characteristics are determined by intra-cavity processes rather than by the gratings profile.

articleTitle: Fused biconical tapered technique based light beam coupling between a single mode fiber and a high nonlinearly photonic crystal fiber
abstract: Light beam coupling between a single-mode fiber and a highly nonlinear photonic crystal fiber based on fused biconical tapered technique is experimentally demonstrated. As a result, more than 90% coupling ratio are achieved.

articleTitle: Experimental experiences in high speed DQPSK transmission
abstract: Field and laboratory experiments show RZ-DQPSK being a suitable format for 40 Gb/s long haul transmission also in mixed rate systems. Trials demonstrate transmission well beyond 1000 km for non-ideal fiber spans at higher loss and PMD.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable waveband cross-connect and its application in 112 Gb/s WDM system
abstract: We demonstrated a reconfigurable waveband cross-connect that can dynamically configure uniform and non-uniform waveband assignments to improve aggregation efficiency. We applied it on 112 Gb/s polarization-multiplexed RZ-QPSK WDM system and obtained good system performance.

Author Keywords: (060.1810) Buffers, couplers, routers, switches, and multiplexers

articleTitle: Overflow traffic modeling in hybrid optical circuit/burst switching nodes with service differentiation
abstract: This paper proposes a model for a hybrid optical burst/circuit switching node, where overflow traffic from optical circuits is forwarded through burst-switched channels. The node's traffic differentiation capabilities are demonstrated through performance evaluation.

articleTitle: Dynamic range improvement in photonic Time-Stretch Analog-to-digital converter
abstract: Dynamic range improvement using analog differential combining in the photonic time-stretch analog-to-digital converter is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. This technique reduces hardware and signal processing requirements for continuous operation and also improves the signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Integrated optical phase-locked loop
abstract: We demonstrate the first integrated optical phase-lock loop (OPLL) photonic IC, containing two SG-DBR lasers with >5 THz tuning range, a balanced detector pair and output modulators. A proof-of-concept homodyne OPLL demonstration has been performed.

articleTitle: Multiple access interference and interferometric noise suppression using dispersion imbalanced loop mirror in optical CDMA networks
abstract: A highly Ge-doped nonlinear fiber based dispersion imbalanced loop mirror is used to suppress MAI and IN in an optical CDMA network, thus improving the power penalty by 7dB and enhancing the network's scalability.

articleTitle: CD-insensitive PMD monitoring of an 80-Gb/s polarization-multiplexed RZ-DPSK channel using a polarizer and a low-speed detector
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a PMD monitoring technique utilizing the polarizer and low-speed detector for 80-Gb/s pol-muxed RZ-DPSK. RF power increment of 16.2 dB, insensitive to 0~100 ps/nm chromatic dispersion, is measured in the presence of 0~12 ps DGD.

articleTitle: Flexible optical packet compression and switching utilizing an optical crosspoint switch matrix based on active vertical coupler
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate all-optical packet compression for a RZ payload up to 40 Gb/s and a label at 155 Mb/s, based on a recirculating buffer with one single optical crosspoint switch. The packet can be flexibly switched, dropped, time slot interchanged up to 9 time-slots and compressed up to 4 packets in one time slot. Back to back BER performance of the 4 times compressed packet is measured with only 1.8 dB of power penalty. By using variable fiber delay lines, this scheme can be further extended to the applications for variable length/time slot packet routing and compression.

articleTitle: Performance of an optical packet switch with an optimal FDL bank
abstract: We present an optimal method to assign delay values to a bank of FDLs and compare the performance of an optical packet switch with various FDL configurations.

articleTitle: Effects of RSOA gain ripples on upstream transmission in a SML-seeded loop-back WDM-PON
abstract: In a SML-seeded loop-back WDM-PON, the upstream BER plots show variation of power penalty by 2 dB, depending on the difference of seed and ripple peak wavelength, which is related to the RSOA transient chirp.

articleTitle: On resource provisioning for multi-domain networks
abstract: We study the performance of multi-domain resource dimensioning/routing techniques with limited information sharing, and provide motivation for considering fairness issues.

Author Keywords: (060.4265) Fiber optics and optical communications/Networks, wavelength routing

articleTitle: Transmission of on-off keying signal at 1310 nm using electrical post-compensation of SOA nonlinearity
abstract: An electrical post-compensation scheme for semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) nonlinearity has been proposed. A 1310 nm on-off keying transmission system was demonstrated with SOA nonlinearity compensation. An 8 dB improvement in Q-factor has been achieved.

articleTitle: Near field probes from photonic crystal fibers: proposal and analysis
abstract: Nano-structured PCFs are suggested to use as super-resolving near-field probes. It is shown that the contrast and resolution of these probes are increased with the size and complexity of the PCF nanostructure.

articleTitle: New type of long-period fiber grating by self-assembled periodic polymerization in silica hollow optical fiber
abstract: We report a new type of long period grating fabrication method by curing polymer filled in a hollow optical fiber. In the curing process, a self-assembled polymer-air periodic structure was achieved.

articleTitle: G.709 hierarchy optical transport core network design, requirements and challenges
abstract: This paper provides an operator view on G.709 core optical network design for use in a multi-vendor/operator environment. It also highlights the G.709 enhancement in Tandem Connection Monitoring and automatic protection switching technique and requirements.

articleTitle: Spatially resolved measurements of fiber parameters by localized four-photon mixing
abstract: Strict localization of four-photon mixing was demonstrated in long sections of highly nonlinear fiber. The technique offers new means for precise mapping of dispersive fluctuations and other waveguide parameters critical for construction of wideband devices.

articleTitle: Soft glass spiral PCF with flat anomalous dispersion at 1064nm and γ≫2000 W−1km−1 at 1550nm
abstract: A soft-glass spiral PCF design is analysed using the FEM approach showing gamma >2000 W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> at 1550 nm and 4000 W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> (1064 nm). The design exhibits low, flat anomalous dispersion (~15 ps/nm.km and dispersion slope~0.25 ps/nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.km) at 1064 nm.

articleTitle: 40 GHz sub-picosecond pulse generation from a Mach-Zehnder modulator and its application to 320 Gb/s OTDM
abstract: We demonstrate 40 GHz repetition sub-picosecond optical pulse generation from a LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> Mach-Zehnder modulator by inserting it in a fiber-loop then using nonlinear pulse compression by dual-stage self-phase modulation. Application to 320 Gb/s signal generation is shown.

articleTitle: Phase-preserving amplitude regeneration using dispersion-imbalanced loop mirror
abstract: Scheme and parameters of dispersion-imbalance loop mirror (DILM) have been optimized for phase-preserving amplitude 2R regeneration. DILM performance for DPSK transmission has been evaluated in numerical simulations. A 4.8 dB Q-factor improvement has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Pump-to-signal intensity noise transfer as the mechanism of self-pulsing in erbium doped fiber laser
abstract: We report experimental and theoretical characterization of self-pulsing in high concentration erbium doped fiber laser which is free from erbium clusters. Unlike previous models of self-pulsing which account for pair-induced quenching (PIQ) on the clustered erbium ions, new model includes statistical nature of the excitation migration and upconversion, and resonance-like pump-to-signal intensity noise transfer. The obtained results are in a good agreement with the experimental data.

articleTitle: 320-Gbps wavelength-multiplexed 1×5 optical packet switching using broadband InP phased-array switch
abstract: We demonstrate 1times5 broadband WDM optical packet routing with monolithically integrated phased-array switch on InP. Using a synchronized eight-port current driver, error-free forwarding of 8 times 40-Gbps multi-colored packet is achieved with Lt25-mA current injection.

articleTitle: Multi-wavelength optical fiber refractive index profiling by spatially resolved fourier transform spectroscopy
abstract: We describe a non-destructive technique to measure an optical fiber's refractive index profile with sub-mum spatial resolution over a wavelength range spanning more than one octave (from 480 to 1040 nm) in a single measurement.

articleTitle: Performance improvement in Brillouin-based simultaneous strain and temperature sensors employing pulse coding in coherent detection schemes
abstract: We have experimentally characterized the benefits of pulse coding in coherent-detection Brillouin-based hybrid sensors, achieving 15 dB improvement in two-way sensing distance at same resolution in simultaneous strain and temperature sensing.

articleTitle: A method of accurately optimizing the timing of phase modulation in wide temporal ranges for DQPSK transmitters
abstract: We propose and verify experimentally a method of accurately setting the timing of phase modulation over temporal ranges wider than 1 symbol period for DQPSK transmitters, allowing Q to be optimized within 0.1 dB.

articleTitle: Measurement of resonant nonlinear index of ytterbium doped fiber using a pair of thermally expanded core fibers
abstract: Resonant nonlinear refractive index of doped optical fiber is measured using a pair of thermally expanded core fibers. Ytterbium doped fiber was used to show the validity of our proposed method.

articleTitle: 90° bent hollow waveguides formed by distributed Bragg reflector
abstract: 90° bent hollow waveguides with distributed Bragg reflectors (DBR) in silicon substrate are proposed. The air core was embedded by Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> multilayer. The two-dimensional (2-D) finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method is used to simulate bending transmission efficiencies of the 90°-bent waveguides. The lowest 90° bending loss is around 0.8dB. This waveguide can be used in integrated planar light wave circuits.

articleTitle: Novel Ti:LiNbO3 polarization converter with a reversed-electrode
abstract: We have successfully fabricated a polarization converter by reversing the polarity of the electrode in coherence length along a X-cut Z-propagating Ti:LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> waveguide. 100% conversion ratio was achieved with an applied voltage of 17 V.

articleTitle: Novel crystalline core optical fibers
abstract: This work discusses advances in fabricating glass-clad crystalline core optical fibers. Of greatest significance is that these crystalline core fibers were produced using scalable and commercially accepted optical fiber draw processes.

articleTitle: Efficient video service in PON using OLT batching and priority queues
abstract: We propose Popularity-based OLT Batching (POB) for VoD service in PONs. POB uses very few queues at the OLT, a novel queue-selection algorithm, and the expected number of arrivals to decide on a queue for batching requests.

articleTitle: Hardware-accelerated protection in Long-Reach PON
abstract: We propose hardware-accelerated protection for the ldquoring-and-spurrdquo long-reach PON to achieve fast protection-switching time, and automatic failure location at OLT. We demonstrate that protection paths can be established within 14 ms after a failure occurs.

articleTitle: Transoceanic field trial of dynamic optical path recovery using GMPLS-controlled optical cross connect
abstract: Transoceanic field trial of the GMPLS-controlled optical network was successfully conducted for resilient global network services. Fast dynamic recovery of optical path services was achieved thanks to appropriate operation and deployment of GMPLS control plane.

articleTitle: Wide and fast wavelength-tunable mode-locked fiber lasers based on dispersion tuning at 1.5 µm and 1.3 µm bands
abstract: Wavelength-tunable mode-locked fiber laser based on dispersion tuning at 1.5 mum and 1.3 mum bands are reported. We realized wide tuning range of over 120 nm and fast tuning rate of over 20 kHz.

articleTitle: Control of transmission band in all-solid photonic bandgap fibers with novel hybridized bandgap structure
abstract: We report on the design and fabrication of all-solid photonic bandgap fibers consisting of two different high-index rods sizes in the cladding, allowing us the control of transmission band over nanometer range for various applications.

articleTitle: An agile multi-wavelength optical source with configurable channel spacing and CW or pulsed operation for high-capacity WDM optical networks
abstract: A multi-wavelength optical source with 50 GHz or 100 GHz-spaced, narrow linewidth channels covering the C-band is reported. The source operates in CW- or pulsed- mode for compatibility with 100 Gbs Ethernet.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an integrated buffer for an all-optical packet router
abstract: An integrated silica 10-channel, AWG-based delay-line optical buffer with up to 100 ns delay is demonstrated. Error-free operation at 40 Gb/s is shown for all channels with penalties of ~2-4 dB at BER = 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>.

articleTitle: Experimental evaluation of the extended JET protocol in support of TDM services
abstract: This paper experimentally evaluated the extended JET protocol supporting periodic TDM circuits on an OBS testbed. The results showed that the proposed scheme can dynamically support both non-periodic and periodic bandwidth resource requirements.

articleTitle: Single-gate 320-to-8×40 Gb/s demultiplexing
abstract: The first experimental demonstration of 320 Gb/s demultiplexing to eight simultaneous always-on 40 Gb/s tributaries with near-zero latency is reported. Error-free demultiplexing is achieved by a single parametric processor operating in copy-and-sample mode over 20 THz.

articleTitle: Demonstration of digital wavelength demultiplexing for group delay dispersion measurement
abstract: A novel WDM detection technique based on ultrafast field sampling is used to measure the chromatic dispersion of optical fibers. Its simultaneous two-wavelength detection enables direct evaluation of group delay difference without optical demultiplexing devices.

articleTitle: Demonstration of programmable broadband packet multicasting in an oOptical switching fabric test-bed
abstract: Multicasting of broadband optical messages is experimentally demonstrated in a programmable optical switching test-bed. Wavelength-striped optical packets with 8 times 10 Gb/s payloads are multicasted error-free through the fabric, with confirmed scalability to 40 Gb/s data rates.

articleTitle: Optical channel drop filter based on two-dimensional photonic crystals
abstract: In this paper, we propose an optical channel drop filter based on two-dimensional photonic crystals (2D PCs). The numerical results show the drop efficiency is closed to 100% and the crosstalk is less than -36 dB.

articleTitle: On-chip 90° polarization rotator using wave coupling through an intermediate, multimode, uniform waveguide
abstract: We propose an ultra-short broadband 90° polarization rotator using wave coupling through a multimode waveguide. A 21-µm conversion length is achieved with 17 dB extinction ratio.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation in an As2Se3-based chalcogenide PCF using four-wave mixing and soliton self-frequency shift
abstract: We theoretically find a bandwidth of 4 mum can be generated using four-wave mixing and soliton self-frequency shift in an As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-based chalcogenide PCF with an air-hole-diameter-to-pitch ratio of 0.4 and a pitch of 3 mum.

articleTitle: Automatic alignment and splicing for elliptical core D-fiber
abstract: A new method for splicing KVH Industries D-fiber using automatic polarization and fiber core alignment is described. A Fujikura FSM-45PM splicer is used in this process for achieving consistent splice loss less than 0.5 dB and Polarization Extinction Ratio greater than 25 dB.

articleTitle: A compact flat-band filter for on-chip tera bit/s optical interconnects on a silicon photonic platform
abstract: A compact coupled-resonators flat-band filter with a large bandwidth (~3.3 nm), large free-spectral range (~18 nm), low crosstalk (Lt-12 dB) and negligible insertion loss (Lt0.3 dB) is demonstrated on a silicon-on-insulator platform with focused applications for on-chip optical interconnects.

articleTitle: Multihopping and waveband assignment in limited reconfigurable WDM networks
abstract: We compare the performance of various transponder waveband assignment algorithms when multihopping is done by OEO conversions in a limited reconfigurable network. We propose an algorithm to find a multihopped route with minimum OEO conversions.

articleTitle: Actively mode-locked fiber optical parametric oscillator
abstract: Active mode-locking of continuous wave pumped fiber optical parametric oscillators is reported. Stable 10 GHz pulses are obtained with tuning range of 21 nm.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 10-Tbit/s multi-granularity optical cross-connect node toward 100-Tbit/s scalability
abstract: We present the first experimental demonstration of a multi-granularity optical-cross-connect node toward 100-Tbit/s scalability. We successfully show 10.24-Tbit/s throughput with completely error-free operation and an 80-Gbit/s (2 times 40-Gbit/s) optical-virtual-concatenation function between different routes.

articleTitle: Triple-Format, UWB-WiFi-WiMax, Radio-Over-Fiber Co-Existence Demonstration Featuring Low-Cost 1308/1564 nm VCSELs and a Reflective Electro-Absorption Transceiver
abstract: We demonstrate co-existing UWB-WiFi-WiMax radio-over-fiber transmission above 600 Mbps over 1 km of fiber using a reflective electro-absorption transceiver. Fifth-order spurious-free dynamic range exceeded 125 dB.Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4/5</sup> across 6 GHz span. WiMax EVMs better than −28.01 dB were measured.

articleTitle: High-power semiconductor optical amplifier
abstract: ▪ High-Power Semiconductor Optical Amplifier ▪ High-power, polarization-insensitive SOA with different structure ▪ bulk: suitable for production due to small strain & large tolerance in width control ▪ QW: highest P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sat</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sup> of +20 dBm & low PDG in wide wavelength range ▪ QD: at developing stage but potential for pattern-effect-free amplification ▪ High-power, polarization-insensitive SOA with GaInNAs / InP ▪ low-gain-tilt and potential for high-power, polarization-insensitive L-band SOA ▪ High-power, polarization-insensitive SOA module by incorporating compressively-strained-QW SOA in polarization-diversity configuration ▪ high P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sat</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sup> of +22 dBm & flat gain for 4ch CWDM signals ▪ Ultra-high-power SOA with novel waveguide structure ▪ SCOWA: Watt-class SOA with low NF

articleTitle: PLI-aware wavelength routing in optical networks
abstract: The trade-off between algorithmic complexity, physical layer evaluation precision and blocking performance is discussed for four different algorithms and variations in the DT network. Newly developed analytical models for SPM and PMD are used.

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion for NRZ signals with enhanced regenerative characteristics
abstract: We present a new scheme for all-optical NRZ wavelength conversion with SOA-MZIs. It uses bidirectional data injection and employs an additional CW signal to differentially bias the MZI and to enhance its regenerative properties.

articleTitle: SBS-suppressed, single mode Yb-doped fiber amplifiers
abstract: Experimental results are presented demonstrating 100 muJ of pulse energy and over 500 W of peak power from a stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS)-suppressed, single mode, Yb-doped fiber structure. Over 135 Watts are achieved continuous-wave.

articleTitle: Beat-noise-free OCDM technique employing spectral M-ary ASK based on electrical-domain spatial Code Spreading
abstract: We propose a beat-noise-free OCDM technique that enables asynchronous transmission using a simple configuration by applying spectral M-ary ASK based on electrical-domain spatial code spreading. The feasibility is confirmed through a 1.5-Gbit/s transmission experiment.

articleTitle: 40 Gb/s DPSK receiver module with integrated free-space delay-line-interferometer
abstract: We present a 40Gb/s DPSK receiver module with athermal free-space DLI. It has a FSR of 43GHz, PDFS of 350MHz and a differential output voltage-swing of 550mVpp. 43Gb/s NRZ-DPSK back-to-back sensitivity was -4dBm (PRBS 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">31</sup>-1).

articleTitle: A monolithic one-sample/bit partial-response maximum likelihood SiGe receiver for electronic dispersion compensation of 10.7Gb/s fiber links
abstract: Combining, for the first time, a 1-sample/bit monolithic PRML silicon with standard MZM modulators and PIN receivers, we experimentally demonstrate error-free transmission (with standard G709 FEC) over a 400-Km uncompensated standard single-mode fiber link.

articleTitle: Scaling of nonlinear threshold with fiber type and channel spacing in WDM transmission systems
abstract: It is shown that the impact of interchannel nonlinear effects in wavelength-division multiplexed fiber-optic transmission systems depends on channel spacing, the fiber's group-velocity dispersion and its attenuation coefficient, condensed into a single dimensionless parameter.

articleTitle: Transmission of 1.2 Gbit/s Polarization-Multiplexed UWB signals in PON with 0.76 Bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency
abstract: The transmission of 1.2 Gbit/s polarization-multiplexed OFDM-based UWB signals in PON is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. This technique allows more than 25 km SSMF transmission reach with 0.76 Bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Integrated design for sliding scheduled traffic in WDM networks
abstract: Network design for sliding scheduled traffic is a highly-complex task that has been dealt by multistep approaches. We propose a scalable method, based on Lagrangean relaxation, which can perform integrated scheduling, routing and wavelength assignment.

articleTitle: 72×100Gb/s transmission over transoceanic distance, using large effective area fiber, hybrid Raman-Erbium amplification and coherent detection
abstract: 100 Gb/s channels are transmitted over 7,040 km. After propagation across eighty-eight 80 km-long sections of large effective area fiber, separated by Raman-assisted erbium repeaters, demodulation of PDM-QPSK waveforms is performed with digital processing in a coherent receiver.

articleTitle: Compact and low power consumption 1.55-μm electro-absorption modulator integrated DFB-LD TOSA for 10-Gbit/s 40-km transmission
abstract: We first report a low power consumption (under 0.18 W) and a wide temperature range (-5 to 75 degC) operation of 1.55-mum un-cooled EA/DFB-LD coaxial-type TOSA in 10-Gbit/s 40-km transmission.

articleTitle: Polarization coupled carrier phase estimation for coherent polarization multiplexed QPSK with OOK-neighbours
abstract: We proposed a novel algorithm for carrier phase estimation with differential demodulation, phase coupling between both polarizations and non-redundant error correction. The algorithm is demonstrated on measured 111 Gb/s polarization-multiplexed QPSK with 10times10.7 Gb/s OOK neighbours.

articleTitle: 32Tb/s (320×114Gb/s) PDM-RZ-8QAM transmission over 580km of SMF-28 ultra-low-loss fiber
abstract: Employing PDM-RZ-8QAM modulation, digital coherent detection and EDFA-only amplification, we demonstrate 25 GHz-spaced, 320×114Gb/s DWDM transmission through seven spans of ultra-low-loss fiber (average span length/loss of 82.8 km/14.6 dB) with a record capacity of 32Tb/s.

articleTitle: End-to-end asynchronous optical packet transmission, scheduling, and buffering
abstract: The first demonstration of asynchronous optical packet transmission, scheduling, and buffering is presented using asynchronous/autonomous transmitters, lookup, buffer and a burst mode receiver. Contention resolution is shown with greater than 99.8% packet recovery at 10 Gb/s.

Author Keywords: (060.1810) Buffers, couplers, routers, switches, and multiplexers

articleTitle: A programmable router interface supporting link virtualization with adaptive optical OFDMA transmission
abstract: A new programmable router interface with adaptive packet over optical OFDMA transmission is proposed, providing a perfect mechanism of bandwidth partition for link virtualization. A comparison study is presented to demonstrate its advantages.

articleTitle: Performance monitoring in optical OFDM systems
abstract: We investigate performance monitoring within coherent optical OFDM systems. Estimates for CD and instantaneous DGD can be extracted from the result of channel estimation. The method can also provide information about OSNR and non-linear distortion.

articleTitle: Characterization of an InP-based electrical 1:2 demultiplexer in a 107 Gb/s OOK system
abstract: The system performance of an InP-based electrical demultiplexer within an optically pre-amplified 107 Gb/s OOK receiver is investigated. Error-free performance was achieved in back-to-back configuration.

articleTitle: High power thulium doped fiber lasers
abstract: Thulium-doped silica fiber lasers and amplifiers offer a route to very high average power in the two-micron wavelength regime. This presentation reviews recent progress and considers the prospects for further improvement in performance.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical thresholding in a 4-channel OCDMA system via Two-Photon Absorption
abstract: We demonstrate the use of a Two-Photon Absorption based detector in an OCDMA system. This detector provides a significant performance improvement over standard linear detection.

articleTitle: Tunable high channel-count notch filter based on a phase-shift phase-only sampled FBG and its application to multi-wavelength fiber laser
abstract: We demonstrate a novel technique for the implementation of a tunable high channel-count notch filter based on a phase-shift phase-only sampled FBG. An application of this filter to a multi-wavelength fiber laser is introduced.

articleTitle: Influence of various factors on indoor cable friction properties and measurement trial at high drawing speed in actual environment
abstract: Newly designed measurement equipment is constructed for measuring the dynamic friction properties of indoor cable at high drawing speed in an actual wiring work. The dynamic friction coefficient depends on drawing speed and surface structure.

articleTitle: Field trial of WDM-OTDM transmultiplexing employing photonic switch fabric-based buffer-less bit-interleaved data grooming and all-optical regeneration
abstract: We report, for the first time, a field trial of a novel 42.7Gbps/128.1Gbps WDM/OTDM grooming node, and confirm node interoperability and the data integrity of asynchronous retiming.

articleTitle: Statistical analysis of MPI in bend-insensitive fibers
abstract: We present a statistical analysis of MPI in bend-insensitive fibers and show that MPI penalty is minimized for a cable cutoff distribution centered at 1200 nm with the maximum value less than 1260 nm.

articleTitle: Optical label switching performance with an autonomous operating 40Gbps optical digital-to-analog converter-type label processor
abstract: Optical packet switching performance with 40 Gbps, 2-bit optical digital-to-analog converter type label processor is demonstrated. Autonomous label processing and packet switching using a phase-shifted preamble-based gate pulse generation scheme was achieved for the first time.

articleTitle: Jitter performance of short length optical interconnects for rack-to-rack applications
abstract: We present eye width analysis for short multimode fiber links (<100 m) including modal noise and laser relative intensity noise. Contrary to power budgeting for traditional links, eye width budgeting is better suited for short links.

articleTitle: Optical steganography using chirped fiber Bragg grating
abstract: Optical steganography has been experimentally demonstrated using a matched pair of chirped fiber Bragg gratings. The stealth channel is temporally and spectrally hidden underneath the public channel. The public channel power penalty is < 1dB.

articleTitle: Introduction of In-Service Optical Path Measurement
abstract: The concept of in-service optical path measurement (ISOPM) for mesh networks is introduced. PMD measurement within bandwidths of 50-GHz spaced DWDM channels along with multiple working channels, as an example, shows the feasibility of ISOPM.

articleTitle: Capacity limits capacity limits of fiber fiber-optic communication systems
abstract: • Shannon's information theory allows to determine an asymptote of the channel information rate for a signal impaired by additive white Gaussian noise • Determining the limiting information rate in point-topoint fiber transmission in optically-routed network can allow to set limits on optical network capacity • Achieving capacity requires an array of advanced technologies • Many important open issues remain to be addressed to solve the problem of maximizing fiber capacity in optical networks!

articleTitle: Optical OFDM transmission in metro/access networks
abstract: We survey the state-of-the-art in optical orthogonal frequency division multiplexed (OFDM) transmission with direct detection (DD), highlighting cost-effective solutions for OFDM/DD metro/long-haul systems and OFDM-based multiple access passive optical networks (OFDMA PON).

articleTitle: Lightwave centralized WDM-OFDM-PON network employing cost-effective directly modulated laser
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate the first lightwave-centralized WDM-OFDM-PON using cost-effective directly modulated lasers (DML) to generate downstream OFDM QPSK signals at 10 Gb/s and provide upstream OOK signals using a remodulating scheme at 2.5 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Embedding optical ethernet services within the path computation element framework: The 100GET approach
abstract: We address the issues of inter-domain optical service provisioning with carrier-grade Ethernet and propose a multi-layer PCE based control plane architecture to implement adaptive advance reservation, which can significantly improve resource utilization and reduce blocking.

articleTitle: 107 Gbit/s demultiplexing photoreceivers comprising pin- and pinTWA frontends
abstract: Demultiplexing photoreceivers, composed of either pin or pinTWA packaged frontends and subsequent packaged InP-HBT-based demultiplexers are reported for 107 Gbit/s operation, paving the way to ultra compact co-packaged pin/pinTWA-DEMUX receivers.

articleTitle: Continuously-tunable slow and fast light using silicon microring add-drop filter with mutual mode coupling
abstract: Continuously-tunable slow and fast light is experimentally demonstrated using silicon microring add-drop filter with mutual mode coupling. Pulse delay and advancement can be achieved by thermal tuning at the drop port of the resonator.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of 10-Gb/s OFDM-QPSK signal at 60 GHz using frequency-doubling and tandem SSB modulation
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 10-Gb/s OFDM-QPSK signal with negligible penalty following 100-km SSMF transmission within 7-GHz unlicensed band at 60-GHz for the first time. The proposed scheme proves to be a viable solution for long-reach 60-GHz RoF system.

articleTitle: Enhanced 10-Gb/s NRZ transmission distance using dual modulation of an integrated electro-absoprtion modulated laser transmitter
abstract: We report on the first demonstration of low-penalty error-free 10 Gb/s transmission using an integrated EML transmitter over 113 km thanks to dual modulation applied simultaneoulsy to the laser and the modulator.

articleTitle: All-optical label extractor/eraser for in-band labels and 160 Gb/s payload based on micro ring resonators
abstract: We demonstrate a passive and asynchronous photonic integrated all-optical label extractor/eraser by using narrow-band silicon-nitride add/drop ring-resonators. Error-free simultaneous separation/erasing of the in-band labels from the 160 Gb/s packet payload was demonstrated without pulse-shape distortions.

articleTitle: Influence of filter shape and bandwidth on 44 Gb/s DQPSK systems
abstract: Filter shape and bandwidth are studied for multiplexers/demultiplexers in DQPSK systems. Simulation shows both factors have strong impact on signal performance. In 50GHz spaced systems with 44Gb/s RZ-DQPSK signals, 2nd-order super-Gaussian filters outperform higher-order filters.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of single-star-type new-generation optical access based on WDM-direct
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 25km-long, WDM-based, single-star-type new-generation optical access system providing both bandwidth-guaranteed and bandwidth-shared services. The system switches the services automatically by use of signaling initiated from ONU.

articleTitle: 80 GHz bandwidth-gain-product Ge/Si avalanche photodetector by selective Ge growth
abstract: We demonstrate selectively grown Ge/Si avalanche photodetectors with a bandwidth of 10 GHz at gain = 8 at 1310 nm. The high bandwidth-gain-product of 80 GHz and Si monolithic integration capability offer great potentials for future applications.

articleTitle: W-band vector signal generation via optical millimeter-wave generation and direct modulation of NBUTC-PD
abstract: The generation of optical millimeter-wave with frequency 8-tupling is experimentally demonstrated. 625-Mb/sec QPSK data transmission at 105-GHz (W-band) is achieved for the first time using the millimeter-wave generation technique and direct modulation of a NBUTC-PD.

articleTitle: Impact of FTTP on metro network architecture
abstract: FTTP has forced a shift in metro network architecture. Traditional DWDM and SONET networks will not efficiently scale to meet FTTP transport requirements. A ROADM based metro architecture is able to efficiently transport FTTP.

articleTitle: High-speed transmission in multimode fibers
abstract: ➢ Overview was given on MMF applications, standards and MMF characterization ➢ Reach, speed and capacity extension techniques were reviewed and discussed GI-MMF-Systems ➢ 40 Gb/s and 100 Gb/s line rates will be realized by space division multiplexing ➢ Lasers, fibers and receivers show up for 40 Gb/s serial systems for more than 400 m transmission distance on a single wavelength ➢ WDM, OFDM and SCM can contribute to extend capacity times distance product to reach several Tb/s·km ➢ Main advantage of high coupling tolerances must be maintained! POF-Systems ➢ 40 Gb/s transmission over 100 m GI-POF and GI-PF-POF is feasible ➢ Higher order modulation formats, WDM, OFDM, SCM and electronic equalization techniques are applied to increase capacity times distance product

articleTitle: Thermal limits for integration of directly modulated lasers with driver IC on SOI
abstract: A study of thermal crosstalk between III-V hybrid integrated directly modulated laser diodes and driver IC in BiCMOS technology on SOI is presented. We derived design rules and cooling requirements from thermal modelling.

articleTitle: End-to-end network architecture choices for future economically viable networks
abstract: This paper examines two alternative end-to-end network architectures, one with an all-optical circuit-switched dynamic core together with cheap, fixed metro, and the other with a core comprising fixed point-to-point pipes with a dynamic metro.

articleTitle: Dynamic grouped-wavelength conversion using multiple-QPM LiNbO3 module and TLA
abstract: The dynamic grouped-wavelength switching of converted signals is demonstrated by using a multiple-QPM-LN module and a TLA. A high SNR (>45 dB) is achieved and the converter exhibits a low power penalty (<0.2 dB).

articleTitle: Requirements for 100-Gb/s Metro Networks
abstract: A combined DPSK and 3-ASK modulation format for 100-Gb/s optical transport is reported as realizable at relatively low cost with currently available components. It is shown that metro and regional network transmission requirements are met.

articleTitle: Highly coherent picosecond pulse generation with sub-ps jitter and high SMSR by gain switching Discrete Mode laser diodes at 10 GHz line rate
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of picosecond pulses with ~800 fs jitter and SMSR in excess of 60 dB by gain switching a discrete mode laser and compare the results with a commercial DFB laser.

articleTitle: MMF transmission of directly-modulated 40-Gb/s signal using mode-field matched center-launching technique
abstract: We demonstrate the transmission of the directly-modulated 40-Gb/s signal over 4 km of MMF by using the mode-field matched center-launching technique. The results show that the maximum reach can be extended to the chromatic-dispersion limit.

articleTitle: Demonstration of the in-band message communication channel and Mac-in-Mac technology for GMPLS controlled new generation layer2 transport networks
abstract: In-band message communication channel and Mac-in-Mac encapsulation technologies are the most important functions for the new generation GMPLS controlled layer2 transport networks. The prototype layer2 transport switch system which supports both functions is successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Single photon avalanche photodiodes
abstract: • Performance of Geiger-mode APDs is improving rapidly ↓ • New application opportunities • Infrared SPADs - Acceptable detection efficiencies - Need lower dark count rates → higher operating temperature - Need solution for afterpulsing - Initial systems demonstrations and field trials

articleTitle: Global optimization of RZ-DPSK and RZ-DQPSK systems at various data rates
abstract: We use a global optimization algorithm to find the optimum fiber launch powers and dispersion map of single-channel RZ-DPSK and RZ-DQPSK systems at data rates ranging from 5 Gbit/s to 130 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Complex component characterization based on elementary matrices
abstract: ▪ Measurement of elementary matrix provides complete component characterization ▪ All important dispersion properties are readily available from matrix N; this eliminates the need for complex analysis of the Jones matrices. ▪ The elementary matrix directly shows the dispersive properties that are normally hidden within the Jones matrix. ▪ Concatenation formulas provided ▪ Learned that concatenation can create p's and q's not present in the individual parts ▪ High order PMD calculations are straight-forward ▪ Expect this to be a fruitful area of continued research.

articleTitle: Design of a chromatic dispersion measurement control protocol based upon the GMPLS architecture
abstract: This paper analyzes requirements of measurement control for chromatic dispersion based upon GMPLS and defines an abstract control protocol applicable to both link and path measurements. The protocol's LMP application has successfully demonstrated measurement control.

articleTitle: Ultimate capacity limitations in repeater-less WDM transmission up to 505 km
abstract: We analyze capacity limitations in long repeater-less transmission experiments. Combination of self-phase-modulation and inter-channel Raman cross-talk limits useable bandwidth, confining ultimate capacity for the examined design to 32 times 10 Gb/s and 8 times 10 Gb/s channels over 486 km and 505 km, respectively.

articleTitle: Fibre nonlinearities in 10 and 40 Gb/s electronically dispersion precompensated WDM transmission
abstract: Fiber nonlinearities in WDM systems using linear electronic dispersion precompensation are studied at high bit rates. In contrast to 10 Gb/s systems, only a small performance degradation due to nonlinearities was found at 40 Gb/s.

articleTitle: A W-Band photonic transmitter-mixer based on high-power near-ballistic uni-traveling-carrier photodiode (NBUTC-PD) for 1.25-Gb/s BPSK data transmission under bias modulation
abstract: We demonstrate W-band photonic transmitters-mixers, which are composed of near-ballistic-uni-traveling-carrier-photodiodes and quasi-Yagi antennas without integrating Si-lens. By utilizing it, data-transmission at W-band can be achieved under bias modulation of 1.25-Gb/s BPSK with 5GHz IF signals.

articleTitle: S-band RSOAs for WDM PONs
abstract: We report on a polarisation independent S-band RSOA for WDM-PON applications for the first time. Operation at 1.25 Gbit/s over the entire S-band is demonstrated in TO-packaged devices with a path loss capability of >25 dB.

articleTitle: 25Gbps 1.3μm DFB laser for 10–25km transmission in 100GBE systems
abstract: We report on a 1.3μm DFB laser with, to our knowledge, record modulation efficiency of 3.7GHz/mA½, demonstrating open eyes after 25km transmission at 25Gbps, under maximum positive dispersion conditions.
