articleTitle: Influence of neighbor channel modulation formats on 112 Gbit/s and 42.8 Gbit/s WDM coherent polmux-QPSK transmission systems
abstract: A detailed study of WDM transmission performance of 112 Gbit/s and 42.8 Gbit/s polarization multiplexed QPSK channels with coherent demodulation is performed by numerical simulation considering different neighbor channel formats and fiber types.

articleTitle: Record transmission distances over ultra low loss G.652 fibre with NRZ-OOK or NRZ-DPSK 40 Gbps WDM systems
abstract: We experimentally investigate the performance of ultra low loss (ULL) fibre for 43 Gbps WDM transmission. Combination of ULL fibre with NRZ-DPSK and hybrid Raman-EDFA amplification enables record transmission distance of 4400 km on G.652 fibre, while implementation of simpler modulation format (NRZ-OOK) and amplification scheme (EDFA only) enables to reach 1600 km at 43 Gbps line rate.

articleTitle: A novel architecture for seamless integration of ROF with centralized lightwave WDM-PON network
abstract: We demonstrated a novel architecture for seamless integration ROF with OFDM-WDM-PON based on an integrated external modulator. The 10 Gbit/s wired signal, 2.5 Gbit/s wireless signal and upstream signal has been transmitted over 20 km SMF successfully.

articleTitle: Why are dense WDM transparent networks more tolerant than expected to in-band crosstalk ?
abstract: We show that 43 Gb/s DPSK channels aligned on the 50 GHz ITU grid remain tolerant to crosstalk thanks to the narrow optical filtering functions of the traversed transparent nodes and their different routing states.

articleTitle: Proposal of high stable clock recovery method based on queuing-delay measurement scheme for TDM PWE3 over PSN
abstract: This proposes a clock recovery method with packet filter based on a new queuing-delay measurement scheme using the fluctuation monitoring of buffer depth. Evaluation results indicate our scheme can satisfy mobile network operator's synchronization requirement.

articleTitle: Advances in fiber laser beam combination
abstract: A number of methods have been proposed to combine high power fiber beams with near diffraction limited beam quality, including active and passive phasing, and spectral combination. The prospects, limitations, and further development of these methods are discussed.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of a novel 5/10-Gb/s Burst-mode clock and data recovery circuit for gigabit PONs
abstract: A novel 5/10-Gb/s burst-mode receiver featuring instantaneous (0-bit) phase acquisition for any phase step (plusmn2pi) between packets in GPON is demonstrated. Our design is based on an oversampling local oscillator and a phase picking algorithm.

articleTitle: Extended operating temperature range of 125 °C (−25°C to 100°C) of 10-Gbit/s, 1.55-μm electroabsorption modulator integrated DFB laser for 80-km SMF transmission
abstract: An 80-km SMF transmission at 10-Gb/s using a 1.55-mum, InGaAlAs EML was demonstrated over an extended temperature range (-25degC to 100degC). A dynamic extinction ratio of over 9 dB at -25degC was obtained.

articleTitle: A study of broadband access: Policy & status in Sweden, and global economic impact
abstract: Broadband access has many perceived benefits. We give an overview of the status and policy in Sweden and present a study of broadband access economic impact by means of regression analysis of international trade data.

articleTitle: Transmission of an ultra-low-jitter RF signal with high output power using all-photonic gain and saturated photodetector
abstract: All-photonic gain allows for the transmission of an ultra-low-jitter signal over 14 km of fiber. The jitter is 2.75 fs, only 0.3 fs more than back-to-back, while RF output power is increased 7.7 dB.

articleTitle: Generation of 270 Gb/s NRZ data packets from a 10-Gb/s signal using a temporal telescopic system
abstract: We demonstrate compression of 24-bit 10-Gb/s NRZ data packets to 270 Gb/s using a temporal telescopic system. This technique's versatility allows format-transparent compression of packets (i.e. NRZ, RZ, DPSK) and analog waveforms by arbitrary factors.

articleTitle: Defect analysis of photodarkened and gamma-ray irradiated ytterbium-doped silica glasses
abstract: Defects in photodarkened and gamma-ray irradiated ytterbium (Yb)-doped silica glasses has been experimentally investigated. The results indicate that the formation of Al-oxygen hole center (Al-OHC) is the prime cause of the photodarkening loss.

articleTitle: Raman-induced gain distortions in double-pumped parametric amplifiers
abstract: Raman-induced gain distortions in broadband (pump separations of 132 and 155nm) double-pumped parametric amplifiers are theoretically and experimentally analyzed. A gain profile possessing 100nm of 3dB ripple and 140nm of 4.7dB ripple is demonstrated.

articleTitle: DWDM transmission with 7.0-bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency using 8×65.1-Gbit/s coherent PDM-OFDM signals
abstract: Spectral efficient transmission of 8times65.1-Gbit/s PDM-OFDM is reported over 240 km. Using coherent detection and 32-QAM subcarrier modulation the channel spacing is reduced to 8 GHz, allowing a net spectral efficiency of 7.0 bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: All-optical label processing and swapping in packet switched networks: Opportunities for silicon photonics
abstract: The use of silicon photonics as technological platform to implement ultra-high speed all-optical switching devices for optical label processing and swapping in packet switches such as the Mach-Zehnder Interferometer is addressed.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of SIP and P2P hybrid architectures for consumer grids on OBS testbed
abstract: Three types of SIP and P2P hybrid architectures for consumer Grids are proposed. Their feasibility, efficiency and scalability are experimentally verified and their performances are experimentally compared by using an OBS network testbed.

articleTitle: 1.55 µm InP-based VCSEL with enhanced modulation bandwidths ≫ 10 GHz up to 85°C
abstract: VCSELs at 1.55-mum with reduced parasitics and improved active region provide superior modulation-bandwidths >10 GHz up to 85degC. These bandwidths enable potential bit-rates of 12.5 or even 17 Gb/s for cost-effective 100 G Ethernet solutions.

articleTitle: Maximized TCP throughput of 10G-EPON by optimizing polling cycle
abstract: We propose and demonstrate by numerical simulations a dynamic polling algorithm to maximize the TCP throughput of 10G-EPON, which can optimize the polling cycle by considering the bandwidth utilization and the round-trip time.

articleTitle: Wireless HD services over optical access systems: Transmission, networking, and demonstration
abstract: We propose converged optical-wireless access networks for future wireless HD services delivery over optical fiber and air links. Key technologies including long reach, flexible reconfigurability, and real SD/HD uncompressed video implementation are experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: WDM-PON development and deployment as a present optical access solution
abstract: The WDM based passive optical network (WDM-PON) provides distinctive advantages over TDMA-PON in terms of protocol transparency, QoS, and security. This paper introduces various WDM-PON schemes and their applications for the cost-effective and future-proof access network solutions.

articleTitle: Serial 40G submarine deployments
abstract: A discussion of the trial of OC768c/STM256 (40 Gbps), transmission over a 7360 km segment of the TAT-14 Trans-Atlantic submarine cable system, using DPSK-RZ encoding in a single wavelength, with polarization mode dispersion and chromatic dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Impact of burst header length in the performance of a 10 Gb/s digital burst mode receiver
abstract: We show that the burst header length must be greater than 64 bits to ensure that the PER is better than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> over the entire 7 dB burst-to-burst dynamic range of the digital burst mode receiver.

articleTitle: Transmission of 32.1 Gbit/s RZ-D8PSK over 160 km using dispersion compensation by optical phase conjugation
abstract: A 32.1 Gbit/s RZ-D8PSK modulated signal was transmitted through 160 km SSMF with optical phase conjugation after 80 km. The phase conjugation was performed by four wave mixing.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s NRZ-DPSK and RZ-DPSK analysis based on complex spectrum measurement
abstract: We present results on the characterization of 10 Gb/s DPSK signals using Brillouin complex optical spectrometry. NRZ and RZ formats are analyzed in the optical domain, and time resolved phase and constellation are obtained.

articleTitle: All-optical ultra-wideband doublet generation and non-degraded transmission over optical fiber
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical ultra-wideband doublet pulse generation by single SOA and 1 km SMF. The doublet pulses are transmitted over 5 km SMF by dispersion compensation without degradation. The pulse shape modulation is also shown.

articleTitle: Microelectronics advancements to support new modulation formats and DSP techniques
abstract: Microelectronics advancements have made possible monolithic ASIC realizations to support new modulation formats on fiber such as QPSK. Critical aspects of high-speed ADC/DAC and DSP techniques are discussed for implementations at 40Gb/s and beyond.

articleTitle: Modeling and experimental analysis of contamination effects on lens-based optic modules
abstract: Developed optical modeling for prediction of contamination effects on optical properties of lens-based receptacles. Good correlation between experimental and modeling data was demonstrated for lens-based SFP modules.

articleTitle: Polarization-based fast-swept optical spectrum analyzer
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel polarimeter-enabled optical spectrum analyzer. The high-speed and very-large spectral-range enable measurement of > 100-nm fast-swept sources beyond 100-KHz. A unique 3-D plot displays the spectra of a fast-scanning source.

articleTitle: Real-time 100-Gb/s POLMUX RZ-DQPSK transmission over uncompensated 500 km of SSMF by optical phase conjugation
abstract: We present an effective solution for the upgrade of a highly dispersive link to POLMUX RZ-DQPSK 100-Gb/s transmission. Dispersion compensation is obtained by properly inserting a single polarization-insensitive phase-conjugation device along the link.

articleTitle: Propagation of multi-bound soliton states in optical fibers
abstract: We report, for the first time, numerical and experimental investigation of propagation of multi-bound solitons in optical fiber. The results show clearly the interaction of multi-bound solitons in optical fiber.

articleTitle: Individual fiber line testing technique for PONs using TLS-OTDR enhanced with reflected backward light analysis method
abstract: We describe a fiber line testing technique for PON that uses backscattered light reflected at FBGs with several wavelengths and a TLS-OTDR. We demonstrate the ability to test 8-branched fibers individually.

articleTitle: Measurement of optical fiber macrobending losses in a single turn with continuously-varying radius
abstract: In a single-mode fiber bent in a continuously-shrinking circle we show an exponential loss increase, with a superimposed oscillatory pattern that depends on the source linewidth, on the bent sample, and on its angular orientation.

articleTitle: Ultrasensitive APD photoreceivers for GPON and long haul optical transmission
abstract: We report the development of ultrasensitive photoreceivers, based on ultra high gain and low excess noise APDs, with sensitivities of -35.5 dBm at 2.488 Gbps and 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> BER and the potential for 6-12 dB sensitivity enhancement at higher bit rates. Current APD devices are not capable of simultaneous high gain and low noise. The developed APD detectors enable the achievement of optimum sensitivity at an order of magnitude higher gain than state-of-the-art detectors. The resulting APD receivers have been produced as ROSAs, fiber-coupled pigtail devices and ITU grid spaced linear arrays.

articleTitle: Modulation-format-independent wavelength conversion
abstract: This paper provides a proof-of-concept demonstration of modulation-format-independent wavelength conversion with an optical hybrid and an IQ wavelength converter. Multi-format wavelength conversion results are presented by using a SOA-based integrated device.

articleTitle: OSNR monitoring at high-speeds using a FBG-based correlator in optical packet-switched networks
abstract: A novel OSNR monitoring technique based on use of optical pulse correlation is demonstrated experimentally. By measuring statistics extracted from the autocorrelation peak, the OSNR is estimated with an error of less than 0.5 dB.

articleTitle: Flat-top pulse generation using 3-dB abrupt taper interferometeric pulse shaper
abstract: Using a novel and inexpensive 204 mm long 3 dB abrupt taper pulse shaper, a 3.8 ps flat-top pulse with less than 4% ripple was generated from a 2.2 ps Gaussian pulse.

articleTitle: Adaptive delay-difference compensation based on peer detection for 40-Gb/s/ch optical virtual concatenation
abstract: We propose an adaptive delay-difference compensation scheme for 40-Gb/s/ch optical virtual concatenation. Channel-to-channel delay-differences are detected based on peer comparison, and synchronously compensated using FIFO buffers. Rapid adaptive compensation with high accuracy is demonstrated.

articleTitle: 3 b/s/Hz 1.2 Tb/s packet generation using optical arbitrary waveform generation based optical transmitter
abstract: 40-bit OOK, 80-bit QPSK and 120-bit 16-QAM packets are generated with spectral efficiencies of 1, 2 and 3 b/s/Hz, exploiting concepts from OAWG. Results demonstrate potential for a Tb/s OAWG based transmitter using GHz electronics.

articleTitle: BER improvement using optical gain clamped amplifier for burst transmission and critical cases studies
abstract: This paper demonstrates significant BER improvement in burst traffic transmission using optical-gain clamped amplifiers. Critical chaotic cases are identified for peculiar burst sequences and their impact in transmission is assessed.

articleTitle: Polarization-independent broadband 1×8 optical phased-array switch monolithically integrated on InP
abstract: An InP/InGaAsP 1 times 8 optical phased-array switch is designed, fabricated, and demonstrated for the first time. The device demonstrates successful operation in the entire C-band (1520-1580 nm) for both the TE- and TM-polarization states.

articleTitle: An offline impairment aware RWA algorithm with dedicated path protection consideration
abstract: We present excellent performance results for a novel offline physical layer impairment aware routing and wavelength assignment algorithm for various transparent all-optical networks, while considering dedicated path protection.

articleTitle: Spectral Hole Burning in EDFA under various channel load conditions
abstract: Spectral hole burning in EDFA depends on channel loading condition. The most problematic channel load cases are identified in simulations of gain controlled EDFA. Simple way to predict channel gain deviation is suggested.

articleTitle: Transmission of hybrid 112 and 44 Gb/s PolMux-QPSK in 25 GHz channel spacing over 1600 km SSMF employing digital coherent detection and EDFA-only amplification
abstract: By using only C-band EDFAs, we have transmitted hybrid 10times112 and 10times44 Gb/s PolMux-QPSK signals in 25 GHz channel spacing over 1600-km SSMF employing digital coherent detection. The measured BER for all channels is smaller than 1.2times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: Signaling and multi-layer probe-based schemes for guaranteeing QoT in GMPLS transparent networks
abstract: Three probe-based schemes accounting for multi-layer performance information are proposed to evaluate and guarantee lightpath QoT in transparent optical networks. Low blocking and fast set up times are achieved for different service classes.

articleTitle: Guard-band for 111 Gbit/s coherent PM-QPSK channels on legacy fiber links carrying 10 Gbit/s IMDD channels
abstract: We investigated through simulations the minimum needed guard-band for the allocation of 111 Gbit/s coherent PM-QPSK WDM channels on legacy 10 Gbit/s IMDD WDM fiber links. For 2 dB penalty, results indicate 400 GHz (SMF) and 600 GHz (NZDSF).

articleTitle: Ultralow power dissipation widely-tunable transmitter optical subassembly for 10 Gb/s pluggable transceivers
abstract: We present design and performance of a 10 Gb/s C-band tunable transmitter optical subassembly based on a sampled grating DBR laser monolithically integrated with a Mach-Zehnder modulator.

articleTitle: EU project POF-PLUS: Gigabit transmission over 50 m of step-index plastic optical fibre for home networking
abstract: We demonstrated a Gigabit/s system for 1mm POF. Optimized Discrete Multi-tone Modulation techniques enabled 1 Gbit/s using LEDs, and 1.5 Gbit/s using VCSELs, a capability that encourages POF's use for next generation home networking.

articleTitle: Sensitivity improvement of incoherent multilevel (30-Gbit/s 8QAM and 40-Gbit/s 16QAM) signaling with non-Euclidean metric and MSPE (multi symbol phase estimation)
abstract: Highly sensitive incoherent multilevel signaling is demonstrated with the sensitivity nearly comparable to coherent detection, and a 160-km SMF transmission of pre-distorted 40-Gbit/s 16-QAM signal without optical dispersion compensation is also performed.

articleTitle: 10 × 112-Gb/s PDM 16-QAM transmission over 630 km of fiber with 6.2-b/s/Hz spectral efficiency
abstract: We demonstrate ten-channel WDM transmission of 112-Gb/s 16-QAM (14-gigabaud, polarization-multiplexed) over 630 km of fiber. 16.7-GHz channel spacing yields a spectral efficiency of 6.2 b/s/Hz, fitting 1 Tb/s of information into a 1.2-nm optical bandwidth.

articleTitle: Real-time coherent optical OFDM receiver at 2.5-GS/s for receiving a 54-Gb/s multi-band signal
abstract: We demonstrate the real-time implementation of a FPGA-based coherent optical OFDM (CO-OFDM) receiver at 2.5-G samples/s, which successfully receives a subband of a 54-Gb/s multi-band CO-OFDM signal with a record-low error floor of 3.7 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-8</sup>.

articleTitle: The impact and mitigation of non-linear effects in coherent optical transmission
abstract: Coherent systems are very disruptive, beyond the transponder design. • Promising for enhancing the tolerance to linear impairments Excellent tolerance to OSNR Extremely large tolerance to Chromatic Dispersion Unmatched tolerance to PMD • BUT with weak tolerance to nonlinear impairments with 40Gb/s PDM QPSK More promising at 100Gb/s PDM QPSK

articleTitle: 111-Gb/s POLMUX-RZ-DQPSK transmission over LEAF: Optical versus electrical dispersion compensation
abstract: We investigate the transmission performance of 111-Gb/s POLMUX-RZ-DQPSK modulation using either optical or electrical dispersion compensation. We show that after 2000-km LEAF transmission both link configurations have a comparable nonlinear tolerance.

articleTitle: First commercial service of a colorless Gigabit WDM/TDM hybrid PON system
abstract: We describe the first RSOA-based WDM/TDM hybrid PON system to enter commercial service. The system, consisting of a 16 times 1.25 Gb/s colorless Gigabit WDM-PON and a legacy TDM-PON with optical-electrical-optical converters, provides the triple-play service using fiber-to-the-home and fiber-to-the-node in a new residential area in Korea.

articleTitle: Plastic optical fiber links: A statistical study
abstract: We report the first large statistical study of graded index plastic optical fiber and demonstrate that modern POF reliably supports 10 Gb/s over 200 m and that reliable 40 Gb/s transmission over distances >100 m are achievable.

articleTitle: Experimental study of linear equalization combined with MLSE at 10.7 Gbps
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that linear equalization combined with MLSE detection can reduce requirements for sampling speed and number of states versus a stand-alone MLSE detector without linear equalization.

articleTitle: Exploiting transponder performance in optical OFDM networks
abstract: In contrast to fixed data rate transponders, OFDM transponders will be capable of adjusting their transmission rate according to the actual SNR of a link. Therefore the total network cost can be reduced remarkably.

articleTitle: Broadband data transmission in a 40 GHz fiber radio link using a dual-wavelength SBS fiber laser
abstract: We generate narrow-linewidth 40 GHz signals using a dual-wavelength SBS fiber laser. Data encoding at bit rates >1 Gb/s is also presented with 1 Gb/s data transmission in a 40 GHz wireless link demonstrated.

articleTitle: Economics of broadband access technologies for rural areas
abstract: We investigate the economics of rural broadband access technologies based on actual geographic information. For low bit-rates and low population density, wireless is the cheapest. For bit-rates exceeding 20 Mbit/s, PON is the lowest-cost technology.

articleTitle: Soft coded modulation for sensitivity enhancement of coherent 100-Gbit/s transmission systems
abstract: Soft-decoding of a PDM-QPSK signal with 34%-FEC overhead-enabled by a symbol rate increase from 28 to 35 Gbaud-leads to 10.7-dB OSNR sensitivity. Soft-decoding is not effective for POL-QAM 6-4 modulation.

articleTitle: Experimental GMPLS routing for dynamic provisioning in translucent wavelength switched optical networks
abstract: A novel OSNR-based IRWA algorithm and the required GMPLS extensions for dynamic provisioning in translucent WSON are presented. Experimental evaluation and validation in the ADRENALINE test-bed shows an important blocking reduction compared to transparent networks.

articleTitle: Trellis shaping for reduction of the peak-to-average power ratio in coherent optical OFDM systems
abstract: We propose a frequency-domain method with good structural properties for reduction of the PAPR in coherent optical OFDM systems. Numerical results indicate that the nonlinear threshold can be increased considerably at modest redundancy.

articleTitle: 16-QAM modulation by polar coordinate transformation with a single dual drive Mach-Zehnder Modulator
abstract: 16-QAM modulation by a single dual-drive Mach-Zehnder Modulator with minimum drive voltage employing polar coordinate transformation instead of a vector I/Q modulator was demonstrated. Clear signal separation was observed with 6-bit DAC resolution.

articleTitle: Adaptive antenna system for OFDMA WiMAX radio-over-fiber links using a directly modulated R-SOA and optical filtering
abstract: We implement a beam steering system based on a directly-modulated unseeded R-SOA, allowing the distribution of 2.4 GHz 64 QAM OFDMA signals with 2048-subcarriers satisfying IEEE 802.16 e specifications.

articleTitle: Automatic level controlled burst-mode optical fiber amplifier for 10 Gbit/s PON application
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, a 10-Gbit/s burst-mode optical receiver with an automatic level controlled burst-mode optical fiber amplifier (ALC-burst-OFA). We receive burst signals with 198.5-ns guard-time and 496.4-ns preamble, and achieve the wide dynamic-range of over 16.6-dB and −22.5-dBm sensitivity at BER=10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−10</sup> using our proposed ALC-burst-OFA and a DC-coupled continuous-mode optical receiver.

articleTitle: Recent progress on athermal AWG wavelength multiplexer
abstract: This paper describes recent progress in relation to the key requirements for athermal arrayed waveguide grating (AWG) multiplexers with resin-filled grooves, namely a wide passband and low loss, compactness and a wide operating temperature range.

articleTitle: Recent advances in 100G OTN
abstract: This paper reviews the market demands, standardization activities, and technology advances in 100G optical transport, as well as a realistic roadmap for volume production and deployment. Exciting challenges can be seen in each area.

articleTitle: 40-Gb/s transmission over 100m graded-index plastic optical fiber based on discrete multitone modulation
abstract: Spectral-efficient 40-Gb/s discrete multitone transmission over 100 m of graded-index plastic optical fiber is experimentally demonstrated by intensity-modulation of a 10-GHz DFB-laser (1302 nm) and direct-detection with a 25-mum large diameter photodetector.

articleTitle: Data-plane architectures for multi-granular OBS network
abstract: This paper presents multi-granular OBS node architectures able to manage multiservice traffic according to the required Quality-of-Service (QoS). These nodes exploit fast and slow switching devices to obtain scalable and cost-effective network.

articleTitle: SOA based upstream packet equalizer in 10Gb/s extended-reach PONs
abstract: We present a packet power equalizer for use in extended-reach PONs based on a gain-controlled SOA located in the local exchange. The scheme can equalize packets with 12 dB dynamic range without requiring a burst-mode receiver.

articleTitle: Chalcogenide core photonic crystal fibers for zero chromatic dispersion in the C-band
abstract: We propose and design chalcogenide core tellurite cladding nanofiber and photonic crystal fiber (PCF). The PCF shows zero flattened dispersion with zero slope at 1.5 mum wavelength. The structure can achieve high control on dispersion.

articleTitle: Modulation formats which approach the Shannon limit
abstract: This article consists of a collection of slides from the author's conference presentation. The complete oral presentation in text form was not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings. Some of the specific areas/topics discussed include: Trends in optical communication Trends in optical communication; Shannon limit; Generic communication theory Generic communication theory; Forward Error Correction Codes; Optical Systems; Capacity limit for non-linear systems; Multi-level modulation formats; and Breaking the current limit.

articleTitle: Colorless WDM-PON performance improvement exploiting a Service-ONU for multiwavelength distribution
abstract: A colorless performance-improved WDM-PON compatible with Gigabit-PON is presented. The proposed solution is based on a Service-ONU for multiwavelength distribution. Mitigation of Rayleigh backscattering effect and path-loss degradation is demonstrated in 2.5 Gb/s and 10 Gb/s schemes.

articleTitle: Long-haul Raman/ROPA-assisted EDFA systems
abstract: The Erbium-doped Fiber Amplifier (EDFA) is a key technical feature in nearly every optical undersea transmission system. This paper reviews simple performance enhancing Raman and ROPA assisted amplifier architectures.

articleTitle: NG broadband access - A total-cost-of-ownership analysis
abstract: TCO of access networks is determined by operational expenditures, with energy cost being one of the major contributors. We show that WDM-PON, although not lowest in capital expenditures, is a future-proof solution which minimizes TCO.

articleTitle: Virtual network topology manager (VNTM) and path computation element (PCE) cooperation in multi-layer GMPLS networks
abstract: A VNTM-PCE architecture for the effective configuration of Virtual TE Links is presented. Two policies are applied to improve the network stability while guaranteeing effective multi-layer Traffic Engineering performance.

articleTitle: Demonstration of contention resolution for labeled packets at 40 Gb/s using autonomous optical buffers
abstract: Contention resolution of labeled optical packets is demonstrated utilizing two packaged optical buffers. Forwarding and buffering decisions are autonomously determined for 40 Gb/s payloads from 10 Gb/s labels with greater than 99.9% packet recovery demonstrated.

Author Keywords: (060.1810) Buffers, couplers, routers, switches, and multiplexers

articleTitle: Phase-noise tolerance of optical 16-QAM signals demodulated with decision-directed carrier-phase estimation
abstract: Phase-noise tolerance of 10-Gsymbol/s 16-QAM signals is investigated both theoretically and experimentally. Optimizing the decision-directed phase-locked loop for carrier-phase estimation, we can obtain acceptable BER performance when the laser linewidth is in the 100-kHz range.

articleTitle: Demodulation of 1.28-Tbit/s polarization-multiplexed 16-QAM signals on a single carrier with digital coherent receiver
abstract: A 1.28-Tbit/s signal on a single carrier is generated by the combination of 16 time-division multiplexing, 16-QAM, and polarization multiplexing. Such a signal is demodulated with a digital coherent receiver having the time-division demultiplexing function.

articleTitle: Highly linear integrated coherent receivers for microwave photonic links
abstract: A coherent receiver with feedback was developed to linearly demodulate the phase of an analog signal. The receiver demonstrates a spur-free dynamic range of 125 dBmiddotPHz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2/3</sup> at a signal frequency of 300 MHz.

articleTitle: 10-Gbit/s TDM-PON and over-40-Gbit/s WDM/TDM-PON systems with OPEX-effective burst-mode technologies
abstract: We propose a 10-Gbit/s TDM-PON and an over 40-Gbit/s WDM/TDM-PON using our operational expenditure effective burst-mode technologies, which improve the interoperability and smoothness of migration to higher-speed PON systems.

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave multi-gigabit IC technologies for super-broadband wireless over fiber systems
abstract: A testbed for transmitting super-broadband 60 GHz wireless-over-fiber using all-optical up-conversion and electrical down-conversion by millimeter-wave multi-gigabit IC is demonstrated with 1.5 Gbps baseband data. A BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-8</sup> is achieved at 10 m between BS and MT.

articleTitle: Transmission reach attainable for single-polarization and PolMux coherent star 16QAM systems in comparison to 8PSK and QPSK at 10Gbaud
abstract: The transmission reach attainable for single-polarization and polarization-multiplexed 10 Gbaud Star 16 QAM systems with coherent detection is experimentally investigated for the first time and compared to 8PSK and QPSK performance at the same symbol rate.

articleTitle: VCSEL to VCSEL injection locking for uncompensated 40-km transmission at 10 Gb/s
abstract: We demonstrate 1.55 mum VCSEL to VCSEL injection locking that permits to propagate at 10 Gb/s over 40 km of SSMF with no penalty and without any dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: 107 Gb/s CO-OFDM transmission with inline chromatic dispersion compensation
abstract: The system performance of 107-Gb/s CO-OFDM system with inline dispersion-compensation is shown through both experiment and simulation. 2.8-dB Q difference is found between dispersion-compensated and dispersion-non-compensated WDM systems.

articleTitle: Lsp request bundling in a PCE-based WDM network
abstract: LSP requests may be bundled to improve the network optimization process at the expense of an increased connection setup delay. A detailed study is conducted to evaluate the pros and cons of the bundling approach.

articleTitle: SIP-based service platform for on-demand optical network services
abstract: This paper reports the experimental validation of a SIP-based service platform for optical transport networks. The platform enables applications to trigger network resource reservation during the session signaling thanks to a consistent network node configuration.

articleTitle: Effect of hybrid IQ imbalance compensation in 27.3-Gbit/s direct-detection OFDM transmission
abstract: A hybrid compensation method for transmitter and receiver IQ imbalance in high capacity OFDM is investigated. Effectiveness is confirmed by simulation and a 16 QAM 27.3-Gbit/s transmission experiment. After 320 km SSMF, 3.5 dB OSNR improvement is achieved.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of multi-impairment monitoring on a commercial 10 Gbit/s NRZ WDM channel
abstract: We present the first experimental demonstration of simultaneous monitoring of firstorder PMD with random power-split and chromatic dispersion using asynchronous delay-tap sampling, in a commercial 10 Gbit/s WDM test-bed. Accuracies achieved were plusmn3.1 ps and plusmn17 ps/nm.

articleTitle: A bandwidth challenge at Super Computing (SC) Conference: Large-scale data transfer using 10Gbps network
abstract: Results of bandwidth challenge contest at Super Computing (SC) 2007 by NICT are discussed. The target of this contest is to make full use of 10 Gbps network for any scientific applications. We, NICT team, attempted to transfer large-scale numerical data at NICT (in Japan) to SC 2007 venue in Reno, USA. We optimized our data transfer system for the real-time computer simulation data, and finally obtained through-put from Japan to USA as high as 4 Gbps.

articleTitle: WDM ring performance improvement by means of a nonlinear effects crosstalk minimization algorithm
abstract: An automatic method based on a genetic algorithm to assess and minimize the impact of nonlinear crosstalk in WDM ring channels is presented and validated. The objective is achieved by optimizing channel frequencies and powers.

articleTitle: Chipset for a coherent polarization-multiplexed QPSK receiver
abstract: Test results of the first modular receiver signal processor prototype for coherent polarization-multiplexed QPSK transmission are presented. The achieved BER at a data rate of 10 Gb/s is well below FEC threshold.

articleTitle: Self-seeded multicasting of 320 Gb/s data in a 2-pump parametric amplifier
abstract: We report first experimental demonstration of single stage, self-seeded 2-pump fiber optic parametric amplifier for simultaneous wavelength conversions. 320 Gb/s single channel OTDM signal was successfully copied to 5 wavelengths with <3 dB Q-factor penalty.

articleTitle: 13.5-Tb/s (135 × 111-Gb/s/ch) no-guard-interval coherent OFDM transmission over 6,248 km using SNR maximized second-order DRA in the extended L-band
abstract: By employing 111Gb/s no-guard-interval coherent OFDM and SNR maximized second-order distributed Raman amplification in the extended L-band, we demonstrate the record capacity-distance product of 84.3Petabit/s.km (13.5Tb/s × 6,248km), and also 1Tb/s transmission over 9,612km.

articleTitle: 1-Tb/s per channel coherent optical OFDM transmission with subwavelength bandwidth access
abstract: 1-Tb/s per channel coherent optical OFDM transmission over 600-km SSMF fiber is demonstrated assisted with a recirculating frequency shifter. Record spectral efficiency and transmission reach is achieved at 1-Tb/s channel rate without Raman amplification.

articleTitle: 2R regeneration of two 130 Gbit/s channels within a single fiber
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the simultaneous all-optical regeneration of two 130 Gbit/s signals in a single highly nonlinear fibre using self-phase modulation and offset filtering. No degradation was observed due to the presence of the second channel.

articleTitle: Simultaneous transmission of digitized multiple wireless services over optical fiber
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate simultaneous transmission of digitized multiple wireless services over fiber. Using an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) with 8-bit resolution, channels are successfully recovered after 20 km transmission with satisfactory error-vector magnitudes (EVM).

articleTitle: Electro-optic synthesis of 8PSK by quad-parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator
abstract: We propose a method to synthesize optical 8PSK with linear phasor trajectory by using a quad-parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator, where BPSK signals are linearly superposed to form 8PSK. Modulation and demodulation of 30-Gb/s 8PSK are demonstrated.

articleTitle: A novel OFDMA-PON architecture toward seamless broadband and wireless integration
abstract: We propose a novel OFDMA-PON architecture enabling seamless integration of broadband data and wireless signals from multiple remote antennas. We demonstrate that three 20 MHz wireless channels at 2.1 GHz-band are trimly overlaid with 10 Gbps OFDMA-PON signal.

articleTitle: Robust, wavelength- and temperature-insensitive 14 krad/s endless polarization tracking over 2.5 Grad
abstract: Results of 14 krad/s endless polarization tracking experiments are presented. Wavelength (1520...1564 nm), temperature (0...70degC) and second, nominally fixed polarization were varied, and a 2.5Grad long polarization trajectory was tracked in 64 h. Mean/maximum polarization errors were les0.053/0.13 rad.

articleTitle: Backward compatible coexistence of PON systems
abstract: We review the concept of PON coexistence, which facilitates upgrading existing networks. The existing coexistence mechanisms are compared, but found wanting in some respects. A novel scheme with a superior combination of properties is proposed.

articleTitle: Modulation formats for 100Gb/s coherent optical systems
abstract: A set of modulation formats for 100Gb/s optical transmission are compared based on OSNR tolerance, equalization complexity, and A/D requirements. Propagation penalty as a function of dispersion compensation is studied for a chosen candidate.

articleTitle: Low return loss field-installable optical connector
abstract: This paper describes the development of a low return loss mechanical splice type field installable connector while maintaining good ease of installation and performance.

articleTitle: IP and optical integration in dynamic networks
abstract: Dynamic DWDM networking has not been productized in the past despite significant research. We discuss reasons for this, real-world needs for such dynamism, and enabling IP/optical capabilities that will make this technology deployable.

articleTitle: Polarization properties of DCMs: Thermal variations
abstract: Polarization properties of fiber-based dispersion compensating modules (DCMs) display reversible and irreversible dependence when subject to temperature cycles and thermal shocks, respectively, with slow temporal dependence of the DGD.

articleTitle: Dynamic load-balanced manycasting over optical burst-switched (OBS) networks
abstract: Data-loss in optical-burst-switched networks primarily occur due to contention of bursts at core nodes. We propose two dynamic congestion-based load-balanced manycast-routing techniques, namely load-balanced SPT and load-balanced DM that significantly improve blocking-probability and end-to-end delay.

articleTitle: Sub-wavelength traffic on an optical network
abstract: Traditional wavelength services are now below the DWDM wavelength rate. Analysis of AT&T's 2.5 G sub-wavelength services on a nationwide optical network gives insight to how services should be supported at 40 Gb/s and 100 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Ultra long-haul transmission over 6,000 km of 100 Gb/s serial signal by using coherent detection
abstract: We have demonstrated a 100-Gb/s single channel transmission over the longest distance of 6,000 km ever reported using 2-subcarrier no-guard-interval PDM CO-OFDM. The unique DSP technology enabled to compensate for CD up to 109,200 ps/nm.

articleTitle: Overlaying coherent-detection channels over direct-detection channels in multi-bit-rate systems
abstract: We discuss the interactions of coherent PDM-QPSK channels at 40 Gb/s or 100 Gb/s with lower-bit-rate legacy channels over a typical terrestrial link. Nonlinear effects are found especially penalizing at 40 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Broadband antennas and efficient electro-optic interfaces for fiber-radio applications
abstract: Techniques are presented that produce highly efficient, broadband antenna/electro-optic interfaces for fiber-radio applications. Advantages of different approaches are highlighted and we show that the device packaging can enhance the performance of fiber-radio RF front-ends.

articleTitle: Microwave photonic applications for silicon photonics
abstract: Silicon-based CMOS Photonics offers many advantages when implementing microwave photonic systems. The toolset available in CMOS photonics and the advantages it offers for the implementation of microwave photonic systems are presented here.

articleTitle: Survivable hierarchical optical path networks employing waveband and wavelength path protection
abstract: We propose a novel hierarchical optical path network design algorithm ensuring wavelength path protection. The effectiveness of the waveband networks that adopt waveband or wavelength path protection are elucidated compared to single layer optical networks.

articleTitle: Local Oscillator Phase Noise Induced Penalties in Optical Coherent Detection Systems Using Electronic Chromatic Dispersion Compensation
abstract: We show that chromatic dispersion induced local oscillator (LO) phase noise to amplitude noise conversion significantly degrades the performance of a high-speed coherent system without optical dispersion compensation and tightens the requirement on LO linewidth.

articleTitle: High-bit-rate optical QAM
abstract: We review electro-optic synthesis of high-speed and high-spectral-efficient optical QAM, where a multi-parallel MZM is utilized. It is shown that QAM and other multi-level formats are synthesized superposing BPSK signals.

articleTitle: Maximizing the transmission performance of DMT signal for next generation PON system by direct modulation of cost-effective and low bandwidth lasers
abstract: Using Levin-Campello bit loading algorithm in DMT format to optimize communication link capacity, high bit rate transmission for NGPON is experimentally demonstrated by direct modulation of low bandwidth and low-cost commercially available lasers and receivers.

articleTitle: Dependence of the Transmission Impairment on the WSS Port Isolation Spectral Profile in 50GHz ROADM Networks with 43Gb/s NRZ-ADPSK Signals
abstract: We analyze how the 50 GHz WSS port isolation spectral profile impairs the performance of 43 Gb/s NRZ-ADPSK wavelengths and find that >10 dB of isolation is needed at the center of the channel relative to the edges.

articleTitle: Demonstration of fast optical protection in ROADM system with one-chip color/direction-independent add/drop multiplexer employing silicon photonic circuit
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated wavelength path and transponder fault recovery in ROADM system with one-chip color/direction-independent add/drop multiplexers employing silicon photonic circuit. Fault recovery time of less than 50ms was achieved for both fault cases.

articleTitle: Burst-mode bit-rate discrimination circuit for 1.25/10.3-Gbit/s dual-rate PON systems
abstract: We propose a 1.25/10.3-Gbit/s bit rate discrimination circuit that can distinguish the bit rate of burst signals in 50 ns. A dual-rate burst-mode receiver including this circuit can operate correctly without any external control signals.

articleTitle: Optoelectronic package having optical waveguide hole and 4-ch × 10-Gb/s chip-to-chip interconnection using thin-film waveguide connector
abstract: We have developed optoelectronic packages having optical waveguide holes with core-clad structure for chip-to-chip interconnection within computer systems. 4-channels times 10 Gb/s signal transmissions between packages were demonstrated with thin-film polymer waveguide.

articleTitle: Low power consumption PLC-type 43Gb/s DQPSK demodulator
abstract: A low power consumption DQPSK demodulator is realized with a PLC with resin-filled grooves. The power consumption from -5 to 70degC is 1.4W, which is 60% lower than for a conventional demodulator with TEC control.

articleTitle: Suppression of nonlinear phase noise in a DPSK transmission using a nonlinear amplifying loop mirror
abstract: Experimental and numerical investigations of phase-preserving amplitude regeneration in a DPSK transmission with a NALM have shown that a 3 dB improvement of the Q-factor or alternatively a 3 dB increase of fiber-launched power could be achieved.

articleTitle: A millimetre wave phase shifter using a wireless hybrid mode locked laser
abstract: 40 GHz hybrid mode locking is observed using planar antennas to form a wireless connection to the saturable absorber. Electronically controlled phase shift is measured which could enable remote antenna beam steering in future WLAN systems.

articleTitle: Generation of a stable and frequency-tunable microwave signal using a polarization modulator and a wavelength-fixed notch filter
abstract: A novel and simple technique for the generation of a stable and frequency-tunable microwave signal using a polarization modulator and a wavelength-fixed notch filter is proposed and experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optimizing the migration of channels with higher Bit-rates
abstract: 10 G can be groomed into 40 G channels or transmitted natively, reducing reach of concurrently mixed 40 G channels. For long-term migration under traffic growth, optimal network cost is achieved by early investments in 40 G-only transmission systems.

articleTitle: Estimation of phase ripple penalties for 40 Gb/s NRZ-DPSK transmission
abstract: Phase ripple penalties generated by up to 6 fiber-Bragg gratings are determined through simulations and experiments of 40 G NRZ-DPSK transmission. A practical approach to estimating the phase ripple impact on the system performance is proposed.

articleTitle: 10G-EPON standardization and its development status
abstract: Why 10G-EPON? ❒ Optical feeders with bandwidth of 10Gbps are necessary for next-generation access system, and PON topology is expected to reduce CAPEX and OPEX.

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion of real-time 100-Gb/s POLMUX RZ-DQPSK
abstract: We present efficient wavelength conversion of a polarization-multiplexed RZ-DQPSK channel through cascading in a lithium niobate waveguide. BER measurements confirm that this is a promising technique for signal processing in high-bit-rate phase-modulated formats.We present efficient wavelength conversion of a polarization-multiplexed RZ-DQPSK channel through cascading in a lithium niobate waveguide. BER measurements confirm that this is a promising technique for signal processing in high-bit-rate phase-modulated formats.

articleTitle: 108 Gb/s OFDMA-PON with polarization multiplexing and direct-detection
abstract: The first single-lambda 108-Gb/s 16QAM-OFDMA-PON is demonstrated using polarization-multiplexed optical OFDM and direct-detection. This is the highest single-lambda downstream rate in PON reported to date, achieved over 20 km SSMF and a 1:32 split.

articleTitle: Polarization evolution in dispersion compensation modules
abstract: We employ a falling weight to generate high-frequency fluctuations in the polarization and PMD of commercial dispersion compensation modules and observe that for low impact forces the polarization variation is nearly identical for successive measurements.

articleTitle: Operational solutions for an open DWDM layer
abstract: We discuss operational considerations of implementing alien wavelengths over an open DWDM network, using advanced DWDM system capabilities. We demonstrate feasibility of this solution using a commercial management tool and DWDM system.

articleTitle: Electrical Compensation of Fiber Chromatic Dispersion Induced RF Power Fading in Optical Double-Sideband Subcarrier Modulation
abstract: We present and demonstrate a new optical double-sideband modulation technique that is free of dispersion induced RF power fading. The predicted 3-dB RF power improvement over optical single sideband modulation is experimentally verified.

articleTitle: All-optical up-conversion of millimeter-wave signals for ROF system using optical carrier suppression-based dual-pump FWM in an SOA
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate all-optical up-conversion of radio-over-fiber signals based on a dual-pump four-wave mixing in an semiconductor optical amplifier for the first time. 2.5 Gbit/s baseband signals are successfully up-converted to 40-GHz millimeter-wave carrier.

articleTitle: A novel incoherent scheme for Photonic Generation of Biphase Modulated UWB Signals
abstract: A novel incoherent scheme for generation of direct-sequence binary biphase modulated ultrawideband (UWB) signals is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. There is no requirement for pulse shaper (optical filter) in our proposed system.

articleTitle: Statistical analysis of single-mode fiber field splice losses
abstract: Using measurements of splice losses in the AT&T network, a statistical model for splice losses is presented and inferences can be made for the distributions of lateral, angular, and longitudinal fiber displacements in field splices.

articleTitle: 1.1-µm-range 12 channels × 10-Gbit/s transmission over 600m MMF using high-density optical modules
abstract: For the first time, we demonstrate 1.1-mum-range 12 channels times 10-Gbit/s error free transmission over 600 m optical link consisting of high-density parallel-optical modules employed with an electrical-pluggable interface and a multi-mode fiber optimized at 1.1-mum.

articleTitle: A GaAs/AlGaAs based uni-traveling-carrier photodiode for 10Gbit/sec optical interconnect at 850nm wavelength with zero electrical power consumption
abstract: We demonstrate a GaAs/AlGaAs based uni-traveling-carrier photodiode for optical interconnect at 850 nm. Under zero-bias operation, such device exhibits reasonable external efficiency (48%), wide 3-dB bandwidth (13 GHz), and 10 Gbit/sec eye-opening without integrating with any active ICs.

articleTitle: Two-electrode high power tapered laser with up to 40.5 W/A static modulation efficiency and 700 Mb/s direct modulation capability
abstract: We report a high modulation efficiency two-electrode tapered laser with a record 0.81W output optical modulation amplitude for 70mA applied current swing under 700Mb/s direct modulation. In addition the device shows a record 40.5W/A static modulation efficiency.

articleTitle: Push-pull modulation of coupled-cavity VCSELs
abstract: Coupled-cavity VCSELs have the ability to modulate the longitudinal optical mode distribution. This longitudinal mode modulation can produce light output modulation without changing the total carrier and photon densities in the laser.

articleTitle: WDM-to-OTDM traffic grooming by means of asynchronous retiming
abstract: We experimentally investigate data protocol transparent 3times43 Gb/s to 129 Gb/s WDM-to-OTDM conversion based on an asynchronous retiming scheme, for buffer-less OTDM traffic grooming. We demonstrate worst-case power penalty of less than 3.5 dB.

articleTitle: 10.8-Gb/s OFDMA-PON transmission performance study
abstract: We have studied the 10.8-Gb/s (10-Gb/s after coding) OFDMA-PON downstream and upstream transmission performance with 8 OUN-s over 20km SSMF. The maximum path loss was achieved at 25.5dB using IM and APD without optical amplifier.

articleTitle: Fiber design for SBS suppression by using hole-assisted structure
abstract: We propose a simple fiber design with a hole-assisted structure for suppressing SBS. We experimentally realize a 7.0 dB improvement in the SBS threshold compared with SSMF, and numerically show a 13.5 dB improvement by profile optimization.
